title: Zero-Degree Ambiguity
author: Lan Sheng
synopsis:
One-sentence summary: I married my arch-nemesis.
　　In physics, zero degrees is a mixture of ice and water. Zero-degree ambiguity is the combination of ice and water—the perfect match in love.
　　Lingdu Design Company has two demons. Everyone in the company is terrified of them and knows full well how much they despise each other.
　　In fact, the dartboard on the wall in Design Director Wen Ni’s office is covered with photos of the same man.
　　Until they discover that these two are actually a secretly married couple in private.
　　Whoa, everyone realizes: so we were just a part of their "play"?
　　Thinking back, the way they looked at each other was never really innocent.
　　With the blinds drawn in the office, the woman is pressed against the edge of the desk, and the man leans in close: "I heard you want a divorce?"
　　The woman’s high heel slides up his suit trousers, her voice languid: "Whether we divorce or not, doesn't that depend on how you perform?"

chapters.title: Save your energy for the moaning later
chapters.content:
When Wen Ni finished her shower and lay on the bed, she remembered she still had a package she hadn't opened.

The packaging was berry-colored, tied with a black satin ribbon in a bow, topped with a matching skull charm that seemed to give a suggestive smile.

She was a regular at this shop, and the owner understood her aesthetic well; the style was exactly what she liked.

Work was busy, and she felt that at times like this, pleasing herself and self-satisfaction were very necessary.

Moonlight filtered through the sheer curtains as Wen Ni examined the item carefully.

Compared to the one she bought last month, if she left this on the nightstand, no one would probably notice.

Wen Ni lay back on the bed, her dark green silk camisole nightdress bunching up around her waist along her thighs.

She wiggled around, found a comfortable position, closed her eyes, and prepared to enter a world of blissful sensation.

However, her body, exhausted from returning after a meeting at dawn, needed some visual stimulation. Unable to get into the mood, Wen Ni simply reached out and turned on the projector, turning up the volume.

Exaggerated images exploded in the room. She watched everything before her, then slid one shoulder strap down...

The music of the electronic door lock sounded right on cue. A man pushed a black suitcase into the room, stood still in the entryway, closed the door, changed into black slippers, and straightened the high heels the woman had kicked off carelessly.

Before he could even stand up straight, he heard suggestive sounds echoing from the ceiling.

And the source of the sound was the master bedroom of this house.

His and Wen Ni’s, marital home.

Wen Ni, in the moment her brain went blank, began to enter a "sage state."

She felt a bit tired; maybe she should just go to sleep like this.

Her eyes were a bit sore from the screen's light, so she raised an arm to cover them, closed her eyes, and breathed lightly.

Suddenly, she felt something was wrong.

It was as if a shadow had covered her form.

In an instant, Wen Ni’s mind flashed with various social news stories about women living alone being invaded by perverts.

She opened her eyes abruptly, propped herself up with her elbows, and locked eyes with the man at the doorway.

Jian Yuchen raised an eyebrow.

Wen Ni’s mind went blank for a moment.

Their gazes met in the air.

Wen Ni looked away, then looked back, and he was still standing there.

Awkwardness rippled through the air.

After a long while, Wen Ni slowly pulled over the thin air-conditioning quilt to cover her somewhat messy lower half.

Then she tucked her messy hair behind her ears.

"Cough, cough..." She finally spoke, her voice slow, clearly making small talk.

"Why didn't you say anything before coming back?"

Damn it, coming back at this time!

Why the hell did you have to come back now!

Wen Ni wanted to get up and kill this bastard, but on the surface, she had to pretend to be calm.

Jian Yuchen smiled, that annoying mouth of his opening and closing as he let out a whistle, "Playing quite wildly all by yourself, huh."

"..." Wen Ni grabbed a pillow and threw it directly at him.

Jian Yuchen didn't dodge.

"I need a shower, want to join?" the man asked naturally as he took off his jacket.

As natural as asking if she wanted a midnight snack.

Wen Ni gave up, lay back down, and wrapped herself into a cocoon, "No, go wash in the guest room."

"It's my bedroom, why should I go to the guest room?" Jian Yuchen disagreed.

That would be making a mountain out of a molehill.

As he spoke, the man walked to the bedside, looking down at the lump on the bed.

Wen Ni intended to play dead, but thinking of the scene just now, this guy would mock her for the rest of her life.

She decided to catch him off guard and pretend to be asleep.

"You were so energetic just a moment ago, and now you're sleepy?"

"..."

She. Just. Knew. It!

This dog of a man would never miss a chance to mock her.

Having finally caught her in such a compromising position, he would definitely attack her from all angles!

The screen had changed scenes, and while Jian Yuchen’s dog mouth hadn't continued its witty remarks, Wen Ni kept her eyes tightly shut.

She continued to wrap herself in her little quilt and play dead.

She decided that no matter what Jian Yuchen said, she wouldn't listen to a word.

Did she think he couldn't see it just because she turned it off?

He picked up her phone and checked the browsing history, "Last time I said I wanted to watch this, you said the bodies were trash and you weren't interested. How did you evolve to being so hypocritical in both body and mind? Did you undergo an ultimate evolution while I was away on business for these two weeks?"

The man’s voice was languid, laced with malicious teasing.

What he said made her feel embarrassed from head to toe.

Wen Ni felt the battle tonight wasn't going well from the start, so she decided it was better to wait and see.

Seeing her playing dead, the man reached out, his long fingers poking into the quilt, creating a wrinkled little dent.

"The little lace is still hanging on your ankle, you managed to escape unscathed."

"Tsk tsk tsk, how pitiful, all alone..."

The silkworm cocoon on the bed moved immediately. Wen Ni had almost forgotten where she threw her underwear, and being reminded by him, she started throwing punches inside the quilt.

Shut up! You dog!

"Are you done yet!" Wen Ni threw off the quilt and glared at him.

Jian Yuchen raised an eyebrow at the sight of her exposed skin, smacked his lips, and said, "Not playing dead anymore?"

"Who was playing dead? That's called high-efficiency rest, can you even do that?" Wen Ni glared at him and then calmly pulled her nightdress back into place.

"What's the point of wearing it? You'll just take it off in a minute anyway. Can this little bit of time satisfy you or what?" Jian Yuchen didn't dodge this time and was hit in the face with the pillow.

However, the man wasn't angry. He caught the pillow with one hand as it fell, then reached into the quilt.

Like a python hunting a rabbit, he pinpointed his target, dragged her out of the quilt by her ankles, and used the pillow to prop up Wen Ni’s waist.

"Save your energy for the moaning later," Jian Yuchen’s eyes darkened as he pressed her back down.

...

When Wen Ni opened her eyes, there was no one by the bed, and it was just beginning to get light outside.

After being tossed around by that dog Jian Yuchen, her waist was aching terribly.

She wanted to go to the kitchen for a glass of water when she noticed a red glow on the balcony.

She pulled her robe tight and peeked out, finding Jian Yuchen hiding there smoking.

Wen Ni didn't allow him to smoke indoors, so the balcony had become his exclusive smoking

chapters.title: I'm not very close with my husband
chapters.content:
His tall, upright back carried a hint of post-satisfaction fatigue. He held a cigarette between his long fingers. When he heard the movement and turned his head, he slowly exhaled a cloud of smoke. His handsome face was hidden in the mist, carrying a hint of frivolous wickedness.

He was only wearing a bathrobe, untied, exposing a large expanse of his chest, which had several scratch marks.

They were from when Wen Ni couldn't help herself during their madness earlier.

In all fairness, Jian Yuchen’s physique was lean and strong, not overly muscular—the kind that looked like a walking clothes hanger in clothes, and a bewitching male fox when stripped.

Coupled with his upturned eyes, Wen Ni felt that from a hundred meters away, if you couldn't tell human from beast, he actually had quite a bit of style.

She only admitted that much.

"Fucked stupid? What are you standing there for?"

She had only been staring at his chest for a moment, and sure enough, nothing good ever came out of this dog's mouth.

Wen Ni rolled her eyes slightly and was about to turn away when her waist tightened, and she was lifted off the ground.

Jian Yuchen placed her directly on the balcony railing, supporting her behind with one hand, while his other hand held the back of Wen Ni’s head to keep her from moving, pressing her down and kissing her.

She couldn't break free at all!

He had always liked the stimulating smell of smoke. Although Wen Ni would have one or two when work pressure was high, she wasn't as addicted as he was.

The scent of smoke swirled between their breaths until the kiss ended.

Wen Ni kicked him in the thigh, and then Jian Yuchen carried her down.

Don't let her temper fool you; she was petite and delicate. Without her usual sky-high heels, she stepped hard on his foot. Especially since her silver nail polish, driven by her vengeful heart, left a shimmering silver streak as she ground her heel into his foot.

However, that little bit of force was like a tickle to the man.

Wen Ni stomped twice more before tossing her hair and turning back into the room, cursing as she walked, "If you bring the smell of smoke inside, I'll send you to the eunuch's quarters tonight."

"So fierce?" The man followed her in. Just as Wen Ni opened the bedroom door, he followed from behind, his long legs slowly stretching out to close the door she had just opened. Then, catching her off guard, he hoisted her up and slowly walked toward the bathroom.

"Jian Yuchen, are you trying to die tonight!" He’d been provoking her ever since he got back from his business trip! There’s no end to it, is there!

"You have some on you too, let's wash together."

The man spoke with utter candor. As he reached out to push the bathroom doors open, his tone became somewhat ambiguous, "Besides, it was only twice—are you satisfied already?"

"I know better than you how to keep you satisfied."

He’d only been gone a few days, and he’d already bought new tricks.

Heh, he wouldn't stand for that!

-

After a night of debauchery, when the alarm clock rang in the room filled with the scent of lethargy, Wen Ni mechanically pulled back the quilt and got out of bed.

As she rose, the heavy blackout curtains opened automatically, letting in the blinding summer sun that radiated heat regardless of the time of day.

Wen Ni felt like a female ghost from the Lanruo Temple, having had her life force drained by a man, only to have to return to her grandmother to report back.

She squinted and let out a long yawn. Looking up, she saw the man, dressed impeccably, already standing in the walk-in closet, adjusting his tie at his collar.

The clingy demeanor from last night had vanished completely. At this moment, Jian Yuchen looked both cold and aloof, the very image of an elite you didn't want to mess with.

It was also the look Wen Ni was most familiar with.

The man watched her disheveled, completely dazed state through the mirror and curled his lips in a satisfied smile.

Wen Ni naturally didn't miss his smug look. As she passed by him, she remarked, "Your technique seemed to be lousy last night. My review is... it’s not as good as a little toy."

Jian Yuchen smoothed his cufflinks, expressionless. "Seeing is believing. Why don't you go take a look at the bedsheets yourself before you keep talking."

He stepped closer as he spoke, "You. Were. Incredible."

Wen Ni had never been one to shy away from a verbal sparring match. No matter what happened later, right now, in this moment, she had to win.

"Women’s acting can be quite deceptive at times."

She finished by patting his shoulder, "Don't be a sore loser."

Jian Yuchen stood with his hands in his pockets, looking down at this woman who didn't know when to quit.

The bathroom door slammed shut.

From inside, Wen Ni’s voice drifted out, forceful and crisp.

"I want an egg and pork floss sandwich, add a slice of lettuce, and a latte."

Usually, if Wen Ni woke up on time and Jian Yuchen happened to be home, he was the one who took care of breakfast.

In the three years they had been married, this was their unspoken agreement.

Jian Yuchen glanced at his watch and then slowly walked out of the room.

Ten minutes later, the door opened. Jian Yuchen looked up to see the woman fully prepared, showing almost no trace of fatigue.

After breakfast, they changed their shoes at the entrance and left at the same time, their movements perfectly synchronized.

The same high efficiency.

When the elevator doors opened, their movements of pressing their car keys were as uniform as if they had been rehearsed.

Even the aura they projected as they walked toward their respective cars—the "I don't know this person" vibe—was identical.

Even their next-door neighbor, who had lived across from them for three years, wouldn't have known they were a married couple if they hadn't accidentally caught them leaving together one day.

Their cars pulled out with the screech of tires on the plastic flooring. The two SUVs departed one after the other, parting ways at the entrance of the residential complex.

-

At 9:00 AM, the office was already bustling with the sounds of phones ringing and printers running.

"Morning, Simon!"

Jian Yuchen nodded. "Morning."

The man walked quickly through the office area. His assistant was waiting at the door, and as soon as he entered, he began reporting on the data he had organized after returning from his business trip last night.

Wen Ni came up from another elevator shortly after. Design Group A was waiting for her final decision.

"Winnie."

Lingdu was a joint-venture design firm, and they usually only addressed each other by their English names.

Wen Ni nodded, took two steps, and then turned to look at her group of bewildered subordinates. "Gather in the conference room in three minutes."

"Understood, Winnie."

Just as she opened her office door, Zhou Xueli from the planning department followed her in.

"The previous proposal." Zhou Xueli sat down across from her desk.

Wen Ni took it, placed it on the desk, and pulled out a hair tie to put her hair up. "Okay."

Seeing her busy the moment she walked in, Zhou Xueli tapped the desk. As the office gossip partner, no one knew better than her just how strong Wen Ni’s appetite for gossip was.

"Have you heard? That new guy, Simon, seems to have landed the new development project for Shengtang International. If our company can really pull this off, that one deal will be enough for this year’s performance. The partner the boss found really has some skills. And you wouldn't believe it—all the young girls in the company are absolutely crazy about him. They say he’s got 'style,' is a gentleman, and they’re praising him to the high heavens."

After Zhou Xueli finished, Wen Ni almost rolled her eyes. That bastard had style? He was just good at dressing himself up. A gentleman? Pfft.

She took a sip of the coffee she’d bought on the way, but Zhou Xueli’s next sentence almost made her spit it out.

"I heard he’s gay."

chapters.title: I Guess She Just Can’t Have My Love
chapters.content:
Wen Ni forced herself to swallow the coffee, hurriedly gathering her things for the meeting while whispering, "Where did you hear this hearsay?"

"Don't you know about Matthia from the marketing department? I heard that while he was away on his business trip, she went to knock on his hotel room door in the middle of the night."

Wen Ni truly didn't know that. The point was, she wasn't sure if Jian Yuchen would have told her about such a romantic encounter.

"And then? Did he let her in?"

Zhou Xueli was too busy basking in the glow of the gossip to notice that her gossip partner Wen Ni’s expression had suddenly turned quite chilling.

"If he’d let her in, they wouldn't be saying he’s gay!"

Wen Ni looked away without a trace, not even noticing herself that the weight on her heart had suddenly lifted.

No, she didn't care; it was just that she couldn't share a cucumber with another woman. She found it dirty.

That was just human nature, right?

It had nothing to do with that guy, Jian Yuchen.

After Wen Ni tried hard to convince herself, Zhou Xueli raised an eyebrow. "It’s not just that he didn't let her in; he even talked to her through the door. That made Matthia furious, and she came back saying she’s determined to win that Simon over within a month."

Wen Ni had no intention of discussing Matthia’s charm; after all, her relationship with Jian Yuchen wasn't exactly great either.

"That’s hard to judge~ Wish her luck." Wen Ni glanced at her watch. "I have to go to the meeting. See you at the restaurant for lunch."

"Fine, go ahead." Zhou Xueli waved her hand. As she watched Wen Ni sway her hips and march briskly into the conference room, she couldn't help but feel that the gossip today hadn't been satisfying enough.

As soon as Zhou Xueli left Wen Ni’s office, she bumped straight into Jian Yuchen.

The man didn't have that greasy, overly-polished look; instead, he was fresh and clean, yet he didn't lack masculine sexual tension.

However, sexual tension is a strange thing; from a genetic perspective, it’s a unique form of male charisma.

In this regard, Jian Yuchen was enviably gifted.

"Winnie not in?"

The man’s clear, magnetic, deep voice rang out.

Zhou Xueli quickly said, "She just went to a meeting."

Jian Yuchen said politely, "My timing is off. Thank you."

The man turned to leave, then looked back. "Oh, remember to tell her that the Jinfeng design proposal has been rejected."

Zhou Xueli’s smile froze on her face as she watched him walk away, leaving only his back behind.

One of Wen Ni’s two major projects this year was Jinfeng, and it was a design proposal that the design department had been working overtime on for half a year, preparing to submit for the bid this month.

It had already passed three rounds of review, and it had been submitted to the higher-ups; everything was progressing smoothly.

To suddenly say the proposal was "rejected"—not "killed"—meant it had to be redone.

Given Wen Ni’s explosive temper, there was no telling if she would go crazy when she got back.

Zhou Xueli couldn't even imagine what her friend would look like when she found out.

Wen Ni indeed didn't know, because this Shengtang International project was one of the two major projects Jian Yuchen had brought in after joining the company.

However, the design proposals and concepts submitted hadn't reached the state she wanted.

The atmosphere in the meeting all morning had been deadlocked.

By the time they finally made it to lunch, the young designers coming out of the conference room had colorful, indescribable expressions on their faces, each one looking more wilted and filled with resentment than the next.

Wen Ni passed by their workstations, and they let out long sighs.

Lingdu was one of the top design firms in the industry, and those who could get in were all talented, but the work pressure and intensity were several times higher than at other companies.

Partner Ning Yan knocked on the office door. Jian Yuchen looked up from his computer. "Going to lunch?"

Jian Yuchen checked the time. "Wait a moment, I need to take a call."

Ning Yan simply walked in to wait. Jian Yuchen was about to suggest he go out when the phone on the desk rang.

"Hello, Jian Yuchen."

"Hello your head!" Wen Ni’s furious voice erupted from the other end.

"Why was the Jinfeng proposal rejected? What’s the reason?!"

"No reason. The client said it wasn't suitable."

"Not suitable! You’re telling me it’s not suitable now? Do you know we already had the design plan approved? They suddenly say it’s not suitable, and all our current work has to stop. And if we have to revise it, we need a direction! Where am I supposed to start from?"

Wen Ni had ranted in one breath, clearly on the verge of losing it.

Jian Yuchen held the receiver away from his ear, setting it aside, but Wen Ni’s questioning could still be heard clearly from the other side.

She probably finished venting and hung up directly, not even giving Jian Yuchen a chance to speak.

Ning Yan stifled a laugh, unable to hold it in any longer.

Wen Ni was the company’s famously spicy pepper, but her professional ability was strong, and she could produce beautiful results, which was enough to command respect.

Even Ning Yan, the big boss, was often challenged by her when she slammed her hand on the table.

But as for being able to go head-to-head with Wen Ni, to the point where everyone in the company knew they were at odds from the moment he joined—that was likely only Jian Yuchen.

"We can go to lunch now." The handsome, tall man stood up, seemingly unaffected by what had just happened.

Ning Yan went out with him to wait for the elevator. "It’s strange, you’ve always had great luck with women. Even an Iron Man would turn into a pink Barbie upon meeting you, so why do you and Wen Ni fight the moment you see each other?"

Jian Yuchen raised an eyebrow. "Ah, I suppose it’s because she loves me but can’t have me."

Ning Yan was amused. "I didn't realize you had such a sense of humor."

If Wen Ni were to love any man and not be able to have him, it certainly wouldn't be Jian Yuchen.

The two of them were like needles against wheat awns, wishing they could bite each other to death.

For there to be anything between them would be absolutely absurd.

When they arrived at the staff cafeteria, people from other companies were also arriving one after another.

Standing there, Jian Yuchen’s 189cm height made him stand out from the crowd. The sound of Wen Ni’s high heels clicked with a distinct rhythm as she swept past them quickly, not even sparing him a glance, and Ning Yan, who was with him, didn't fare any better.

Ning Yan shrugged at Jian Yuchen.

When Zhou Xueli ran over, she greeted the two of them before squeezing in next to Wen Ni. "Hey, calm down."

"If I haven't twisted his head off yet, doesn't that mean I'm calm enough?" Wen Ni picked up a few light meals she liked and chose a booth by the window.

As soon as she sat down with Zhou Xueli, Ning Yan came over to greet them. "Do you mind?"

How could Wen Ni not know him?

He was just afraid that she would make things difficult for Jian Yuchen and affect the company's daily operations.

Since he was the big boss and also her senior from university, Wen Ni shrugged, and Ning Yan sat down with a smile.

The base note of woody perfume always carried an alluring scent. Wen Ni took a sip of coffee. The man had already taken his seat opposite her, his long legs stretching forward and bumping into her stocking-clad legs. Wen Ni subconsciously wanted to kick him, but her leg was clamped firmly by his powerful legs, stuck awkwardly in mid-air, unable to pull away.

chapters.title: Bedding as Rotten as His Mouth
chapters.content:
Wen Ni gave him a fierce, subtle glare, but Jian Yuchen took it as her flirting with him.

The man leisurely added seasoning to the fried egg on his plate. Wen Ni glanced at him sideways, trying to pull her foot away while simultaneously cursing him to have an accident—hoping that the entire jar of salt would spill into his meal.

Things did not go as Wen Ni expected. Jian Yuchen perfectly adjusted the seasoning, then picked up his knife and fork to eat his favorite fried egg.

Behind his calm and breezy demeanor was the posture of a predator biting down on its prey and refusing to let go.

At least, Wen Ni felt as if she had been firmly clamped by the pincers of a hairy crab; not only could she not pull away, but he also rubbed against her suggestively.

Wen Ni’s blood boiled. She wanted nothing more than to flip the vegetable salad in front of her onto his face, just so he would know the consequences of harassing a decent woman in broad daylight!

She was no pushover.

The other two couldn't see the sparks flying between them; they only knew that Wen Ni’s expression was getting worse and worse. This Jian Yuchen was really something.

Knowing full well that the dynamite was on the verge of exploding, he still insisted on sitting opposite her.

Zhou Xueli had also gained a new understanding of Jian Yuchen: despite his polished appearance, he was quite insufferable.

Zhou Xueli and Ning Yan exchanged a look and began making awkward small talk, ranging from the morning weather to the newly opened commercial center.

As it turned out, the other two had no intention of joining in at all.

Just as the conversation was about to run dry, a female voice suddenly came from the side. "Do you mind if I join you? Mr. Ning?"

Ning Yan looked up and saw it was Matthia from the marketing department. He intended to scoot over a seat, but she walked around the other side and sat directly next to Jian Yuchen. "We meet again, Simon. I didn't expect you to like this too. I discovered a restaurant last time where the fried eggs are simply divine. Shall I treat you to them sometime?"

Wen Ni sneered inwardly. It was just a mere fried egg; how good could it be? Could it be fried into a kaleidoscope of colors?

Wen Ni was still struggling to pull her leg away when Jian Yuchen suddenly released it.

The sound of a fork hitting the porcelain plate drew the attention of others. Wen Ni, having just steadied her leaning posture, gave a stiff smile to those around her, signaling that it was just her, nothing happened, everyone should just keep eating!

Her little outburst interrupted Matthia’s question.

The scene suddenly went quiet.

Ning Yan pondered his choice of words. "Wen Ni, clear your schedule for tomorrow afternoon. We’re going to Jinfeng."

Wen Ni nodded. "Okay."

Jokes aside, she still had to ask the client what exactly they were dissatisfied with regarding the design proposal; otherwise, the team members would have complaints, and repeated revisions were just a waste of time.

Seeing that Ning Yan had finished speaking, Matthia smiled slightly at Jian Yuchen. "Was I too presumptuous just now?"

A classic retreat-to-advance tactic.

"Not at all."

Matthia smiled shyly. "Actually, this is my first time asking someone out. By the way, Simon, I still have some questions about the previous proposals for Sheng Tang International. Can I come find you during the lunch break later? Or maybe we could exchange WeChat?"

Taking the initiative.

Wen Ni was happy to watch the show.

Jian Yuchen narrowed his eyes. "For the proposals, we can just discuss them together in a meeting. I don't like using WeChat."

Ha, what a hypocrite!

She didn't know who the idiot was that had been commenting on every single post she made since the day before yesterday.

Wen Ni’s phone vibrated on the table. Jian Yuchen’s gaze fell upon it, and he also saw the gossip-filled glow in the woman's eyes. It was clear she was chatting away with Zhou Xueli, who was sitting opposite Ning Yan.

Based on his basic understanding of his wife, Jian Yuchen felt that the protagonist of today’s conversation was undoubtedly himself.

And in fact, he was right.

[President's Wife's Chat Room (3)]

Li-a-Li: That bitch! This Matthia is something else. I’ll bet fifty cents that Jian Yuchen will be taken down by her within 5 days.

Wen-Bu-Ding: Get a life. There’s nothing worth betting on regarding this man’s private life.

Li-a-Li:! You’ve changed, my gossip partner. Hurry up and place your bet, we’re just waiting for you. Other departments have already started betting.

Wen-Bu-Ding: This has already spread? Why don't you guys go to the marketing department? With your level of reach, staying in the planning department is a waste of talent.

Li-a-Li: Stop talking nonsense. I’m waiting for Matthia to take him down so she can tell me how Jian Yuchen rates in bed! Is he as classy as he looks?

Wen Ni almost couldn't help but roll her eyes. What kind of "class" do you need in bed? Do you have to ask what flavor of condom he likes before getting into bed?!

Wen Ni didn't know what other women were like, but she liked things to be a bit unexpected.

But why on earth was she gossiping about her own husband’s performance in bed with another woman at a time like this!

Wen Ni was chatting away when a dialog box suddenly popped up. Without thinking, she sent the message intended for Zhou Xueli directly to the other person.

Wen-Bu-Ding: I bet 100 that Jian Yuchen is absolutely terrible in bed, just as rotten as his mouth.

As soon as she sent it, she met Jian Yuchen’s sinister gaze and his half-smiling expression. Especially when he revealed those sharp canines, she felt like a wild wolf had locked onto its prey and was about to pounce and bite her throat off in the next second.

Wen Ni felt bewildered, until her phone vibrated in her palm.

She glanced down.

Simon: Wash up and wait for me tonight.

?

???

No! How did that get sent to Jian Yuchen!

Of course, Wen Ni knew his vengeful nature, especially at certain times, when he seemed to take pleasure in tormenting her.

Of course, they were actually quite compatible, otherwise, they would have divorced long ago.

Wen Ni closed her eyes, feeling like she had been set up by Zhou Xueli.

"Excuse me, which one of you is Ms. Wen Ni?"

Wen Ni turned her head. A delivery guy was looking for her, holding a bunch of dewy, vibrant roses.

"Ms. Wen Ni, these are flowers bought for you by a Mr. Chen. Please sign for them."

Wen Ni gasped, looking at the flowers held out to her. Just as she was about to say she wouldn't accept them and ask him to tell that Mr. Chen, Matthia across from her cheered excitedly in a low voice, "Is it that Manager Chen from last time? Winnie, just take them! He’s so persistent."

Wen Ni met Jian Yuchen’s gaze and gave him a fierce glare. What are you looking at? It’s not like I sent flowers to Manager Chen.

"Winnie’s popularity is always high. Thanks to her, we don't have to buy flowers for the office," Ning Yan joked with a smile.

This Manager Chen was a client from three months ago who had fallen for Wen Ni at first sight. Over time, he had launched a passionate pursuit, sending flowers, afternoon tea, or waiting downstairs for Wen Ni to go watch a movie.

However, Wen Ni basically ignored him.

She personally disliked having private dealings with work clients.

"I can't sign for these flowers." Before Wen Ni could finish, the delivery guy quickly put the flowers down and ran off, fearing he wouldn't get his delivery fee.

"..." Wen Ni felt like she hadn't checked the almanac before going out today; nothing had gone smoothly since this morning.

"Winnie’s popularity is indeed high, but it’s better to keep work and private life separate," Jian Yuchen said slowly as he drank his coffee, his words carrying a hidden meaning.

Wen Ni looked at Matthia, who was clinging to his side. "I have always drawn a clear line, so you don't need to worry about it."

The other three at the table felt their eyelids twitch. Are they going to clash again?

chapters.title: Make Time to Watch a Movie with Me
chapters.content:
Jian Yuchen smiled half-heartedly. "That would be for the best. Otherwise, I’m really afraid our Lingdu will turn into a second-hand flower shop."

"You worry too much. I’m not so desperate that I’d eat grass by the nest."

Matthia: When the city gate catches fire, the fish in the moat suffer.

Ning Yan intervened at the right moment. "How about we finish eating before we discuss this?"

"I was just discussing company rules and regulations with Winnie, right?"

"Oh, so that’s what it was. Mr. Ning, it seems the company’s standard regulations need to be reformulated." After saying this, Wen Ni took a deep breath. "It’s so stuffy. I’m full, goodbye everyone."

"Since we’re all done, let’s go together." Jian Yuchen followed silently.

Every time these two clashed, their bodies were always very honest.

The people in the company were almost used to it, shaking their heads helplessly.

The elevator after lunch was always packed. Wen Ni had gotten in relatively early, but after being squeezed and pushed, she somehow ended up at the very back.

The air was filled with a mix of various perfumes and the rich aroma of coffee.

Coupled with the body odor radiating in the summer heat, Wen Ni held her breath, but the very next moment, she immediately inhaled a sharp, stifling breath.

The reason was none other than a pair of hands wandering up and down her buttocks, even giving her a firm squeeze.

Wen Ni turned her head fiercely, meeting Jian Yuchen’s gaze as he looked down at her.

What are you looking at? Being tall isn't that great.

Wen Ni wanted to move away from him, but unfortunately, there were already too many people in front, and she was shoved hard into Jian Yuchen.

The man maliciously bumped into her as well. Wen Ni gritted her teeth and slammed her high heel onto his leather shoe, grinding down with force.

"Hiss..." The man couldn't help but let out a soft hiss.

Matthia, who had been pushed away and couldn't get near Jian Yuchen, immediately cast a glance over.

Unfortunately, she could only see the man and Wen Ni pressed closely together, one in front of the other, but both of their expressions remained poker-faced, revealing nothing.

However, a woman’s sixth sense told her that things were, perhaps, not what they seemed.

Finally arriving at the Lingdu office floor, Wen Ni and her group walked out. The office was still quiet, with everyone resting. Wen Ni was accustomed to taking a nap in the afternoon, but today, perhaps because she was so infuriated by Jian Yuchen, the moment she opened her office door and stepped inside, she wanted to find her dartboard and pierce him through to vent her anger.

The man had already passed her door with Matthia.

When his gaze fell on her inside, Wen Ni was throwing darts.

Jian Yuchen glanced at the wall and walked past without a trace.

Before long, Wen Ni received a WeChat message from him.

"That photo was from how many years ago? Shall I give you a new one?"

"No need. Please refrain from workplace harassment during office hours!"

Wen Ni took a breath to calm herself, feeling that with each passing day, her resentment at work was fiercer than a vengeful spirit that had been dead for a thousand years.

In the afternoon, Wen Ni went to the marketing department. In the company’s internal WeChat group, Matthia was typing away furiously at her computer.

Wen Ni glanced at it and then stood behind her.

Matthia’s colleague coughed frantically to warn her. Perhaps she was too excited about what she was saying, as she didn't notice Wen Ni's presence at first.

"She definitely has something going on with President Ning, otherwise how could she give him attitude in public? When have you ever seen such an arrogant employee?"

"Just look at the way she walks; she must be good at technique in bed. Otherwise, how could she climb to the position of director at such a young age?"

Matthia had been talking for a long time without a reply from the other side, and only then did she realize something was wrong. She turned her head abruptly and saw Wen Ni’s slightly world-weary face.

Wen Ni was not a traditional "first-glance" beauty, but there is such a thing in this world as an "atmospheric beauty."

She belonged to that category.

Each of her features, when taken apart, wasn't particularly stunning, but when put together, there was a certain vibe that made people unable to help but shift their gaze toward her.

At this moment, amidst Matthia’s awkward smile, she rolled her eyes slightly and said slowly, "Thank you for the compliment on my physique. Also, there is no need to project your own rich sexual experience onto me."

Instantly, everyone in the office buried their heads toward their chests, wishing they could cease to exist.

Afterward, Wen Ni didn't wait for Matthia to apologize; she turned and walked away.

Matthia realized what had happened and chased after her, "Sister Winnie, I really just spoke without thinking, please don't be angry..."

Wen Ni ignored her entirely.

Less than an hour later, Zhou Xueli reached out to her as expected.

Li Ya Li: Heard you made Matthia cry by scolding her?

Wen Buding: Oh? Is that the version of the story now? As expected, I will always firmly occupy the role of the vicious female supporting character.

Li Ya Li: Don't worry, Matthia was dragged off for a talk by her department head. She’ll probably get a warning and then have to send you an apology letter.

Wen Buding: What use is that to me?

In the workplace, whenever a woman holds an important position and has even a hint of attractiveness, people assume it must involve a physical transaction.

She was well aware of how others discussed her and Ning Yan behind her back; it was just that today she happened to run into it herself.

Was she supposed to go and have a row with everyone? She would be better off thinking about how to crack the tough nut that was Jinfeng and secure a hefty year-end bonus.

What can relieve worries? Only making money.

Before leaving work in the afternoon, Wen Ni did indeed receive an email from the company, which criticized certain colleagues for slacking off and spreading rumors. Wen Ni didn't even finish reading it before closing it; she figured the whole company would receive Matthia’s apology letter shortly.

Ning Yan asked Wen Ni to come to his office before leaving.

Wen Ni pushed the door open right on time at 5:00 PM, but what she saw was not Ning Yan, but Jian Yuchen.

"Why are you here?" Ning Yan wasn't there, so Wen Ni didn't stand on ceremony with him.

Jian Yuchen was sitting in the chair opposite Ning Yan’s desk. Upon hearing this, he put down the magazine in his hand, "Ning Yan asked me to come. Did he call you too?"

"That’s an obvious answer." She found a seat nearby.

"I looked into Jinfeng. It seems Shangmei Advertising intercepted the deal. Their boss’s wife is the sister-in-law of the third young master of the Jinfeng Group. With that nepotistic connection, that is the ultimate reason why the proposal didn't pass."

Wen Ni knew it. Everything had been going so smoothly in the early stages, designed exactly according to the other party's requirements; how could they have flipped the table right before signing?

"However, it’s not without a turning point. I heard there is another decision-maker. Ning Yan and I plan to take them out to dinner tonight. Are you coming with us, or are you going home to eat and wait for me?"

The topic suddenly shifted from the workplace back to the family. Wen Ni naturally chose to go along, so she could see if there was any room for maneuver.

After all, she had been working day and night for this project for over half a year. For Shangmei to suddenly snatch the cake away—Wen Ni couldn't swallow this.

"One more thing."

Wen Ni said seriously, "Go ahead."

Jian Yuchen tapped his fingers on the desk, "I want to take you to a movie tomorrow night. Can you squeeze out three hours?"

Wen Ni thought he was going to say something else, "We'll see tomorrow. What are we watching?"

"I don't know, whatever." As long as it was with her; the two of them hadn't been on a date alone for nearly half a year.

The last movie was actually the New Year's film from the year before last.

chapters.title: Things Like First Boyfriends.
chapters.content:
"Whatever" wasn't an act of indifference; it was because both of them were so busy that they had no idea what movies were currently playing. Every time, they would just head to the cinema and randomly choose the one with the closest showtime.

Whether it was good or not was purely up to luck. If they encountered a bad commercial film, they could only blame their own bad luck.

When Ning Yan entered the room, he had apparently received some new information and waved his hands hurriedly, "I’ve set the appointment. It's at Mingding, Private Room No. 3. Wen Ni, go and bring the design proposal."

"See you in the underground parking lot in a bit."

Wen Ni wanted to ask why he was in such a rush, but fortunately, the design files for Jinfeng were always on her computer, so she wouldn't be caught off guard.

She returned to her office to grab her bag and computer. When she went downstairs, Ning Yan was already waiting at the intersection in his car.

Wen Ni got into the car, and Ning Yan said, "This decision-maker just returned to the country today. I managed to intercept him with the information I got. If we seal the deal tonight, we can still crack the Jinfeng project."

Wen Ni handed her bag to Jian Yuchen, and the man took it and placed it aside smoothly.

Ning Yan watched their interaction through the rearview mirror and frowned. He felt like something wasn't quite right.

Forget it, he was probably overthinking.

Streetlights flashed past their eyes with the flow of traffic, creating long lines.

Inside the car, none of their phones stopped ringing. While Ning Yan was ordering food with the restaurant, he was also briefing Jian Yuchen and Wen Ni on the background of this decision-maker.

Negotiating business wasn't Wen Ni’s strong suit. Usually, Ning Yan handled the company’s business, and later, after Jian Yuchen joined, the two of them worked as a team, becoming the two "faces" of Lingdu.

Wen Ni only needed to catch the dew beneath the flowers and snag a year-end bonus.

When they arrived at Mingding, Ning Yan checked the time, "Good thing we aren't late. Let’s head to the private room."

Wen Ni walked in front. Ning Yan glanced at her back, then looked at the bag in Jian Yuchen’s hand...

"You two are getting along well today."

He emphasized the word "today."

After all, if word got out that Jian Yuchen was carrying Wen Ni’s bag, no one in the company would believe it.

Carrying a woman’s handbag, Jian Yuchen didn't feel embarrassed at all, "It’s just a convenience. You can just consider it me being a gentleman."

Ning Yan smiled without a word. If you, kid, could just stop getting red-faced and shouting every time you see her?

The place Ning Yan chose was undoubtedly excellent in both taste and decor.

Wen Ni didn't like the socializing involved in business, so she rarely attended such occasions. Ning Yan usually didn't make her come, which was why she had stayed at this company for so long.

It wasn't just the prospects of Lingdu; it was also because Ning Yan was a good boss. Furthermore, the two of them were university seniors and juniors. With that relationship, Wen Ni felt that as long as Ning Yan didn't drive the wrong car and bankrupt the company, she could work here for a lifetime.

The private room was for ten people. Jian Yuchen sat on Wen Ni’s left and hung her bag on the back of the chair.

The married couple didn't need to notify each other that they wouldn't be home for dinner; they could just freeload off Ning Yan, the "big spender."

However, Wen Ni never expected that the big client Ning Yan was so eager to meet would be a familiar stranger: her first boyfriend, Shen Huaixu.

Clearly, Shen Huaixu was also momentarily surprised when he entered the room and saw Wen Ni.

"President Shen." Ning Yan stood up and smiled to shake hands with Shen Huaixu.

"President Ning, you’ve gone to great expense tonight."

"Not at all, please, have a seat."

Shen Huaixu looked around the seats and then decisively walked to Wen Ni’s right side.

"Do you mind if I sit here?"

Wen Ni’s scalp tingled. The sudden appearance of a first love from one's reckless and naive youth was truly quite a shock.

"It's fine."

After all, the situation had reversed; the other party was now her "Client Daddy," and she still had a proposal she needed him to approve. Could she really say it was inconvenient?

Shen Huaixu brought an assistant and a secretary, and the small room was filled to capacity.

Ning Yan began to introduce, "Our company’s star design director, Wen Ni. Her designs are widely acclaimed."

"I know." After Shen Huaixu finished speaking, he explained to everyone, "Wen Ni was my high school classmate. We haven't seen each other for so many years, and I truly didn't know she would be here today."

Ning Yan was pleasantly surprised. "What a coincidence, she was my junior in college. It seems it’s fate for our Wen Ni to follow this path; everywhere she goes, she runs into classmates."

Wen Ni secretly rolled her eyes at Ning Yan for making awkward small talk, but she had to say a few polite words at this moment.

"Long time no see," Shen Huaixu spoke first.

"Yes, it has been."

The woman's voice was clear and sweet; it didn't seem to have changed after all these years.

She had only shed the appearance of a young girl, becoming more mature and graceful.

Shen Huaixu felt a sudden wave of emotion, but he was no longer the naive boy he once was. Especially when he saw Jian Yuchen sitting to the side, the man’s eyes narrowed.

"I didn't expect Brother Jian to be here too."

"It seems the world is indeed very small," Jian Yuchen smiled and raised his glass.

Shen Huaixu swirled the wine in his glass. The two men clinked glasses in the air, and for some reason, there was an unspoken, smoke-filled illusion of tension.

"Are you two classmates as well?"

"Yes, from high school. But Brother Jian was a legendary figure in school back then." Perhaps because they were touching on the past, the topic was simpler than the upcoming Jinfeng design project, so Shen Huaixu spoke with ease, without needing to be so cautious.

Ning Yan was stunned. Didn't that mean Jian Yuchen and Wen Ni went to the same school too?

How come he had never heard either of them mention it?

However, this wasn't the right occasion to bring it up.

"Is Brother Jian at Lingdu now?" Shen Huaixu asked.

Jian Yuchen didn't hide it. "You could say that."

Although he had other companies, there was no need to explain it clearly to Shen Huaixu.

The man realized, "It really is a coincidence."

"The food is here. Let's eat and chat. I heard President Shen likes seafood, and seafood is the specialty here at Mingding," Ning Yan greeted them warmly.

Shen Huaixu smiled and said, "I've long heard of President Ning's hospitality, and today I've finally experienced it."

Wen Ni’s head was buzzing. She felt that the scene of her current husband and her first love sandwiching her was a bit stimulating.

However, when it came to business, it wasn't her place to speak, so Wen Ni just focused on eating.

"This yellow croaker is fresh; you should try it."

Just as Shen Huaixu finished speaking, his chopsticks landed in her bowl.

At the same time, Jian Yuchen's chopsticks also appeared in her field of vision.

The two men locked eyes. The awkward atmosphere prompted everyone else at the table to look at the three of them.

Wen Ni picked up her bowl, calmly accepted the two pieces of fish, and thanked them with a normal expression: "Thank you."

But as composed as she was on the surface, she was screaming internally!

Do I not have chopsticks? Why make it so awkward!?

chapters.title: Don't Tickle Me
chapters.content:
Shen Huaixu smiled, and Ning Yan steered the conversation toward the Jinfeng design project.

The people Shen Huaixu brought were naturally his trusted aides.

So, he pondered for a moment and said, "Regarding the Jinfeng design project, the company is actually still deliberating internally."

Wen Ni, who had been burying her head in her food, finally perked up, wanting to hear what the problem was.

"There are many design teams participating in the bidding now, and with the board of directors making new decisions, all the proposals were overturned and sent back for revision. That is the reason the design drafts were rejected."

When Ning Yan heard this, he realized there was still a chance.

"So, President Shen, that means our Lingdu still has a chance to participate in this design project, right?"

Shen Huaixu laughed. "Of course. Lingdu is a well-known design firm in the industry, and you've had excellent design works in recent years. I know all of this."

Wen Ni was listening intently when suddenly her finger was hooked. She thought she had bumped into someone and pulled her hand back, but the finger wrapped around hers again.

Wen Ni turned her head and met Jian Yuchen’s eyes, which had lost their smile.

?

What? Want to fight?

Let's fight at home.

"Wen Ni's designs have a style of their own. I've been following them for years, and they are actually very suitable for Jinfeng. However, the approval of a design proposal still requires the leadership's consent. I think Lingdu can go for an on-site inspection. As it happens, next week we will be inviting well-known design firms in the industry, if Lingdu is still interested."

"Of course!"

With a project as big as Jinfeng, Lingdu had already invested so much manpower and resources; giving up now was not Ning Yan's style.

He had fought step by step to reach his current status, and the ability to bend and stretch was already carved into his bones.

As long as the official seal hadn't been stamped for another company on the Jinfeng project, he had to fight for it.

Shen Huaixu had shared such a big piece of news today without outright rejecting Lingdu, and Ning Yan was grateful from the bottom of his heart. He stood up to toast him.

Wen Ni didn't want her design project to go down the drain and let her team's hard work go to waste, so she also stood up to toast.

Perhaps because they had common topics, Ning Yan and Shen Huaixu chatted quite enthusiastically.

Wen Ni didn't have a high tolerance for alcohol. After five or six glasses, she was already half-drunk.

Just as Shen Huaixu was about to pour her another glass, a hand gently covered Wen Ni's wine glass.

Shen Huaixu looked up. Jian Yuchen smiled faintly. "President Shen, our Design Director Wen has a low tolerance. If she keeps drinking, it won't be very convenient for her to get home."

Shen Huaixu raised an eyebrow. "That's true. It was my oversight. It's getting late, and if there is any new news, my assistant will contact President Ning."

Ning Yan saw that it was indeed nearly 10 o'clock, which was about right; they had talked through everything they could.

He knew the principle of knowing when to stop.

"Thank you again, President Shen, for today. Let's head down together; I'll call a designated driver."

Jian Yuchen had also drunk quite a bit, but his tolerance was unreadable, unlike Wen Ni, whose face was already flushed.

Everyone stood up to leave. When Ning Yan turned back to call for them to follow, he saw Jian Yuchen and Shen Huaixu both reaching out to support the half-drunk Wen Ni, one on each side.

?

Jian Yuchen didn't wait for Shen Huaixu to react; he pulled her from his side to his front. "Director Wen lives in the same residential complex as I do. I will ensure she gets home safely, so there's no need to trouble President Shen."

Shen Huaixu watched them leaning against each other, with Wen Ni showing no resistance, and narrowed his eyes. "That may be so, but it's not reassuring for a man and a woman to be alone. I can have my secretary send you both back. Besides, Director Wen is a young woman; it's not good if she goes home drunk with no one to take care of her."

"Who says I have no one to take care of me!" Wen Ni suddenly stood up straight and patted her chest. "I have a roommate."

Facing Wen Ni, Shen Huaixu wasn't as sarcastic. Hearing "roommate," he assumed it was a girl, so the man didn't insist.

The group walked out of the private room, and Jian Yuchen practically carried Wen Ni out in his arms.

"Don't tickle me," Jian Yuchen warned, lowering his head.

When Wen Ni was drunk, her hands wouldn't stay still; she loved to grab or scratch at something.

Wen Ni pouted, feeling a bit unhappy. *Stingy, what's the harm in letting someone tickle you a bit?*

When he was in the mood, he would hold her tight all night, and did she ever complain?

Wen Ni wasn't as temperamental as usual while being difficult. Seeing the others ahead, Jian Yuchen lowered his head and warned, "I'll deal with you when we get home."

By the time Ning Yan paid the bill and waited for the designated driver at the entrance, Shen Huaixu's driver had already brought the car around.

Shen Huaixu looked leisurely at Wen Ni and Jian Yuchen, who were stuck together.

"Here is my business card. If there are any updates on the design project or if you have any questions, feel free to contact me."

This was practically opening the door wide for them.

Ning Yan took it for Wen Ni. After happily seeing Shen Huaixu off, Ning Yan breathed a sigh of relief. "This President Shen is actually quite easy to talk to, not as unapproachable as the rumors say."

The information he had revealed tonight was more than enough.

Jian Yuchen gave him a cold look.

Ning Yan felt a shiver run down his spine.

As a good friend, Ning Yan knew this guy's temper all too well.

Especially when he stared at someone like that, that person was sure to be in for a rough time.

When Jian Yuchen suddenly said he wanted to be a partner in his design firm, Ning Yan had no objections, but he had always been behind the scenes until he finally came to the company this year. However, Ning Yan knew this guy had other companies in the background.

With Jian Yuchen, Lingdu had developed rapidly, but to the outside world, it was all Ning Yan's credit.

Seeing his expression, Ning Yan wondered if he had said something wrong tonight.

However, as soon as the designated driver arrived, Jian Yuchen took Ning Yan's car keys, tossed them to the driver, picked Wen Ni up horizontally, and stuffed her into the backseat. He got in after her, his movements as smooth as if they had been rehearsed countless times.

Just as Ning Yan was about to get in, Jian Yuchen rolled down the window. "Take a taxi yourself. Your car is mine for the night."

Ning Yan: ???

*Wait, brother, what exactly did I do? Can you give me a straight answer?*

However, Ning Yan could only watch as his car left him behind in a cloud of exhaust, speeding away.

Inside the car, Jian Yuchen mentioned the address of the residential complex before pinching Wen Ni's face. "Is it that good? You drank everything they toasted you with?"

Wen Ni wanted to sleep, but he kept pinching her face. She turned her head away, unhappy. "Stop pulling me."

"Heh." The man let out a short, cold laugh.

When they arrived at the complex, Wen Ni was already asleep. Jian Yuchen had the driver park in his own spot before carrying her upstairs.

Wen Ni suddenly did a face-plant and almost threw up.

She kicked the man twice. "Jian Yuchen, do you want to die!"

"Yeah, I want to die on you."

chapters.title: The Delicate One
chapters.content:
The man, expressionless, carried her with one hand and held her two bags with the other. Entering the elevator, he couldn't help but frown. "Did you put explosives in your bag? It's so heavy."

It was just a small chain bag. No wonder she was always complaining that things were heavy; he wondered what on earth she had stuffed in there.

Wen Ni sat up from his shoulder. "Heh, you're not even 30 yet and you're already failing."

Facts proved that no matter how old a man was, if you told him he was "failing," he would find a way to jump up and prove you wrong.

Jian Yuchen gave her a familiar, chilling smile. He would let her know later whether he was "failing" or not.

The man opened the electronic lock and went straight to the master bedroom as soon as they got home, throwing Wen Ni onto the bed.

When they were newlyweds, they had chosen a mattress that was ruined within three months. This was a smart bed they had just replaced last year, and the comfort level was matched to both of their body requirements.

Wen Ni liked it softer, while Jian Yuchen liked it firmer.

So, as soon as she landed on the bed, Wen Ni felt as if all the bones in her body were about to be snapped in three.

Jian Yuchen tossed her bag aside, loosened his tie, and was about to lift her skirt.

Men's savagery in certain matters is no different from that of primitive savages before evolution.

The desire to carry any woman they like into a cave remains unchanged.

Just as Jian Yuchen was about to bend down, the woman's foot pressed against his chest.

"What are you doing? Trying to stall for time with some fun? Too late!"

He was holding back a lot of anger.

She had been smiling so happily at Shen Huaixu all night.

It seems Shen Huaixu is unwilling to relinquish the golden label of "first love boyfriend," and she doesn't want to let anyone else take it off either.

"I haven't removed my makeup yet!" the woman's sweet yet slightly domineering voice rang out.

She propped herself up, her shirt billowing out. Jian Yuchen's eyes darkened. "Remove your makeup?"

Sometimes Wen Ni was so lazy she needed him to feed her, especially on weekends when she absolutely wouldn't move until 1:30 PM.

She was like a spineless, limp snake in bed.

If you asked her to do anything at that moment, she'd practically kill him on the spot, letting Jian Yuchen know that a woman's morning grumpiness was as devastating as Thanos snapping his fingers.

So, in the years since Jian Yuchen married her, he'd not only learned to distinguish the purpose and occasion of each type of stocking, but also accurately differentiate between cleansing oil, cleansing balm, and cleansing water.

He even knew women's lipstick shades, what cushion foundation, powder foundation, and pressed powder were.

If he weren't an investor, he could probably make some money in the beauty industry to support this heartless, ungrateful woman at home.

"No, I can't leave without removing my makeup and showering!" Wen Ni insisted.

And this was already a prelude to her temper tantrum.

Jian Yuchen was patient with this kind of thing; a little extra effort wouldn't hurt. He simply scooped her up, placed her on the bathroom sink, filled the bathtub, and then expertly picked up a makeup remover pad to wipe her face.

Wen Ni was a completely different person at work and after work.

At work, she was professional, focused, and attentive.

After work, she was lazy, listless, and completely wasting her time.

Now, nestled in Jian Yuchen's arms, her face resting on his palm, she lazily instructed, "Make sure you remove your eyelashes and eyeliner completely. Otherwise, it won't look good!"

Jian Yuchen pinched her cheeks, as if he wanted to bite off a piece of her flesh.

"You certainly know how to order people around," Jian Yuchen gritted his teeth, his tone fierce, but his movements were very gentle.

Wen Ni closed her eyes. "Gently place the makeup remover pad over your eyelids, okay? Don't rub them, it'll make fine lines and wrinkles look terrible."

"You're quite demanding, Director Wen. Why aren't you so gentle at the company? Why don't you ever act cute with me?"

Wen Ni, her eyes covered by the makeup remover pad, scoffed. "With your awful behavior, who would want to act cute with you?"

Jian Yuchen was speechless. He shouldn't have been so nice to this woman.

He angrily grabbed the makeup remover pad and smeared the foundation off her face.

"Ouch, be gentle!" Wen Ni didn't think she'd said anything wrong.

Acting cute at the company? Was she afraid people wouldn't know what their relationship was?

Besides, he could reject nine out of ten of her proposals. Act cute? She felt like twisting his head off.

See? He took revenge just for calling him a jerk!

A petty man is the worst. Jian Yuchen said expressionlessly, "When have you ever told me to be gentle when I meant it?"

Wen Ni blushed. "Times change. Is being gentle in bed the same as being gentle while washing my face? If you damage my skin's protective barrier, I'll have to use your credit card for cosmetic surgery."

"Don't you always want me to call you the most beautiful woman on Jianshe South Road? Aren't you beautiful enough?"

Seeing him soften his movements, Wen Ni gave a delicate yawn, then continued to boss him around, "The face wash needs to be lathered before applying it. Don't spill it on my clothes."

Jian Yuchen squeezed between her legs. "You're such a delicate thing."

Always demanding.

Finally, after removing her makeup, Wen Ni hadn't even reacted before her skirt had fallen to the floor.

The man quickly undressed them both and got into the bathtub, picked up the rose essential oil that was placed beside him, and carefully massaged her shoulders and neck.

It's rare to see a man with such an elaborate ritual before eating meat, but Jian Yuchen likes to thoroughly pound the meat until it's firm and chewy before indulging.

The little lamb to the slaughter, oblivious, her face flushed from the aroma, leaned against him. "I want honey water later."

"Warm it, with two extra spoonfuls of honey."

"Aren't you afraid it'll be too sweet?"

"I like it sweet."

Jian Yuchen glanced at her. She's sweeter than him! When she's being affectionate, she's like a honey pot, but when she gets angry, she's a powder keg.

However, she only occasionally drinks honey water after having alcohol, and Wen Ni cherishes these days when she can indulge in sweets without restraint.

The man's hands, warm from the essential oil, massaged her neck with just the right amount of pressure.

Wen Ni almost fell asleep from the comfort.

Only when the rich, creamy foam drifted to an inappropriate place did Wen Ni blush and say, "I'm not finished washing yet."

Jian Yuchen pulled her into his arms. "Are you happy today?"

Wen Ni thought for a moment. "It'll have to do."

What was there to be happy about? She'd be irritated at work all day, had to go out for business dinners in the evening, and came home to another mundane day. Another day gone.

"Ouch!" Wen Ni glared at him, quickly sliding away from him. "I'm not finished soaking."

She'd brought back bath oil balls from her trip; she wanted to soak until she was comfortable before going back to bed.

Besides, he was always so persistent; Wen Ni didn't want to rush into her execution and get whipped.

The woman's soft hair swayed in the water. Jian Yuchen stretched out his arms on either side of the bathtub, staring at her with a wicked grin, as if she were a clean, ready meal waiting to lie obediently beneath him.

Wen Ni stretched her foot out in front of him, her toes, painted with nail polish, peeking out from the foam. "Squeeze it."

It hurt a little after wearing it all day.

Jian Yuchen was always in a good mood before things got serious. He grabbed her ankle with his large hand, pulled her close, and bit her instep. "I've agreed to so many of your requests, so you'll have to agree to mine later. You're not jealous, are you?"

chapters.title: You’re Not Jealous, Are You?
chapters.content:
Wen Ni looked up and knew what kind of request the man was about to make.

"Aren't you afraid of aging prematurely?"

"I hope you're a good man."

"Let's get this straight, if you want me to be a widow after 35, you'd better be kind and let me go sooner."

Jian Yuchen glanced at her sideways. Wen Ni hadn't realized the seriousness of the situation. "Why are you looking at me like that? You know why we got married in the first place."

"It wasn't because we were in love..." Wen Ni's voice trailed off.

Because the water was gradually flowing towards her.

The man jumped up, splashing water all over Wen Ni's face. Especially when she saw Jian Yuchen face-to-face with her, with the little version of him standing at attention too, Wen Ni almost jumped up.

The showerhead was turned on, pouring water directly over Wen Ni's head.

"Ah!" She sobered up considerably and immediately jumped up, ready to strangle Jian Yuchen.

The man ignored her throes, rinsed the soap off her, and then pulled her out, his large hand around her waist.

"Don't slip on the bathroom floor!"

"What do you mean 'don't'? You've already started planning to cheat on me while I'm taking a shower. Don't you think you deserve a beating?"

The bathroom was steamy, and two blurry figures overlapped.

The showerhead hit the floor, splashing water from the bathtub like waves.

The sensor-activated toilet kept opening and closing because of the movement of the figures.

Wen Ni's face flushed red; she felt like she couldn't breathe.

In the hazy, confused state of mind, her first thought was, "Thank goodness Jian Yuchen did a decent job with the drainage during the renovation..."

Otherwise, the bedroom would have been flooded.

...

Afterwards, in the clarity that comes after, Jian Yuchen spaced out for a while before finally clearing his head and opening the refrigerator to see what snacks were available.

Wen Ni was slumped on the large bed, her hair already dry without her noticing. All she could hear was the sound of his slippers.

"I want boneless chicken feet with lemon."

"That's iced."

"I don't care, give me some beer too."

"Not planning on going to work tomorrow?" Although Jian Yuchen said that, he still got it for Wen Ni.

She usually stocked up on snacks at home, sometimes letting them expire and then having to throw them away.

Jian Yuchen knew her hamster-like habits inside and out.

Wen Ni rolled around on the bed a couple of times before saying, "I still have half a month of annual leave left, ask for half a day off for me tomorrow."

Anyway, Ning Yan said he was going to the Jin Feng headquarters in the afternoon.

Jian Yuchen opened two bottles of wine, and Wen Ni, already wearing a loose shirt, floated out.

The hem of her shirt just covered her private area. The wine rolled down his Adam's apple; he licked his back teeth, pulled Wen Ni closer, and fed her a mouthful of wine.

Wen Ni choked, punching his shoulder. "Who wants you to feed me? Disgusting."

"Haven't you eaten enough?"

She's disgusted now, even after kissing for years.

Wen Ni put on disposable gloves, kicked Jian Yuchen, and said, "Turn on the projector, let's choose a movie."

"What do you want to watch?"

Wen Ni quickly curled up beside him with a small plate. "Um, you choose, anything's fine."

Jian Yuchen picked up the remote, pressing buttons until he saw the words "First Love," then silently pressed the button.

Wen Ni's head swayed back and forth, a few wispy strands peeking out playfully as she ate, seemingly beckoning to Jian Yuchen, just like their owner, always ready to pounce.

The movie wasn't from recent years; the picture quality was decent, and Wen Ni watched it alright.

The distinctive fermented smell of beer mingled with the aroma of chicken feet. Jian Yuchen turned to look at her.

The scene was showing the male and female leads' first confession.

It began with the girl's first flutter of the heart.

It was destined to be a bittersweet and unforgettable experience.

Jian Yuchen thought of Shen Huaixu in high school…

Hmm, quite similar to the male lead.

On the basketball team, good at studying, liked wearing white T-shirts, had a sunny smile…

Clearly a girl's type.

Jian Yuchen thought the beer tasted strange today, like it was expired.

"Hahahaha." Wen Ni laughed heartily while scrolling through Douyin on her phone, not paying any attention to the movie. "Are you going to look or not?" the man asked.

Wen Ni turned her head. "I've already seen the movie you picked. This part is the most boring; I can follow the plot just fine while scrolling through my phone!"

"Is that so? Then what do you think of... them?"

Wen Ni thought for a moment. "Hmm, they definitely won't end up together. Movies are just beautified fantasies. Look, the guy is going abroad, the girl is staying in the country. And given how boy-crazy the female lead is, she'd barely pass at a regular university. You never see her studying. They aren't even on the same page!"

"..."

Jian Yuchen: Why on earth am I discussing this kind of teen campus movie with this woman?

Was I expecting her to spout something like, "The most stunning glimpse of life is in one's youth"?

Jian Yuchen fell silent, but Wen Ni seemed to have opened the floodgates. "Hey, why did you pick this one? I remember the ratings weren't that high. The director was too obsessed with the melancholy of youthful art films."

Jian Yuchen rested his head on his hand, leaning against the sofa, and Wen Ni took the opportunity to lean her whole body against his sturdy thighs.

Seeing he didn't respond, both of them fell quiet.

The air conditioning was running strong, and Wen Ni huddled closer to him. "Give me the blanket."

"No. Freeze."

Wen Ni turned her head, stood up abruptly, and Jian Yuchen asked, "What are you doing?"

Wen Ni wasn't doing anything in particular; she just put down the chicken feet and blocked the screen.

Jian Yuchen’s eyelids twitched. The light from behind highlighted the woman's body contours.

She wasn't wearing anything underneath.

Through the summer shirt, she looked even more alluring.

Wen Ni saw his immediate reaction, whistled, and lifted her hem to sit on his lap.

"You don't want to sleep tonight, do you?" The man patted her slender waist.

Wen Ni swayed her waist. "Who told you to ignore me?"

Jian Yuchen deliberately avoided looking at her. "When did I ignore you? I took off your makeup when you asked, and didn't I get you the chicken feet?"

Wen Ni cupped his face. "Are you... jealous?"

Jian Yuchen looked at her wickedly. "Bullshit."

Wen Ni felt a bit smug. "Tsk, you're a grown man, still playing these games. Shen Huaixu and I haven't seen each other in how many years? And you're still jealous of that."

"I was only with him for three months in total. Three months, big brother! I don't even have his contact information."

Jian Yuchen sneered, "No contact info, yet you were flirting with him all night?"

"Can you be reasonable? When I was with Shen Huaixu, weren't you with Fang Hui?"

Perhaps because their first loves had been brought up, Jian Yuchen was willing to be reasonable and calm. "Fang Hui and I..."

Wen Ni raised an eyebrow, waiting for him to continue.

Jian Yuchen thought for a moment and shut his mouth. "Never mind."

"Ugh, you're such a tease, starting gossip and leaving it half-finished. Be careful, or your future son won't have..."

His mouth was immediately blocked by the man.

"What, your son isn't my son? Who are you cursing?"

Wen Ni slapped his hand away. "What about you and Fang Hui? That’s ancient history from before we were married. It’s pointless to dig that up now."

chapters.title: Jian Yuchen, the Mushroom Picker
chapters.content:
Perhaps because he hadn't heard the name Fang Hui in many years, Jian Yuchen was dazed for a moment.

"Why did you suddenly mention her?"

Wen Ni snorted. "Look at you! Only the magistrate is allowed to set fires, while the commoners aren't allowed to light lamps! You're a hypocrite."

"Fang Hui didn't appear at our dinner party."

"That's because she went abroad."

Jian Yuchen raised an eyebrow. "How do you know?"

Wen Ni shifted her gaze. "You can see it on social media."

The man held her, lifting her chin. "You’ve been stalking her, haven't you?"

Wen Ni clicked her tongue. "I just take a look every now and then."

Jian Yuchen took a sip of wine. "I didn't even know she went abroad. Aren't you wronging me?"

"Well, I didn't know Shen Huaixu was back either. We haven't been in touch for years." Wen Ni tilted her head back; at this moment, she was like a victorious little hen, head held high in provocation.

Jian Yuchen flicked her chest. "Don't try to change the subject. We're talking about Shen Huaixu. Don't tell me you didn't see what he was implying tonight."

Wen Ni shrugged. "You know me, I don't eat grass I've already grazed, especially since he might become my client."

That was true. When she said she was breaking up, it was always after careful consideration, with no room for change.

"How did you and Shen Huaixu break up back then?"

Wen Ni took a sip of wine and yawned. "Can I not answer that? I forgot a long time ago."

"Liar." Jian Yuchen didn't believe her, but Wen Ni refused to answer no matter what.

She finished the can of wine, and she was already drowsy.

"Hey, when did we first meet?"

"Speech competition, traffic safety."

"Oh, right, right, right. Your class monitor and our homeroom teacher even drew lots to see who would go first."

Perhaps because they were talking about that time, Wen Ni found it funny. "Hey, why did you look at me like I was an eyesore back then? I never offended you."

Jian Yuchen looked at the screen, his facial features obscured by the movie's lighting.

"Never offended me? Think carefully."

Wen Ni shook her head. "That was the first time I saw you, and you didn't even give me a pleasant look. Don't tell me you were jealous because I spoke better than you."

"A reminder: we both got first prize."

Wen Ni shook her head. "Really?"

Jian Yuchen didn't continue the topic with this drunkard.

After three more cans, Wen Ni let out a hiccup. The man saw it was about time. "Let's go back to the room."

"I'm not going back!" Wen Ni squatted on the floor, hugging her knees.

Jian Yuchen squatted down and stared at her. "What kind of trouble are you making now?"

Wen Ni looked at him and beckoned with her finger. "Come here, I'll tell you a little secret."

You don't have a secret in your entire body.

Though he thought that, Jian Yuchen still leaned in.

As a result, he saw Wen Ni move both hands to the top of her head and slowly open them.

?

"Are you messing with me?" Jian Yuchen gritted his teeth.

Wen Ni shook her head. "I am a little mushroom."

"..."

Jian Yuchen didn't want to waste any more time; picking the mushroom was more important.

He hoisted Wen Ni up in one go.

"No, no! If you pick me, you'll make soup out of me! I'll die!"

Wen Ni grabbed the corner of the sofa, resisting fiercely.

"Mushrooms are meant for soup. If you don't like it, you can be an enoki mushroom." Jian Yuchen leaned down and carried her horizontally toward the bedroom.

Wen Ni started thrashing. "I don't want to be an enoki mushroom, I'm a King Oyster Mushroom!"

As she spoke, her voice grew smaller, tinged with a cry. "The big bad wolf who picks mushrooms~ *hiccup*..."

Jian Yuchen: "..."

"If you keep singing, I'm going to record it."

A ready-made piece of leverage—he wouldn't be a fool not to use it.

"How dare you! I, the Emperor, shall execute you and your nine generations!"

Jian Yuchen narrowed his eyes, his white teeth catching his tongue. "You're still listed as my spouse, Your Majesty. Don't forget to include yourself in that execution."

Wen Ni was furious, but her clothes were stripped off in an instant.

"Why are you taking off my clothes!"

"What mushroom doesn't get washed before being made into soup?"

"My family only uses dried mushrooms! Not fresh ones!"

"Well, aren't I a dried mushroom?"

???

Something seemed off, but she couldn't quite put her finger on it.

Jian Shifu, who had been busy all night, painstakingly cooked a pot of tender mushroom soup.

When the sky was just beginning to brighten, he got up to clean up the mess in the living room.

Wen Ni was sleeping soundly in the covers.

Jian Yuchen tucked the sheet around her and kissed her forehead.

She twisted away as if in disgust, but the man pulled her back and gave her a hard kiss before letting her go.

The living room was a mess. Jian Yuchen squatted down and cleared the trash into the bin.

Wen Ni's phone was stuck in the sofa crevice. He picked it up and noticed a text message.

[I've added you as a friend, remember to accept.]

?

Jian Yuchen remained expressionless and naturally swiped into WeChat.

Sure enough, he found a request in the "Add Friend" section.

Shen Huaixu.

The man didn't even look at it; he blocked and deleted it in one go, then shoved the phone back into his pocket.

The mushroom was already in his pot; he wanted to take the whole basin too?

In his dreams.

The movie had long finished and started playing again automatically.

The male and female leads were like two parallel lines, one upstairs, one downstairs.

Their gazes occasionally crossed when passing the staircase.

That might have been the only eye contact in a whole day.

But it was enough to make one's heart flutter.

Jian Yuchen finished the remaining wine and stared blankly at the screen.

Tonight was never enough; it seemed the more he watched her cry and beg, the emptier he felt inside.

Was the first meeting really the speech competition?

Not at all.

It was clearly the time she was late in the morning, and he noted down her class and name, only for her to glare at him fiercely.

Wen Ni back then was lively and quirky.

She had short hair, and when she walked, the tips of her hair would bounce.

She often wore pants under her school skirt.

She would sneak over to their class during PE to watch the boys play basketball.

Her grades fluctuated.

It made him check her ranking first every time, then look for his own.

This girl seemed like nothing could knock her down; she was always full of energy.

However, Jian Yuchen would never forget the first time she cried in front of him—it was because of Shen Huaixu.

She cried until her nose was running.

Not cute at all.

Squatting under the flower bed, she didn't even dodge the splashing rain.

She just sat there crying, so useless.

He still remembered what the people around him said.

"Wen Ni? Isn't she dating Shen Huaixu? Her boyfriend went abroad early instead of taking the college entrance exam. She must be heartbroken; they probably broke up."

So it was because of a breakup.

Jian Yuchen felt his mood was just like the rain that day—drizzling and miserable.

Damp and sticky.

Since he left, why come back?

chapters.title: Calling Shen Huaixu's Name All Night
chapters.content:
Perhaps because Jian Yuchen had suddenly brought up things from high school.

In her subsequent nap, Wen Ni dreamt of that suffocating, breathless time.

Wen Zhiwen’s approach to raising Wen Ni had been one of suppression since she was a child.

To be honest, for a college student who had made his way out of the mountains, Wen Zhiwen was always viewed by others as positive, upward-moving, and someone worth emulating.

Since she was young, Wen Ni could never understand why he could treat his own daughter with such an attitude in private.

It was as if her very act of breathing at home was a mistake.

She remembered that when Shen Huaixu was about to go abroad, she was the last to know.

In truth, she had been so busy with her studies at the time that she didn't even feel sad; Shen Huaixu was already in another country.

He had only left her a letter, as her mobile phone had been confiscated by Wen Zhiwen, and she couldn't receive his so-called farewell text messages.

Back then, phones were still button-operated. In those tiny screen frames, every text message cost money, so one would try to cram as much as possible into every single one, making them so long you couldn't see the end when scrolling down.

Shen Huaixu must have really liked her back then.
