"Isn't that just the tone you use for celery? It’s so green and healthy, can't it be used?" Jian Yuchen turned his head. A light source flickered on his side; it was clear he was operating his phone.

Wen Ni lunged at him. Jian Yuchen freed one hand to wrap around her small waist, letting her thrash on the bed as if she were merely tickling him.

Wen Ni was exhausted, but she hadn't managed to snatch the phone; she had only worn herself out.

"Alright, alright, when would I have had time to record? Look how worked up you’ve gotten." Seeing she was about to explode, Jian Yuchen offered a timely concession.

Wen Ni was still annoyed and sat down hard on him. "I'll crush you to death!"

"I don't accept that method of death, but I can accept dying from doing it 76 times."

The "doing" here was, naturally, a verb.

Wen Ni was speechless and rolled off him.

"Sleep."

Seeing her lying there motionless, Jian Yuchen turned over, pulled her into his arms, and rested his chin on her head. "Where do you get so much energy all day long?"

This remark, this tone?

"Wow, don't you dare play the victim. Who was it that insisted on tossing and turning until this hour?"

She turned her head and met the man's gaze.

Suddenly, both of them looked away for no reason.

Perhaps because they understood what the other was thinking, it felt even more awkward.

Such moments of innocence had vanished completely just one week after their wedding.

Wen Ni had never actually imagined what marriage would look like.

Especially marrying Jian Yuchen.

After the trials of high school and college, and even having to run into this man at work, Wen Ni never expected that Jian Yuchen would turn out to be a curse.

Those three characters were now appearing alongside her own on their marriage certificate.

Even her best friend since childhood, Lu Yang, didn't know she was married.

At the time, she had prepared herself for a marriage of convenience.

She didn't think Jian Yuchen had any interest in her in that regard, either.

So, when both families had dinner at a restaurant, and Wen Ni moved into the bridal suite prepared by Jian Yuchen’s parents with her suitcase, she automatically headed for the guest room.

"Where are you going?" The man had just taken off his jacket and asked directly when he saw her movement.

"Back to my room," Wen Ni said, turning around.

"The master bedroom is here." Jian Yuchen pointed in a direction with his chin, while casually loosening his tie.

Wen Ni hadn't expected him to be so gentlemanly, actually willing to give her the master bedroom while he took the guest room.

That was nice of him; the master bedroom even had its own bathroom.

Wen Ni hummed a little tune. "Thanks."

Then, under Jian Yuchen’s puzzled gaze, she happily wandered into his nest.

Opening the closet, she saw Jian Yuchen’s black, white, and gray suits hanging on one side, with the other side left for her.

Wen Ni said, "Hey, should I move your clothes over for you?"

The man had already entered the bedroom and closed the door behind him.

"Move them over for what? Do you have so many clothes you can't fit them?" Jian Yuchen took off his wristwatch and placed it on the nightstand.

Wen Ni didn't even think before saying, "Then you'll have to come to my room to get dressed later? That’s so much trouble."

What if he accused her of taking advantage of him!

Wen Ni didn't want that.

Jian Yuchen walked up behind her. "Hmm?"

Wen Ni had just opened her suitcase when she realized he was standing right in front of her.

"Do you want to shower first, or should I?" The man unbuttoned his cuffs and added, "It’s 10 o'clock, let's get some rest early."

Wen Ni froze, as if she heard a different meaning in his words.

She felt that perhaps it was her own mind that was dirty.

So she blinked and looked at him. "Is the bathroom in your guest room broken?"

Jian Yuchen paused, raised an eyebrow, and looked at her with a wicked glint in his eyes. He then stretched his long arms out on either side of her. "Ms. Wen Ni, allow me, your newly appointed husband, to tell you what you should be doing on your wedding night."

Wen Ni understood.

"You want to do it with me?"

He probably hadn't expected this slow-witted girl to blurt out the exact answer so shockingly.

The man nodded, staring at her, and confirmed, "Yes, Wen Ni, I want to do it with you."

"..."

Just by being looked at by him, her legs felt inexplicably weak.

Doi with Jian Yuchen—Wen Ni had never considered this option in her life.

"Scared?" the man asked, lowering his gaze.

Wen Ni stared at the body beneath his shirt and stiffened her neck. "Who's scared? I’m very experienced, you know. You shower first!"

Jian Yuchen scoffed. "That’s perfect, then. I also hate it when people are coy in bed."

With that, the man unbuckled his metal belt.

Wen Ni used every ounce of her self-control not to bolt out the door or call him a pervert when he made that move.

Oh heavens, she wanted to scream in her group chat.

She was done for; she was going to sleep with her arch-nemesis!

What position should she use to pin him down completely? To make him shout, "Queen, I was wrong!"

And then whip him hard with a lash.

However, in reality, Wen Ni’s posture silently slumped, and she quickly dodged from under his ribs, pretending to organize the clothes in her suitcase.

There was a rustling sound behind her as the man tossed his discarded clothes into the laundry basket. Out of the corner of her eye, Wen Ni caught a glimpse of his bare back in the mirrored closet door. Her face flushed bright red, and she lowered her head to keep busy.

In fact, she had already folded and unfolded the same white shirt several times!

The sound of water in the bathroom started. Wen Ni could only be thankful that the glass wasn't completely transparent, at least providing a tiny bit of privacy.

Wen Ni quickly opened her phone, wanting to find the video her friend had shared to cram some positions so she wouldn't be laughed at by Jian Yuchen later.

However, as soon as she clicked into it, she panicked and realized she hadn't muted it.

To provide the best sleep experience for the newlyweds, the master bedroom had been enlarged by combining two rooms into one.

Therefore, in the spacious environment, the sound traveled even more clearly.

chapters.title: How about I provide the accompaniment?
chapters.content:
As luck would have it, the sound of water in the bathroom stopped at that exact moment.

Wen Ni almost threw the phone in her hand.

The man emerged from the shower stall and opened the door. "You really haven't changed from childhood to adulthood when it comes to cramming at the last minute."

This referred to every time before an exam, when Wen Ni would buy snacks and fruit to offer to Confucius at the school flower bed.

Every time Jian Yuchen saw it, he would sneer.

She hadn't expected to be teased about this old habit on her wedding night.

Wen Ni’s stubborn nature flared up.

"This is called striving for excellence. I’m naturally a technical expert, okay? What 'cramming'? I’m worried you won't be able to handle it later. If you turn out to be a 'one-minute man,' we might as well go to the Civil Affairs Bureau at 8:00 tomorrow morning and get this divorce over with."

As soon as the words "one-minute man" left her lips, Wen Ni felt the room's temperature plummet into freezing air.

"Heh, don't you dare beg me to stop later." Jian Yuchen said this as he ripped off his bath towel.

Wen Ni’s eyes widened. Before she could react, she had already been scooped up by Jian Yuchen and tossed onto the bed.

The mattress hadn't been changed yet, and when Wen Ni was thrown onto it, her head spun. While she was still dizzy, the man leaned over and heavily sealed her lips.

"Mmph, I~ I haven't... showered yet." Wen Ni pressed against his hands as he tried to strip her clothes, trying to buy some time to prepare for the upcoming battlefield.

She had gone to get the marriage certificate in the morning, went to work in the afternoon, ran to a renovation site, and had dinner—she was covered in smoke and dust.

He, on the other hand, had showered and smelled fresh.

And what about her!!

"I don't mind you; I'll make do with the original flavor." The man spoke incoherently, his hands already quickly pulling her flailing arms above her head, and he swiftly stripped off her suit skirt.

Wen Ni never thought that one day she would be like this with Jian Yuchen.

Uh...

Well, being completely honest with each other.

"What are you looking at? Are you not satisfied?"

Jian Yuchen squeezed twice. "It'll do."

"What do you mean 'it'll do'? I’m a C-cup, okay? Look at this shape, this color, this style—on the market, it’s considered very beautiful! Apologize to my left and right! Immediately! Otherwise, they’ll be very angry."

"I'll kiss them, and they won't be angry anymore." The man said this with a straight face, and Wen Ni was instantly stunned with rage.

"Fine, first day of marriage and you're pulling this on me? Scum!"

"Stop yapping and hurry up and use your rich and exquisite combat techniques to conquer me." The man slapped her butt.

Wen Ni was the one who had said those words. If it were anyone else, she might have softened up a little and admitted she only knew how to watch and didn't know how to do it.

But he was Jian Yuchen, and Wen Ni would never, ever admit defeat!

Fine, no yapping it is!

Today, she, the great CC, would show him what it meant to conquer!

Wen Ni steeled herself, flipped over, and climbed up. She poked his shoulder with her finger. Jian Yuchen was surprisingly easygoing at this moment; he lay there sprawled out, and for the sake of observation and learning, he even placed both arms behind his head, looking like he was waiting to see how she would operate.

"What are you looking at!" Wen Ni felt a bit embarrassed.

Why didn't this man turn off the lights!

Was he just wasting electricity because his family had a little money?

"You look good," Jian Yuchen said softly.

Wen Ni’s movement to cover her body paused, and her face suddenly turned bright red.

Perhaps because she had fought with Jian Yuchen for so many years, Wen Ni had never imagined that Jian Yuchen would ever compliment her in her life.

She thought to herself, how could you believe anything a man says in bed!

That scoundrel Jian Yuchen was no exception.

She closed her eyes. "You... turn off the light, it’s hurting my eyes."

Jian Yuchen was quite obedient this time; he stretched out his long arm and pressed the button, leaving only a dim, yellowish light from the bedside lamp.

Wen Ni felt like she was blushing all over. She took a deep breath, her movements quick and agile.

"Hiss!"

As a result, both of them gasped in pain.

"You're not in pain?!" Jian Yuchen asked through gritted teeth.

"Can't you see I’m in so much pain I’m crying?!"

"If you're inexperienced, just admit it, don't put on an act. Come here!" The man yanked her to his side.

Wen Ni had originally intended to put on her clothes and go to sleep; such a life-draining matter could be discussed tomorrow.

Who would have known that under the "soothing" of this guy, Jian Yuchen, she would end up exhausted for the better part of the night in a daze.

The next day, she couldn't even get out of bed.

Liar, total scumbag!

It was as if she were the only one who didn't know how to do it; he kept flipping her over like a pancake, with an endless supply of energy.

He did it on purpose—he was bullying her on purpose!

Wen Ni cried until she was exhausted. Since she had already taken leave, she didn't want to get up at all; she’d rather just starve to death.

It wasn't until evening that the man carried her out to eat dinner.

"I don't want porridge, I want a KFC family bucket!"

Jian Yuchen wore a mysterious smile and, with a very good temper, ordered one for her.

Wen Ni almost buried her face in the bucket.

"Eat slowly, no one is going to snatch it from you."

Look at how hungry the child was, as if she hadn't eaten for three days and three nights.

Having been bullied all night, Wen Ni couldn't even walk to the bathroom, so Jian Yuchen had to carry her there.

"Why are you still standing there? Haven't you bullied me enough?" Wen Ni sat on the toilet, her voice hoarse, and scolded him crossly as she saw the man standing at the door, motionless.

Jian Yuchen raised an eyebrow. "Can't you pee while I'm here? Weren't you quite capable last night?"

Wen Ni was so angry her face swelled up. "You—you—you are shameless! Get out!"

"How about I provide some musical accompaniment? Shh~ shh-shh~ shh!"

"Shh your grandfather!" Wen Ni grabbed a hair-drying cap from the side and threw it at him.

Jian Yuchen reached out and caught it, sighing. "Fine, I'll wait for you outside."

Wen Ni said without thinking, "It's all your fault! Talking about 'one last minute'—you had way too many 'one minutes'!"

Added together, it was all night without stopping. And then he even tricked her into taking leave early in the morning!

She was just too naive! She actually believed this guy's nonsense!

For the first time, Jian Yuchen felt a bit embarrassed and rubbed his nose. "Does it still hurt? Should I go buy some ointment?"

"You dare try!" She didn't have such a thick skin.

Hearing the sound of the toilet flushing, Jian Yuchen waited at the door for Her Majesty's instructions.

Whenever he thought of last night, the smile on the man's face never faded.

Unfortunately, in Wen Ni's eyes, that smile was a sinister grin, a cruel smile!

Jian Yuchen, this cruel man, was finally able to ravage her in a legitimate way.

She really was a stupid pig who had walked right into the trap.

As Wen Ni was wallowing in self-pity, the moment she squeezed out some hand soap and looked up, a shrill scream erupted in the bathroom.

The man pushed the door open and rushed in. "What's wrong?!"

Wen Ni turned her head, looked at him, and then looked at herself in the mirror.

Her foundation was mottled on her face, and her eyeliner and lipstick were so crooked they looked like a large map drawn on her face.

It wouldn't be an exaggeration to call her a female ghost.

And to think this man actually praised her for being pretty last night!

Jian Yuchen, you are capable of great things.

You are truly capable of the impossible!

"You—I look like this, why didn't you remind me!"

Jian Yuchen breathed a sigh of relief, thinking something had happened to her.

"Isn't it quite good? Returning to one's natural state."

"..." Wen Ni was so angry her head spun, and she pushed the man out!

She had thought that even if they didn't get along in other areas, they were quite compatible in bed.

It was all an illusion! An illusion.

chapters.title: Best Actress, Well-Deserved
chapters.content:
The consequence of their wedding night was that Wen Ni discovered Jian Yuchen was a perpetual motion machine.

The first thing she did every day when she got home, no matter how sleepy or tired she was, was to remove her makeup.

Then, she would quickly put it on again in the morning...

*Beep*, the female ghost clocks in after her soul has flown away.

Wen Ni's dreams all night long ranged from her first love to her wedding night.

In the dream, Jian Yuchen was insufferably hateful, so much so that she even ate his breakfast viciously the next morning.

Jian Yuchen: ?

Seeing Wen Ni eating fiercely, he silently moved his own fried egg over to her.

Wen Ni ate it without hesitation!

When the two arrived at the company, they were back to acting like strangers.

"Winnie, Byrne (Ning Yan) just said there's going to be a small meeting about Jin Feng later. You need to decide which team member you're taking to Jin Feng, and then come up for the meeting."

Wen Ni nodded. "Got it."

Her team had put a lot of effort into the Jin Feng project. Wen Ni intended to be fair, so she decided to take the two main designers from groups A and B, along with the two most outstanding interns.

When they arrived at the conference room next to Ning Yan's office, everyone realized that the Jin Feng project could actually take a turn for the better and was worth fighting for again.

Everyone had poured half a year of heart and soul into this; now that it was suddenly gone, no one was willing to give up.

No matter how hard it was to crack, they had to crack it.

This was the drive of the design industry.

It was also Lingdu's consistent philosophy.

Otherwise, they wouldn't have been able to carve a path out of the siege in such a fast-changing industry all these years.

Lingdu never wanted weak or incompetent soldiers.

Jian Yuchen didn't have many people on his side, bringing only his personal assistant.

"Since everyone knows the current situation, the design team will probably have to work a bit harder. Now that the personnel list is confirmed, let's try to keep this trip confidential. Everyone, send your information to my assistant, and we'll book the tickets together."

"Understood."

Jian Yuchen and Wen Ni stood up. When they reached the conference room door at the same time, the teams on both sides were on high alert.

They were terrified that the two would start arguing over who should open the door first.

Fortunately, the two of them pulled their respective sides of the door open simultaneously and walked out.

Everyone couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief.

They wondered if President Ning was truly bold, taking these two on a business trip—they just hoped they wouldn't start fighting at Jin Feng.

The thing Wen Ni brought most when traveling was disposable travel supplies; she even brought a foldable kettle.

Not to mention personal items like bed sheets and bath towels.

It just so happened that their home stock had run out, and Wen Ni hadn't remembered.

Instead, after Jian Yuchen returned to his office, he sent her a message, reminding her to check the inventory.

Wen Ni slapped her forehead, only then remembering the matter.

"Let's go to the nearby supermarket after work."

"Sure."

After they finished communicating, Zhou Xueli sent a file over on the company's internal software right on time for her to sign.

Pear-ah-Pear: I heard President Ning is taking you and Jian Yuchen on a business trip? What big project did you guys land again?

Wen-not-Ding: Internal secret. The trip is real, but the specific location is confidential.

Pear-ah-Pear: Then can I look forward to a year-end bonus?

Wen-not-Ding: If things go smoothly, you should mourn the fact that your annual leave for this year will be pushed to the year after next.

Pear-ah-Pear: Heavens, my mother! All my beautiful virtues, my cultivation, my beauty—all in vain!

Wen Ni didn't want to go on this trip either. She never slept well whenever she changed hotels.

Especially when she had to get up early to deal with clients, it was even more of a torment.

After drinking three cups of coffee and negotiating the villa design style with a new client, Wen Ni finally got off work and headed to the underground garage.

She found that Jian Yuchen's car was actually parked there.

Wen-not-Ding: Why haven't you left yet?

Simon: You haven't replied to me about which supermarket.

Wen-not-Ding: The one at the entrance of our place, I guess.

Just as Wen Ni finished sending the message and was about to get into the car, she saw someone rushing over to Jian Yuchen's car.

It was Matthia.

"Simon! My car broke down today and I didn't drive it. Where are you going? Can you give me a ride?" Matthia raised both hands and blinked her eyes. "Please, please."

Jian Yuchen's eyelid twitched, and he subconsciously looked at Wen Ni.

Matthia looked over too, but she didn't care that Wen Ni saw this scene.

After all, everyone in the company knew that Wen Ni had absolutely no interest in Jian Yuchen.

She wasn't a potential love rival either.

"Winnie is here too? Well, be careful on your way home, see you tomorrow."

Wen Ni silently got into the car. Jian Yuchen withdrew his gaze and said, "Sorry, I have urgent matters."

Matthia looked sad. "But it's very hard to catch a taxi at this time when I'm going home alone."

"The subway station isn't far." Jian Yuchen started the car. "Excuse me, please move."

Matthia watched the car drive away and stomped her feet in anger.

What a tough nut to crack!

As soon as they arrived near the supermarket, Jian Yuchen parked the car and saw that Wen Ni was already waiting at the entrance with a shopping cart.

They had been married for so long, but they hadn't gone to the supermarket together many times.

"I thought you were going to take Matthia home."

"Looks like we don't need to buy vinegar at home." After Jian Yuchen finished speaking, Wen Ni realized what he meant. "Who are you calling jealous? Shameless."

"Then why are you being so sour? Besides, I didn't give Matthia a ride." Jian Yuchen picked up a can of yellow peaches that Wen Ni liked and put it in the cart.

Wen Ni chose a few bags of junk food. "I call that reasonable speculation, not being sour. I think you're just looking at me through colored glasses."

Jian Yuchen's gaze fell on her; she was wearing a tight-fitting suit skirt today. "Hmm, the way I look at you is indeed not exactly 'innocent'."

It was colored.

Most of the time, when she annoyed him, what he thought about when he went back to the office was how to pin her down in every corner of the room and make her cry and beg for mercy.

In his fantasies, Wen Ni wasn't wearing any clothes at all.

Wen Ni understood instantly.

"We're in a supermarket; even if you're feeling horny, there should be a limit."

"I'm not showing it to the whole world, and the limit is determined by you, after all, you're the object of my fantasies."

"Oh, so I have to thank you for awarding me the status of the female lead?"

"You're welcome, it's only right; you deserve it." After Jian Yuchen finished speaking, Wen Ni gave him a fierce look.

"I really want to film this face of yours right now and show it to the fan girls who used to have a crush on you. 'High-mountain flower,' 'aloof from women,' 'ascetic academic'—those are all the biggest misunderstandings about you."

"Heaven and earth as my witness, I never built that persona." Jian Yuchen picked up a carton of yogurt that Wen Ni liked, and then said speechlessly, "Given my enthusiasm for a certain activity, it's quite obvious that the Jian Yuchen you're talking about is a product of your classmates' fantasies."

"Who's to say it wasn't you giving them the wrong impression?" As Wen Ni said this, she wasn't looking ahead, and when they reached a corner, Jian Yuchen pulled her back.

"Careful."

Wen Ni’s nose bumped into his suit jacket.

“Yu-chen?” a woman’s soft voice rang out.

Wen Ni turned her head and saw Fang Hui.

What was it she said again?

All the accidents in this world appear in the most dramatic ways.

For instance, her and his—

chapters.title: It’s Not What You Think Between Her and Me
chapters.content:
“What a coincidence.” Fang Hui was clearly very surprised to run into him here.

Jian Yuchen pulled Wen Ni’s waist tight. “It is quite a coincidence.”

Fang Hui’s gaze fell on the woman in his arms, likely surprised that he would be so unreserved with someone in public.

“Is this… your girlfriend?”

“My wife. We’ve been married for three years.”

The man felt the body in his arms stiffen and his gaze dropped to the crown of Wen Ni’s head.

He also automatically ignored the shock and surprise in Fang Hui’s eyes.

Wen Ni was still playing dead, but Jian Yuchen had already turned her around and draped an arm over her shoulder. “You know her too, Wen Ni.”

Fang Hui was indeed shocked that they were married, but seeing their intimate movements, her eyes wavered. However, she had always been good at controlling her emotions. “How come nobody knew? When did this happen? I’m sorry, you said three years—I’m just a bit too surprised.”

Fang Hui smiled. “Congratulations to you both.”

Wen Ni twitched the corner of her mouth. Her relationship with Fang Hui wasn’t good; it was limited to just knowing each other, so there was nothing much to say.

“We’ll get going then.” Jian Yuchen pushed the cart and pulled Wen Ni away.

Wen Ni could feel that Fang Hui was watching them the whole time.

“Why are you being so timid?” The man picked up a disposable bath towel and frowned at Wen Ni.

She pouted. “I just feel awkward.”

The difference between her and Fang Hui…

No, that wasn’t the right way to put it.

From her appearance to her personality, she and Fang Hui were two completely opposite people.

Fang Hui was a great beauty in the traditional sense—fair-skinned, beautiful, tall, and possessed a gentle, harmless personality, always speaking in soft whispers.

She was the quintessential template of a school-day “white moonlight.”

Yet, Wen Ni’s feelings toward her were very complicated.

Because she was the template for the “perfect daughter” in Wen Zhiwen’s eyes.

When they were children, Fang Hui lived in the same apartment building as her, but later moved away as her father’s career advanced.

When Wen Ni was climbing trees, Fang Hui was in the choir with her mother, singing and dancing; everyone called her a “nightingale” and called Wen Ni a “wild monkey.”

When she was at home doodling, Fang Hui had already become a school reporter and was appearing on television for interviews.

In any case, every time Wen Zhiwen saw her coming home from school, he would sigh and say that he wished Fang Hui were his daughter.

Or else, he’d say that Fang Hui was more like his daughter.

Wen Ni didn’t hate Fang Hui, but she would subconsciously compare herself to her.

And Fang Hui was like a nightmare, attending the same schools as her from kindergarten through high school.

Continuing her legendary life, and remaining the standard template for a “good daughter” in Wen Zhiwen’s eyes.

She discovered that Fang Hui and Jian Yuchen had a thing going on back in their senior year of high school.

The music teacher had stopped her and asked her to help fetch a USB drive from the audiovisual room.

Thinking the next period was a study hall, she wandered over slowly.

Usually, no one ever came here except for computer class; it was incredibly quiet.

Only the sound of a piano echoed through the teaching building.

Wen Ni was drinking milk and yawning. When she opened the door and walked in, the piano music stopped abruptly.

As she finished her milk, the dull sound of the straw hitting the empty bottle echoed through the classroom.

The young girl sitting on the piano bench and the young boy standing by the window reading a book.

It was just like the cover of a romance novel from that time.

The only prerequisite would have been that neither of them were people she disliked.

“I’m here to… get a USB drive.” She explained her actions, then quickly walked to the podium to look for the drive the teacher had mentioned.

Unfortunately, the more nervous she got, the harder it was to find.

Her mind was filled with: What are they doing here?

Until a pair of hands reached out in front of her.

Wen Ni looked up; Jian Yuchen shoved the USB drive at her. “It’s here.”

“Oh.”

For once, she didn’t bicker with him.

She only breathed a sigh of relief when she had walked out of the classroom, head down.

But Fang Hui chased after her at that moment.

“Wen Ni.”

Wen Ni felt completely uncomfortable facing her.

She felt inferior, yet deep down, she didn’t actually think she was any worse than Fang Hui.

It was Wen Zhiwen who was sick; it was he who was gaslighting her.

But no one understood her contradictory psychology, and she didn’t want to blow this small matter out of proportion and affect her own mood.

“What’s wrong?”

Fang Hui gave her a gentle smile and looked back toward the classroom, a faint blush on her face. “Wen Ni, about me and Yu-chen being here… could you please not tell anyone?”

Wen Ni was a bit annoyed. Did she think she was a blabbermouth? She didn’t want to talk about it anyway.

“I won’t say anything.”

Fang Hui held her hand. “I knew you were the best. I’ll buy you milk tea later.”

Thinking of this, Wen Ni sighed. “Hey, why did you and Fang Hui break up?”

She seemed to remember that after high school graduation, she hadn’t heard anything about them.

After all, Fang Hui later studied broadcasting and hosting at a media college, which wasn’t the same university as theirs.

And she heard she had gone to Z City.

“Long-distance relationship?”

With Jian Yuchen’s infuriating mouth, would he be very gentle when talking to Fang Hui?

Thinking of this, Wen Ni felt it was unfair—she worked herself to the bone, and Jian Yuchen never gave her a pleasant look.

Admittedly, no matter how eloquent Mr. Jian Yuchen was, he couldn’t keep up with his young wife’s jumping thoughts.

He just frowned and said, “We weren’t really in touch much anyway.”

“If you don’t want to say it, then don’t. This answer of yours is so dismissive.”

Jian Yuchen put away the things they were buying and squeezed her hand. “I’m telling the truth. Whether you believe it or not, it’s not what you think between her and me.”

“Then why don’t you tell me what it was about?” Wen Ni looked up at him.

Jian Yuchen said, “I can’t talk about this. If I do, you’ll get carried away.”

Zero sincerity!

He didn’t want to talk about it, and now he was shifting the blame onto her!

Wen Ni rolled her eyes. “Then why did you tell her we were married just now?”

“She won’t talk about it to others; she’ll keep it to herself.”

“Besides, she cares about her reputation.”

Wen Ni was puzzled. “Is there any necessary connection between the two?”

Jian Yuchen sighed. “No, so let’s not dwell on this.”

Wen Ni felt he was becoming more and more dismissive. She raised her fist and punched him. “What kind of attitude is that? Are you still my gossip partner or not?”

In the distance, Fang Hui watched them chasing each other.

Jian Yuchen even pulled her hand and pressed her into his arms.

Fang Hui gripped the shopping cart handle tightly, then slowly turned and left.

“Miss, you dropped your items.”

“It’s fine, I don’t want them anymore.”

With the business trip items sorted, Wen Ni was sitting in the living room eating snacks and scrolling through her phone.

Jian Yuchen was organizing documents in the study. His computer chimed; he clicked on his private email and received a message from Fang Hui.

[Is it convenient to meet up? I’ll wait for you at the old spot.]

Jian Yuchen glanced at Wen Ni, who was lying on the sofa.

[Not convenient. If you have something to say, just say it directly. If not, I won’t be going.]

“Jian Yuchen, the cola is gone. Get me a can.”

“Coming.”

The man got up to get her a cola. “Drink less. Your period is coming in a couple of days.”

“Oh, I know, you busybody.”

There was no reply from the other side for a long time. In a month, this email would automatically clear—

chapters.title: The Vanishing Him
chapters.content:
The flight itinerary was sent by Ning Yan’s assistant.

It was indeed an early morning flight.

Wen Ni rolled her eyes the moment she saw the flight time.

This meant they had to leave at 6:00 AM to make it on time.

Jian Yuchen turned around with the cola and saw Wen Ni’s face covered in a blood-red paste. The man couldn’t help but step back.

“What? Never seen a beauty applying a rose mask?” Wen Ni even used both hands to make little waves at her chin.

“I thought someone had turned you into a human-skin lantern.” Jian Yuchen opened the cola and took a sip himself to steady his nerves.

“Hah, then why didn’t it scare the guts out of you!” 656767

“Can’t help it, heaven blesses the working class; someone like me is destined for great fortune.” Jian Yuchen placed the other cola in front of her.

Wen Ni sipped through the straw and continued lying on the sofa scrolling through her phone.

Jian Yuchen sat down. “Is your luggage all packed?”

“Mm-hmm.” Wen Ni asked nonchalantly, “How are you planning to go tomorrow?”

It was the first time both of them were going on a business trip with company staff; they had to plan the route.

“Let’s go together.” Jian Yuchen leaned back.

Wen Ni’s hand paused, and she looked up at him.

“The parking lot is so big, we might not run into them. The parking lot is full by 8:00 AM, hard to find a spot.”

Wen Ni understood. Jian Yuchen looked at her. “Are you afraid?”

Wen Ni puffed out her chest. “Who’s afraid!”

“Then it’s settled.”

Wen Ni checked the time; it was getting late, and today’s situation didn’t allow for sleeping in.

An adult’s free time was just that scarce and short-lived.

After washing her face and doing her nighttime skincare routine, Wen Ni climbed into bed like a lamb waiting for the slaughter.

Jian Yuchen saw her get in, then turned off the bedside lamp and lay down to sleep.

Under normal circumstances, if neither gave the other a hint, marital life could be paused for a day.

Especially when they had to wake up early the next day, it was practically an unwritten rule.

Jian Yuchen adjusted his breathing, ignoring the faint scent of Wen Ni’s body, and was just about to fall asleep when, next to him, Wen Ni kicked off the duvet and started kicking her legs up in the air.

?

“What are you doing?”

“Don’t you think I’ve gotten fat lately? I ate carbs again tonight, I have to burn off some calories.”

“You didn’t watch your diet when you were eating, and now you’re trying to lock the stable door after the horse has bolted.”

Wen Ni covered her ears, refusing to listen, while kicking her legs frantically until she was exhausted.

“It’s not working! I’ve been so busy lately; I haven’t had time to hit the gym. My personal trainer is about to kneel down and call me ‘Mom’.” Wen Ni lay on the bed, panting heavily.

Jian Yuchen squeezed her soft arm, and at the thought of her having big muscles later, he mused, “I just invested in a hotel. I’ll take you there to swim later; the environment is quite nice.”

Wen Ni paused and turned her head to stare at him. “Just how rich are you? How come you’ve invested in another hotel?”

"It took you three years of marriage to think about caring about my account balance—isn't that a bit too slow?"

Wen Ni raised an eyebrow. "Isn't that a good thing? It proves I don't have much interest in your wallet, which fundamentally prevents you from becoming the protagonist of *Lost in the Stars*!"

"If you had the ability to do that, then talk. With that brain of yours, who could you possibly outplay?"

Whatever was hidden beneath her eyes was clear at a single glance.

"I have such great qualities; why do they sound so terrible coming from your mouth?"

Jian Yuchen stretched out his long legs to pin her down, leaning in to bury his face in the crook of her neck. "Go to sleep quickly. Leave the exercise to me."

Wen Ni felt like she detected something off about that.

But as for accepting the "mobile yellow flag," she refused!

The man always carried a comforting body temperature and a scent that made her feel at ease. Wen Ni couldn't help it; she burrowed into his arms, found a comfortable angle, and drifted off to sleep.

The next morning, the two of them got up quickly and changed their clothes.

When they left, Jian Yuchen grabbed her suitcase as well. Both were 24 inches, but hers was significantly heavier than his.

"What did you put in here?"

"My noble soul."

"..."

Wen Ni shrugged. "Fine, it’s just some travel-sized skincare, masks, cosmetics, and my laptop."

Jian Yuchen was speechless. "Beauty really does come at a price."

Wen Ni felt his ideological awareness had leveled up.

As soon as she got into Jian Yuchen’s car, Wen Ni took out a U-shaped pillow, planning to nap for a bit. "Wake me up when we get there."

"Mm."

He played some soothing music, and Wen Ni fell asleep instantly.

Halfway there, Jian Yuchen received a call.

Ning Yan’s voice filled the car. Wen Ni opened her eyes, wanting to hear what nonsense he had to say.

"Have you set off?"

"Arriving in half an hour."

"Wen Ni isn't picking up her phone. I don't know where she is."

Jian Yuchen glanced at Wen Ni. "If she isn't picking up, she's probably driving."

"That's possible. See you at the boarding gate on time then. By the way, I just ran into Shen Huaixu. He’s actually on the same flight as us, probably heading to Jinfeng too. Feels like our odds just got a bit better."

Jian Yuchen looked at the red light ahead, thinking that Shen Huaixu really was like a lingering ghost.

Wen Ni’s eyes widened as well. What kind of twisted fate was this?

She had said it before: if you have any emotional entanglement with a man, and it happens to be in the workplace, everything becomes very complicated.

Jian Yuchen didn't say anything. Ning Yan muttered to himself, said he’d talk when they arrived, and hung up.

The car moved forward, already on the airport expressway.

Wen Ni cleared her throat, trying to change the subject.

"Um, do you have the list of people going this time?"

"The group was created last night. Didn't you say, 'It's these people again'?"

?

"Really!" Wen Ni pulled out her phone with an exaggerated expression.

"Oh, so it is! I thought it was some boring advertisement, so I muted it."

"..." Jian Yuchen glanced at her and continued driving.

Wen Ni asked, "How are we going to handle it at the airport?"

"Together."

"That would be too obvious."

"Can't we meet in the parking lot? Who says walking together means there's something going on?"

Wen Ni felt he had stopped being cautious today.

Usually, they were very careful about walking together.

Wen Ni pouted. "Fine, I guess, since you're acting as my chauffeur."

The airport was already getting congested early in the morning.

They had to queue for the parking lot. After Jian Yuchen parked, he picked up Wen Ni’s suitcase. "Let's go."

Wen Ni followed him silently.

She felt like there was something wrong with the two of them appearing in front of their colleagues like this for the first time.

Speak of the devil—as soon as they got on the elevator, they ran into two colleagues from the company.

It was Sapna from Market Research and Frits from the Media Department.

"Simon? Winnie?" Their gazes landed on them.

Jian Yuchen smiled naturally. "What a coincidence."

"It really is. We thought we were going to be late. You two just arrived too?"

"Yeah, we parked next to each other."

Their eyes fell on the two suitcases in Jian Yuchen’s hands.

Jian Yuchen stood still, looking straight ahead. Compared to Wen Ni’s guilty conscience, he was as calm as if this were the most ordinary thing in the world.

It made the two colleagues think, *Well, it's just gentlemanly manners, I must be overthinking it. After all, this is Jian Yuchen and Wen...*

chapters.title: Can You Swap Seats With Me?
chapters.content:
After the four of them exchanged greetings, they maintained the basic etiquette of corporate slaves toward their colleagues.

However, based on Wen Ni’s knowledge of this company, they would definitely post in their private group: *Holy hell, I saw Jian Yuchen and Wen Ni together. Jian Yuchen was even carrying Wen Ni’s luggage.*

Then, after half an hour of intense discussion, they would reach two conclusions:

One, Jian Yuchen has some dirt on the "female devil" Wen Ni.

Two, Jian Yuchen is her gay best friend.

My god, the second conclusion was simply beautiful; it perfectly avoided the question of how to explain the two of them appearing together, while also dumping a bucket of black paint on Jian Yuchen.

Wen Ni had already started planning how to ask Jian Yuchen for hush money.

The elevator reached the first floor of the airport terminal.

The usual routine followed.

Sapna was a very enthusiastic person. As soon as they left the elevator, she linked arms with Wen Ni, affectionately asking if they should go grab a coffee since they had time.

Frits automatically walked with Jian Yuchen, helping to share the burden of the ladies' suitcases.

Sapna turned back to express her gratitude. "Thanks to you both. I'll have Winnie and me treat you to coffee later."

Wen Ni heard Jian Yuchen and Frits talking about the recent stock market.

She listened in secretly; after all, even the "cowardly money" she earned had to be managed.

When the four of them reached the boarding gate, the main group had already arrived.

"Where is Director Ning?" Frits asked.

"Oh, he seems to have gone into the VIP lounge to chat with Director Shen from Jinfeng."

Ning Yan’s assistant started counting heads. Wen Ni saw Gu Wang, an intern from Group B, waving at her, and she walked straight over.

"Director."

"Nervous about your first business trip?" Wen Ni asked, noticing he had brought a DSLR camera.

Gu Wang smiled. "It's alright. My dad said to watch more and learn more."

They say you can tell what kind of student a designer has by the designer themselves.

In the Creative Department, besides Wen Ni as the Design Director, the two lead designers of Groups A and B had very different styles.

Group A was good at catering to the market, understanding current client needs, and was better suited for home and commercial renovations, keeping up with trends and fads.

The group leader, Wang Linmu, was a veteran designer with years of experience. His intern, Yu Xiaozhu, had also just graduated from a professional program this year. The two of them were on the same wavelength, so they had a very good relationship with the Marketing and Client departments.

Group B followed the creative route, focusing on private exhibition halls or scene design, testing creativity and artistic conception.

When the lead designer, Tao Zi, came to work, her desk looked like you’d walked into a tropical rainforest—you could find all sorts of little animals there. But she was also someone with a vast galaxy in her mind. Gu Wang shared her style; every time the teacher and student appeared, they seemed completely out of place with the rest of the Lingdu company.

Their designs were loved by those who loved them, who saw them as the creative hands of God.

Those who didn't like them would only frown and say, "I guess I don't understand art."

To put it bluntly: *What the hell is this?*

Wen Ni, on the other hand, combined both, reaching a perfect balance.

Tao Zi was leaning in a corner wearing sunglasses, dressed in vintage clothes she’d picked up from who knows where. Gu Wang whispered, "She didn't sleep well."

"I can tell."

"Engineer Wang, are you confident this time?"

Wang Linmu sighed. "Hard to say. I saw that Director Shen earlier, and I don't think he needs a design that's too good."

This was just something said quietly within their own circle.

The subtext was simply that Shen Huaixu looked like a businessman; design was secondary, and profit was the main thing.

"Don't worry, your Director Ning has plenty of connections." Jian Yuchen suddenly sat down across from them.

When it comes to business, it’s best to leave it to the professionals.

Jian Yuchen wasn't wrong. If there was no chance, this group of people wouldn't be standing here.

As long as Jinfeng hadn't completely shut the door, they still had to compete.

Ning Yan came out soon after, looking in good spirits.

"I was just about to ask if you had arrived. I was afraid you'd be late."

Ning Yan squeezed in between them.

Sapna handed him a coffee, and Ning Yan thanked her. "Let's put in 120% effort this time. Our odds are still very good. We’ve worked hard for half a year; let's make one final push to win this contract."

Wen Ni truly admired Ning Yan for being so energetic early in the morning.

Once on the plane, she just wanted to have a good sleep.

The assistant began distributing the boarding passes.

Everyone started looking for their seats.

Wen Ni took hers, opened the coffee, and took a sip without even looking at it.

When they were boarding the plane, Wen Ni realized Jian Yuchen was actually still with them.

Years of being classmates + arch-rivals + brief colleagues all told her that Jian Yuchen was an extremely fastidious person.

Why would he sit in business class?

She checked twice, and once she confirmed Jian Yuchen was really on the same route as them, she asked, puzzled, "Aren't you going to first class today?"

Jian Yuchen was behind her in line. "I was afraid you'd think I was wasting money, so I had to save some for you."

?

Wen Ni looked around, terrified that someone would hear.

"Are you trying to kill me?" Being so obvious in public.

Jian Yuchen lowered his eyes to look at her nervous expression, curled his lips into a smile, reached out to steady her head, and turned her in the other direction.

The two of them’s little interaction was seen by the others.

?

No way, is Simon already this bold!

Daring to touch the Queen's head!

Who should they help first if things go south?

However, after being nervous for a while, nothing happened, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

It seems Wen Ni, when on a business trip early in the morning, is still relatively easy to talk to.

In short, even if the two of them kissed right there, everyone would just assume one of them had been forced to do it for money.

Wen Ni looked at her seat, then at the boarding pass in Jian Yuchen’s hand.

Lily was way too good at arranging things!

"I want the window seat."

Jian Yuchen tilted his head, signaling her to hurry inside, as there were people behind them waiting to board.

Besides, she could sit on his lap for all he cared, let alone a window seat.

Once Wen Ni sat down, she took out her headphones, eye mask, and U-shaped pillow, intending to drift off to sleep right there.

However, before she could even put on her eye mask, Shen Huaixu’s voice reached her.

"What a coincidence. Would you mind switching seats?" This was directed at Jian Yuchen.

Coincidence?

Jian Yuchen looked up from his phone screen.

"Mr. Shen, you really know how to joke."

"Too bad it’s not very funny," Jian Yuchen said, then closed his eyes to rest.

Wen Ni looked at Jian Yuchen, then at Shen Huaixu, who was staring at her.

She suddenly felt a wave of scalp-tingling dread.

"How about... you switch with me?"

Both men looked over in unison.

One could see the exact same thought on both their faces: Are you an idiot?

To avoid getting caught in the crossfire, Wen Ni silently turned her head to look at the scenery outside.

Honestly, it wasn't like she wanted to run into her ex-boyfriend.

If he weren't a client, she would have told him to stay far away long ago.

"Mr. Shen, why don't you take my seat?" Lily, not wanting to offend a major client, very perceptively offered up the seat next to Jian Yuchen.

"Thank you for the trouble. You can go sit in my seat, here is my ticket."

chapters.title: Isn't This Giving You a Choice?
chapters.content:
Passing up a perfectly good first-class seat just to squeeze into business class with them.

Wolfish ambition.

His intentions were truly sinister.

Jian Yuchen glanced at Wen Ni, but unfortunately, this prized catch had already put on her eye mask and was playing dead.

After Shen Huaixu sat down, he didn't speak either, appearing to need rest.

With Ning Yan absent, there was no one to warm up the atmosphere, and not knowing what to say to someone of Shen Huaixu’s status, they could only close their eyes and rest in silence.

The plane took off soon after.

"I heard you started an investment firm after graduation. How come you're at Lingdu now?" Shen Huaixu finally spoke up.

He held a magazine in his hand, asking the question quite nonchalantly.

Jian Yuchen spoke slowly, "Are you very concerned about what I’m doing?"

Shen Huaixu curled his lips into a smile, "Just asking out of passing interest."

"Then you’d better stop worrying about it. As long as I’m at Lingdu, don't even think about becoming a shareholder in this company."

Shen Huaixu shook his head, "You still haven't changed."

"You're about the same."

"Then shall we see if the outcome this time will be the same as it was in high school?"

Jian Yuchen suddenly opened his eyes and stared at him coldly, "You are more than welcome to try."

Perhaps hit in a sore spot, Shen Huaixu didn't say another word.

Jian Yuchen turned to look at Wen Ni, who was fast asleep with her headphones on, completely oblivious to the world, and couldn't help but reach out and pinch her nose.

Wen Ni mumbled something, swatted his hand away, and turned the other way to continue sleeping.

Shen Huaixu watched their little interaction, his lips pressed into a thin line.

Because it was a short flight, Wen Ni didn't wake up at all until the plane reached its destination.

"I thought that Mr. Shen was going to stay at the same hotel as us."

"How could that be? People would just accuse us of being opportunistic. This is called avoiding suspicion."

"Exactly. Didn't you see? As soon as the plane landed and he turned on his phone, he got a call and headed back to first class."

"You didn't say a word to him the whole way?"

"He didn't say anything once he came over, and I only called him Mr. Shen."

"You let a perfectly good 'golden turtle son-in-law' slip through your fingers."

Wen Ni put on her sunglasses and faced the high-noon sun, feeling that even so, all her vitality was evaporating along with the early morning.

The hotel shuttle had already arrived.

Ning Yan was quite excited. Since it was just their own people on the minibus, he turned around and said to everyone, "We'll rest for one night today. I’ve booked a resort hotel. Tomorrow we’ll head to Jinfeng for the real battle. Tonight’s expenses are on me."

"Mr. Ning is generous!"

"Thank you, Mr. Ning!"

Ning Yan nudged Jian Yuchen, who was sitting next to him, "Hey, I picked this place specifically. There’s a beach in the back, a bonfire party tonight, and a beach bar. Want to go and have a romantic encounter? Solve your lifelong problem."

"You and I are not the same kind of person."

That was quite a statement.

However, Gu Wang, sitting behind them, heard it.

"Mr. Ning, are we really not working today?"

Ning Yan turned and laughed, "Would I lie to you? Go have fun! Work hard after you've played, and I'll treat everyone to a meal later."

"Yay~"

Wen Ni heard Sapna complaining, "Mr. Ning, why didn't you tell us you booked a hotel with a beach? I didn't even bring a swimsuit."

"Just buy one there!"

As if the ones sold on-site would be any good!

However, after arriving at the hotel, Sapna immediately beamed with joy. The hotel was well-situated; besides a commercial street for late-night snacks and barbecue, it also had a full range of swimwear and swimming gear.

In addition to affordable swimwear, there were also designer shops.

Lily handed out room cards to everyone. Directors got single rooms on the 24th floor, while the rest of the staff got standard double rooms.

Sapna was in a rush to buy a swimsuit to take photos on the beach in the afternoon, and Gu Wang happened to have his camera with him.

Wen Ni had originally wanted to catch up on sleep, but seeing the boundless blue sea outside, she immediately fell silent.

Screw sleeping!

Blue sky! Sea! Here I come!

Action is better than thought. Before the male colleagues could even react, they had already left their luggage at the front desk and went off hand-in-hand to buy swimsuits.

Ning Yan could only watch their backs and say, "Be careful on the way."

The scorching sun outside hit her skin, and Wen Ni instantly woke up. At high noon, the ground in the distance seemed to shimmer with heat haze.

The palm trees on both sides didn't even stir.

Even on the roadside, one could hear the sound of waves crashing against the shore and the noise of tourists riding jet skis.

The closer they got to the beach, the less clothing the people they encountered were wearing.

Sexy, hot babes were running around in bikinis.

It actually made them, dressed in work clothes, look out of place.

As soon as Wen Ni entered the swimwear shop, before she could even enjoy the air conditioning, she received a message from Jian Yuchen.

Simon: Don't you dare buy a bikini.

Wen Buding: Then a one-piece.

Simon: Don't you dare buy a high-cut one.

Wen Buding: ? Freedom of dress, thank you~

The other side was still "typing," but Wen Ni didn't care. The more he forbade her from buying something, the more her rebellious streak flared up, and she was determined to buy it.

"That one, the bright red one. Wrap it up for me."

The group quickly returned to the hotel. Taozi said, "See you at the beach later."

"Ok."

Wen Ni took out her room card. Just as she was about to swipe it to enter, a figure moved faster than her. Emerging from the room next door, he wrapped an arm around Wen Ni’s waist and pulled her inside, closing the door behind them in one fluid motion.

The entire sequence was smooth and effortless.

"What are you doing! You scared me to death." Wen Ni looked up and saw it was Jian Yuchen, so she retracted the foot she had been about to kick him with.

The man looked down, then took her shopping bag with one hand and rummaged through it. When he saw the style of the swimsuit, Jian Yuchen’s eyelid twitched.

Wen Ni got anxious, "This is the prettiest one in the store, and this red is very vibrant—it really complements my skin tone."

"Fine, go change."

Wen Ni was skeptical, "You're being this easygoing?"

Jian Yuchen gave a mirthless smile, "Yeah, doesn't it complement your skin tone?"

Wen Ni took the swimsuit and looked at him twice more, "Then I'm going to change?"

Jian Yuchen even helpfully opened the bathroom door for her, "Bedroom or bathroom, I'll give you the freedom."

Sarcastic.

Something was very wrong.

The little radar on top of Wen Ni’s head was blaring an alarm.

She silently took two steps back.

"You wouldn't happen to be planning to, while I'm in there~"

Jian Yuchen raised an eyebrow, waiting with interest for her to silently say the correct answer.

However, the tone took a sharp turn.

"Planning to sneak attack me from behind, right? How did you know I bought ice cream! You want to eat it, so you're using this method to stall me and steal it while I'm changing, aren't you!"

"I just stole your last one last night, is it really that serious? You can even smell it!"

"..."

Jian Yuchen couldn't catch his breath. Seeing that the situation was bad, Wen Ni tried to run, but was immediately scooped up by the man and shoved into the bathroom.

"Hey, don't pull so hard, this is expensive!"

"I'll pay you back."

"But I want to wear it tomorrow, you're going this way, ugh, you're so clumsy." Wen Ni was tickled by him.

chapters.title: No Way, Giegie
chapters.content:
Jian Yuchen stepped back a bit. Seeing that he wasn't forcing it anymore, Wen Ni slowly and voluntarily changed her clothes.

To show that this was her room and she couldn't lose her dignity as the host, she tilted her chin up slightly, "10 minutes is enough, right? Hurry up and finish. I have to go downstairs to look at the muscular guys."

Wen Ni felt she was truly beautiful and kind-hearted.

Unlike Jian Yuchen, this capitalist, who insisted on squeezing her even when his wife was on a rare business trip.

How inhumane!

The man gritted his teeth, a cold laugh spilling from his lips, "10 minutes."

"When have you ever been satisfied with 10 minutes?"

Wen Ni’s expression was a bit unnatural, "I can do it in five minutes, don't tell me you can't~"

She even deliberately pinched his shirt collar with a sarcastic tone, provoking him, "No way~ giegie~"

Jian Yuchen revealed his signature cold, sharp canine teeth.

The alarm on top of Wen Ni’s head had reached level one. She tried to run, but was pressed against the mirror by the man.

Before she could even beg for mercy, he bit down on her neck.

"Ahhh, are you a dog!"

The man was ruthless, "Save some energy, don't you still have to go look at your muscular guys later!"

The phone left in her bag kept vibrating.

Downstairs, Sapna looked at her phone, "Strange, Winnie isn't answering."

Taozi looked at the ice cream truck on the beach, "Let's go play first."

"Fine, anyway, she'll see us when she comes down to the beach. Let's go~"

...

"Shameless."

"Mm, want to curse harder?"

"Despicable!"

"Average, I'd say."

"You bastard, you son of a turtle."

Jian Yuchen poked her belly button with his finger, "If I'm a bastard, then you have to give birth to a turtle son for me."

Wen Ni was so angry she tried to scramble up to bite him, only to be pressed back down, eventually ending up like a flipped, dead fish.

-

When Wen Ni finally came downstairs, she covered her reddened eye corners. Although she had indeed gotten her wish to wear the red swimsuit, only that dog Jian Yuchen had seen it!

He had made her wear a pair of denim shorts when she came down—that was his absolute bottom line. After she spun around in front of the mirror, she saw little strawberry marks on her neck, back, and inner thighs!

A scoundrel is a scoundrel.

In the end, she could only frantically cover them with foundation and tie Jian Yuchen’s white shirt around her waist to cover everything above her thighs before coming out.

"Director, you're only coming down now?" Tao Zi, who had returned with a collection of colorful little seashells, asked in surprise at seeing her late arrival.

Wen Ni was listless, her gaze unfocused, still lingering in the afterglow of what had just happened.

"Yeah... where are the others?"

"Yu Xiaozhu and Sapna went to play on the slides, and the others are trying out other water activities. Gu Wang followed them to take beautiful beach photos."

Tao Zi always had a way of being both within and outside of the crowd.

She would participate in group activities, but she always found her own comfortable way to do so.

Wen Ni sat down on the lounge chair next to her.

"What's wrong?" Wen Ni looked warily at the way Tao Zi was eyeing her.

Tao Zi said with a calm expression, "This outfit is actually quite nice. With the swimsuit underneath, your top won't ride up."

The silence from Wen Ni was deafening.

Thanks for the compliment; please don't compliment me again next time.

"Winnie, you finally made it down," Sapna said, returning excitedly with two scoops of ice cream. "A handsome guy just treated me to these."

"You’re late; there was a performance just after you came down. It was so lively."

"I saw it too," Wen Ni said lazily, ordering a watermelon juice.

"Huh? Where did you watch it from? Upstairs? That’s so boring."

Of course it was from upstairs. With such a large floor-to-ceiling window, and her crying and shouting, they certainly had a good time. (;072820Д2820`)

Just as Wen Ni was trying to relax and enjoy the sun and sand, Sapna suddenly shook her arm. "Damn, that handsome guy isn't so great anymore. How could I forget that our company has a top-tier specimen!"

Yu Xiaozhu looked over as well.

In fact, the entire row of people on the lounge chairs turned in unison to look at Jian Yuchen and Ning Yan walking over.

Jian Yuchen was wearing only a pair of loose swimming trunks. His upper body muscles were firm and powerful, and his skin was a natural tone. However, there was always a "vampire elite" vibe about him, and appearing so disheveled suddenly made him incredibly attractive.

A beautiful appearance is always bewitching.

Wen Ni shook her head. This group of people probably didn't know the true face of this wolf-dog!

Jian Yuchen’s gaze drifted over, and he raised his hand slightly to greet them.

"Ahhh!"

"Simon is so handsome!"

Unlike the other sycophants, Wen Ni gave him the middle finger. ╭∩╮

Jian Yuchen shoved his hands into his pockets and gave her a meaningful smile.

Due to their years of marital tacit understanding, Wen Ni understood instantly. He was saying, "Come here."

As if she’d let him win—why would she go over!

However, Ning Yan discovered a beach volleyball court and immediately dragged Jian Yuchen over.

Once the men left, the female colleagues had no more inhibitions.

"With a body like Simon's, no wonder Matthia can't forget him."

"Hey, don't get any ideas. Don't forget why she was cut from the business trip list this time—it was because she tried to throw herself at Simon in the middle of the night during his last trip."

"Men like this are only for looking at from afar; they aren't easy to capture. Even if you were together, you wouldn't feel secure."

"Why?"

"Good body, rich, knows how to dress, and handsome—there are plenty of women who want a catch like this. Look."

Wen Ni followed their gaze. The volleyball court, which had been purely men just a moment ago, was suddenly flooded with hot girls, several of whom were circling Jian Yuchen.

Sapna shrugged and said, "See? Facing so many temptations, it's possible his boat could capsize one day."

Wen Ni bit down hard on her straw. What kind of taste do they have?! Fancying Jian Yuchen.

That double-standard dog! He wouldn't let her wear a sexy swimsuit!

And him?

In broad daylight, preening, disheveled, and indecent!

Wen Ni narrowed her eyes, finished her watermelon juice in one gulp, slammed it on the table, and stood up to head straight for the volleyball court.

"Where is Winnie going?"

"To play!" Wen Ni rotated her wrists and twisted her neck. She was determined to smash his dog head in today.

In college, Wen Ni had dabbled in the school volleyball team. Although she was a substitute, she had experienced the days of having wrists that throbbed with pain.

Jian Yuchen was just about to leave when he saw Wen Ni coming over aggressively from a distance.

Ning Yan was still asking him, "Are we playing? If not, should we just go?"

Jian Yuchen was too much of a magnet for trouble; young girls kept surrounding him, and if a game started, he’d surely be targeted.

Men's jealousy can be terrifying at times.

"Play, why wouldn't I play?"

His sexy hot girl was wearing her little red swimsuit and had joined the battlefield; how could he not play?

Ning Yan: ?

Why do you change your mind every second, kid? Can't you be consistent?

chapters.title: The Flirtatious Wolf-Dog
chapters.content:
"Wen Ni, it's rare to see you take the initiative to participate in sports. How about this: don't play against outsiders. Let's have an internal company team-building match, take a group photo to upload to the company group, and show off our company's style and spirit. We can put it on the public WeChat account later."

As expected of you, thinking about marketing your company wherever you go.

But Wen Ni didn't care, whether it was team-building or playing against outsiders.

She wanted to stand on the opposite side of Jian Yuchen and use a thunderous, invincible spike to hit him right in the face!

Let him go out and be a flirtatious, shameless jerk again!

Not keeping his husbandly duties—if she hadn't dragged him off to be drowned in a pig cage, a face-smashing spike was letting him off easy!

"There are exactly fifteen of us. Let's draw lots to decide who is the referee, who keeps score, and who plays," Ning Yan said. Everyone agreed.

Lily quickly went to borrow a lottery jar.

Wen Ni reached in and drew a red ball.

She then looked provocatively at Jian Yuchen, who had drawn a blue ball. Just, wait, for, it, you!

Jian Yuchen felt she looked like a bristling little wild cat, waiting to scratch him at any moment.

The fun of their marriage seemed to have leveled up.

"Are you having that much fun playing? Why are you smiling so lecherously?" Ning Yan, who had drawn to be a judge, turned and saw Jian Yuchen’s mysterious smile and couldn't help but retort.

Jian Yuchen shrugged, and they took their positions.

Wen Ni grabbed the volleyball. Yu Xiaozhu said awkwardly, "Director, I'm not very good at playing."

"It's fine. I'll handle the serves. If you can return it, great; if it's too far, just toss it to me."

"Okay."

Gu Wang patted Wen Ni on the shoulder. "Director, I'll guard the back for you."

Wen Ni patted her chest. Burn, little Wen Ni!

Challenging the boss, grinding for gear—she was determined to show Jian Yuchen what she was made of today.

"Go, handsome!"

However, at the start, the momentum on both sides was already a bit lopsided.

Wen Ni’s team was ignored, while on Jian Yuchen’s side, hot girls were cheering for him in groups.

Wen Ni: ...

What a realistic society.

She seized the moment. As soon as Tao Zi blew the whistle, Wen Ni tossed the ball high, jumped, and spiked it directly at Jian Yuchen.

The man was prepared and returned it with ease.

Wen Ni knew he had that trick up his sleeve, so she had specifically retreated a bit, caught the ball he sent back, and smashed it right back at him.

Jian Yuchen had also anticipated this and, timing it perfectly, sent the ball back smoothly.

Wen Ni broke into a cold sweat; the ball had almost been spiked into the ground by him just now.

The two of them went back and forth, left and right, up and down.

At first, Gu Wang and the others were waiting in the back to receive the ball.

It turned out that neither of these two intended to let anyone else touch it at all!

Everyone went from being on high alert to standing with their hands on their hips watching, and later, they huddled together to check their phones for nearby milk tea delivery.

Even those hot girls felt it was boring and hurried off to find other handsome men to feast their eyes on.

Sapna sat on a lounge chair next to Ning Yan, bought a coconut, and held it while drinking through a straw.

"Why are these two always at each other's throats when they get together?"

Ning Yan sighed. "You get used to it."

Great minds think alike; Sapna decided to clink her coconut with his.

Wen Ni played without stopping. The score was currently tied.

It was haunted—every time she got a lead, Jian Yuchen would catch up.

And then she had to keep playing him until she was exhausted! She was wearing herself out.

What a vicious man, actually trying to wear her out with a war of attrition.

Trying to let her, a delicate flower of the motherland, get sun-scorched to death here!

I, Wen Ni, will absolutely not surrender to such dark forces!

Just as Wen Ni decided to give it her all in the last few rounds to smash Jian Yuchen, she heard her dear teammates praising the dog-man's physique.

"Simon usually wears a suit and doesn't show anything, but now that he's taken it off, you can see he's so well-built. Every muscle wasn't grown for nothing."

"The point is, when he works out, his jaw doesn't get puffy and his neck doesn't get thick. Such sensible muscles."

"I want to ask if he takes private clients. My core strength has been weak lately."

"..." Wen Ni was furious.

Can't you see the kind, excellent, diligent, and hardworking Design Director, me, Wen Ni!

My body is also... forget it, it's completely covered up by that scoundrel Jian Yuchen.

You can't see a damn thing.

The ball suddenly landed on the net. Wen Ni said listlessly, "I'm not playing anymore. I need a break."

Both her arms felt like they were going to fall off, and combined with the workout he gave her this afternoon, her waist and legs were sore. She had really risked her life trying to beat him, and she hadn't even managed to hit him.

Jian Yuchen followed her silently with his hands in his pockets.

Wen Ni grabbed her phone, intending to see if there was a sausage grill so she could buy some high-calorie food to fill the void left by her colleagues' hurtful comments.

She didn't look back at all.

"Hello, I'd like a hot dog, a side of crispy fries, and a Coke."

"Two cups." The man’s lazy voice sounded from behind her.

Wen Ni turned around and brushed past him.

"Why are you leaning so close? Aren't you afraid of being seen!" Wen Ni was startled.

Jian Yuchen raised an eyebrow. "Doing something bad behind my back? You're scared like this—what a disgrace."

Wen Ni retorted, "I’m a fine, upstanding youth of the modern era. How is it that nothing good ever comes out of your foul mouth?"

"Oh? This foul mouth of mine kissed you just a few hours ago. Do you want to taste it yourself?"

Wen Ni got anxious. "We’re out in public! Watch your behavior. If someone calls the police and you get hauled away, don't expect me to save you."

After saying this, Wen Ni noticed others were looking at Jian Yuchen.

She grabbed the roasted sausages and popcorn. "You, come with me!"

Jian Yuchen obediently carried the two cups of cola, paid, and followed.

Once they reached a more secluded changing area, Wen Ni dropped the act. "Who told you to come down wearing only swimming trunks! I don't have my freedom, so what right do you have to dress so provocatively?"

"My only casual shirt is on you. Do you expect me to come down in a suit?" Jian Yuchen countered.

Wen Ni looked left and right, then pointed at the old woman selling floral shirts nearby. "Then go buy one of those. It’s 20 yuan; a bargain for you."

Jian Yuchen had likely never worn such gaudy clothing in his life.

"You really want me to wear that?"

"Are you unwilling?"

"Because you're jealous?"

Wen Ni took a fierce bite of the large sausage, her small mouth glistening with oil. "Yeah, I'm so jealous. I want to see my husband wear it."

Wen Ni wanted to see him make a fool of himself, but the man was pleased by the words "jealous" and "husband."

"Fine, I'll satisfy you."

He walked straight toward the old woman. Wen Ni followed him, giggling, and picked out the ugliest one, the kind middle-aged uncles wear.

As it turned out, Jian Yuchen threw it on, and he somehow looked like a protagonist from a Hong Kong film—rogueish yet with a hint of seriousness.

He effortlessly brought out his aura of being both righteous and wicked to the fullest.

Wen Ni: ...

Do these people have any aesthetic sense at all? Why are they praising him again! (

chapters.title: Eating Everything Keeps You Nutritionally Balanced)
chapters.content:
"Where did you two go? I was just about to look for you." Ning Yan waved at them.

Then his gaze landed on Jian Yuchen, who was wearing the floral shirt behind Wen Ni.

Ning Yan couldn't help it; he frowned and said, "Jian Yuchen, if you're being threatened, blink your eyes."

Sapna walked over and took a look. "I think it actually looks quite good. Which brand is it? It’s got a touch of 'yuppie' in the casual style."

Wen Ni sighed expressionlessly. "Is it possible that the rate of wearing the same outfit on this beach is a bit high?"

In fact, there were too many people wearing floral shirts, but most people wouldn't actually buy one as ugly as this.

Tao Zi held her cola and leaned in. "Hmm, fun fact: the completion of a fashion look depends on the face."

Yu Xiaozhu nodded. "That makes sense."

Wen Ni was completely defeated by this group. How was it that not a single person was on her side?

Ning Yan patted Jian Yuchen on the shoulder. "I'm going to go get one too. Hey, Wen Ni, don't go that way; I've booked a barbecue stall."

Wen Ni followed the direction he was pointing and realized that Gu Wang, Frits, and the others had already started grilling.

The evening sunset shone on the beach, making even everyone's hair strands glow.

Wen Ni felt half her face burning; she figured she’d probably gain two pounds tonight.

Fortunately, her exercise level for the afternoon was off the charts, so she could afford to burn some off.

Sapna was on a diet and only took a few vegetable skewers, planning to stick to a vegetarian barbecue route.

Wen Ni snatched a few lettuce leaves from her, wrapped up some grilled meat, and shoved it into her mouth.

Seeing that Frits and the others weren't grilling properly, Jian Yuchen simply took over himself.

Those who were full and satisfied began heading to the night party. After all, there was a bonfire party and truth-or-dare over there, and the noisy music and the surging pheromones were far more tempting than barbecue.

Before long, only Jian Yuchen, who was still grilling, and Wen Ni, who was still stuffing her face, were left on their side.

"Handsome, want to come play cards with us?"

Wen Ni bit viciously into her lettuce-wrapped meat, but Jian Yuchen lifted his eyelids and said, "Sorry, my wife is strict. If you come talk to me again, she's going to whip me when we get home."

"Cough, cough, cough..." Wen Ni, who had been pricking up her little ears to eavesdrop, nearly choked to death on the lettuce wrap.

The spicy girl's gaze landed on Wen Ni, then she gave an awkward smile. "Sorry, I thought you were single."

Why would a married couple sit so far apart?

But looking closer, it seemed... strangely doting.

He grilled, she ate.

Wen Ni’s face flushed red. "Are you trying to kill me?"

Jian Yuchen flipped the meat. "I wouldn't dare. Right, bed-partner?"

"There was too much powder on that just now, add some sauce. No, why are you changing the subject? Despicable."

"I grilled you some meat, you don't have to call me 'Baby' so happily."

?

Wen Ni was just about to turn and curse him, but Jian Yuchen had already placed a plate of grilled squid in front of her.

Wen Ni loved squid legs. She picked them up and said with an unnatural expression, "Just this once, don't make it a habit. I can't be bought by you every time."

Look at that holy, inviolable appearance.

Yet, tears were practically sliding down from the corners of her mouth.

"Actually, looking at it this way, it feels like the relationship between Simon and Winnie isn't that bad."

"You think so too? Sometimes I feel there's a forbidden 'love-hate' vibe between Simon and her. It's quite fun to ship."

Tao Zi poked her head out from the corner, narrowed her eyes, and said, "Same."

"So you all have that feeling too," Lily chimed in.

Gu Wang picked up his camera and took a photo of the two of them from behind as they looked at each other.

Honestly, without hearing the two of them spewing venom and trading barbs, just looking at their backs, one could really imagine a lot.

Moreover, Gu Wang’s candid shot was excellent; the moon was rising over the sea, fireworks were blooming in the distance, and they were looking at each other.

"Ah~ I could imagine a million-word modern romance novel of love and hate from this."

"Am I the only one who thinks this scene belongs in a Japanese midnight ramen anime? Like, the next second they'll find a small grove and do the deed?"

Everyone smiled meaningfully. "That's not impossible either."

Sure enough, shipping everything just keeps us nutritionally balanced.

"Hiccup~" Wen Ni burped, then looked down at her little belly.

Good heavens, anyone who didn't know would think she was three months pregnant.

She tried to suck in her stomach, but the man had already extinguished the stove and walked up to her. "Want to get some exercise?"

Wen Ni’s stretching motion froze halfway, and she glared at him viciously. "I’m warning you, workplace sexual harassment is not allowed even for married couples."

"I’m inviting you for a night stroll. What kind of messy things are you thinking about all day long?"

"Even if you want to, I need to recover my energy, don't I? Don't be too insatiable; it's not good for your health."

After the man finished speaking, he successfully watched Wen Ni fly into a rage, picking up a large inflatable hammer from the side to chase him down.

"What are they playing now?" How could the script go from a Japanese romantic fireworks festival to a martial arts battle in the blink of an eye?

"Zhong Wuyan fighting Li Bai, perhaps..."

Looking at Wen Ni’s "80-damage" hammer swing and Jian Yuchen’s agile dodging, it was truly the atmosphere of a bickering couple.

"What are you watching?" Ning Yan came over to watch with them.

"Mr. Ning, we were saying that Simon and the others are so fun to ship."

Ning Yan was surprised. "You can ship them? I'm afraid you'll get indigestion. There's no way these two will have a thing."

"Why?"

"This kid Jian Yuchen seems to have someone he likes." Ning Yan pondered for a moment, feeling like he’d said too much. "Anyway, it won't be Wen Ni."

If he liked Wen Ni, he wouldn't waste time bickering like a grade-schooler.

They would have been together long ago.

Adult love is always a dark fairy tale, wanting to possess the other person.

Childhood is much purer; liking someone is sometimes the starting point, and also the end.

At the age when one can cast aside all money, status, and external conditions for love, yet is powerless to protect it—that is everyone's regret.

So, at Jian Yuchen's age, being such a deep and calculating guy, if the woman he truly liked was right in front of him, would he just watch and do nothing?

Once Ning Yan left, the group was shocked.

"Simon has someone he likes?"

"It wouldn't be someone from our company, would it?"

"Doesn't look like it. Could it be a man?"

The topic was successfully derailed by Ning Yan.

When Wen Ni returned to her hotel room, she was half-dead from exhaustion. Having just eaten, she had spent the time on the beach上演 "beating her husband to death," which had drained her.

"Going to my room?" Jian Yuchen followed her; the hallway was empty.

"No."

"How can you sleep on those sheets?"

When Wen Ni remembered what happened, she realized he was right, and suddenly her anger flared. "It’s all your fault."

"Forget it, come to my place to wash up first. You can come back and change clothes tomorrow morning." The man scooped her up by the waist and turned into his room.

Shen Huaixu stepped away from the drinking party. His secretary handed him a bottle of water. Shen Huaixu said thank you, then opened his phone, specifically finding Ning Yan's social media feed to click on it.

Sure enough, Ning Yan had uploaded a group photo of the small circle at the beach.

Wen Ni was leaning in the back, smiling at the sparkler in front. When his gaze shifted to the side, he saw Jian Yuchen, who was looking at Wen Ni the whole time.

He was turning his head; from this angle, it looked like he was looking at the lighthouse behind Wen Ni.

It seemed careless, like a random snapshot.

But he just knew.

Jian Yuchen was looking at Wen... (

chapters.title: Is Wen Ni the Same?)
chapters.content:
"Mr. Shen."

Shen Huaixu let the screen go dark before putting it away, saying slowly, "Are the seats for tomorrow's bidding conference all arranged?"

"They should all be deployed."

"Have them changed. Move Ling Du up."

"Now?"

"Is there a problem?"

"No."

Shen Huaixu took a drag of his cigarette. The secretary notified the person in charge of seating, specifically glanced at Shen Huaixu, and then emphasized to the other party, "The designer must be in the front, sitting with the leaders of her department."

"How long have you been with me?"

Shen Huaixu asked suddenly.

The secretary was stunned and answered honestly, "Over two years."

"What kind of person do you think I am?"

The secretary thought for a moment. "Professional, with a keen eye..."

"No, not from that perspective," Shen Huaixu narrowed his eyes. "From a woman's perspective of a man."

Having been with him for so long, the secretary naturally knew a bit about his private life.

"Does Mr. Shen want the truth or a lie?"

Shen Huaixu smiled. "The truth, naturally."

The secretary took a deep breath. "As a boss, Mr. Shen, you are indeed a good leader. But as a boyfriend, well, if it were me, I probably wouldn't consider it."

Shen Huaixu flicked the ash off his cigarette. "May I ask why?"

The secretary pondered. "Perhaps it’s not pleasant to hear, but based on the two years I’ve spent by your side and having witnessed the state of your three previous girlfriends, I’ve discovered that you actually love yourself more. When a partner can no longer extract more affection from you, you find them tiresome.
