It’s a recurring cycle, unless you are willing to find a woman who is willing to sacrifice herself entirely to the point of having no self, someone who revolves around your life and can be satisfied by a single glance from you."

"You don't necessarily love her much, but she must love you very much. Of course, this is just my personal opinion, it has no real reference value."

Shen Huaixu chuckled. "Good."

He looked at the door of the private room, thinking of Wen Ni from earlier today.

In truth, she was completely different from how she was in high school.

Back in high school, Wen Ni could at most be considered a girl with a personality. Beneath her well-behaved exterior, those eyes were full of spirit and an unyielding tenacity, and she would always say something surprising to attract attention.

Now, at first glance, Wen Ni only felt like a mature woman with charm; her first impression was clean, crisp, capable, and shrewd.

He was very curious about who her man was now, and if she had ever been heartbroken for anyone.

Shen Huaixu suddenly remembered the time he had just gone abroad; he hadn't told Wen Ni.

Later, after settling down in the United States, he contacted a classmate back home and heard a piece of gossip: it was said that on the day he left the country, Wen Ni cried very sadly, as if her heart were broken.

What was he thinking at that time? Perhaps mostly pride, mixed with a little heartache.

But as these years passed, it seemed that his initial feelings of liking someone had all been given to Wen Ni.

It wasn't mixed with any other reasons—not because of how good the other person's figure was, or how superior their family background was—it was just that she attracted him. He had never even thought about having anything with her.

Wen Ni.

Did she feel the same way?

-

"Jian Yuchen, I didn't bring my facial cleanser and those things."

Wen Ni complained in the bathroom.

Jian Yuchen walked in, reached into the pockets of the shorts at her waist, and found the room card. "Did you put them in the suitcase?"

"Yeah, in the usual spot."

"Wait there."

Wen Ni was used to being laid-back; if he really waited for her to go get them, it would take forever.

"Then, while you're at it, bring my sheet masks. I want the repair kind; I think I got sunburned this afternoon, my face is flushed." She muttered to herself in front of the mirror.

Jian Yuchen quickly swiped the card to enter her room and dragged her suitcase over.

As he closed the door and walked to the entrance, he saw Ning Yan standing at the door.

Ning Yan looked at him in shock as he emerged from the room next door.

"Did I remember wrong? Is this your room? Where are you going in the middle of the night?"

Ning Yan immediately walked toward him.

Jian Yuchen felt a headache coming on. "Are you looking for me?"

"Yeah, looking for you to have a couple of drinks."

"Let's go." Ning Yan said, reaching to open the door.

Wen Ni's clothes were still laid out on the bed; Jian Yuchen hadn't packed them into the suitcase at all.

And the level of mess in that room—any adult could figure out what was going on.

Jian Yuchen immediately blocked him and bit the bullet, saying, "I went to the wrong room. This is someone else's room; mine is next door."

"Huh? Then how did you get in?" Ning Yan lowered his voice and quickly helped him close the door.

"The door wasn't latched properly." Jian Yuchen walked to his own door.

"I'm not feeling well. I'll treat you to a drink tomorrow."

Ning Yan frowned, snatched the room card from Jian Yuchen, and swiped it open.

"If you say you're not feeling well, how can I just stand by and do nothing? We've been friends for so many years; do you still treat me like an outsider?"

Ning Yan pushed the door open and entered. Jian Yuchen grabbed his wrist from behind, his gaze fixed on the room.

"What's wrong?" Ning Yan looked at him with a strange expression. "Don't tell me you're hiding a woman in here, to be this scared."

He walked forward on his own and sat on the sofa in the lounge. "The bar on the first floor here has such good wine; I specifically came up to have a drink with you to relieve some stress."

Jian Yuchen's gaze fell on the bathroom, and he realized Wen Ni was no longer there.

He moved the suitcase to the corner.

Ning Yan had intended to ask why he was only getting the suitcase now.

But men were usually too lazy to pursue such trivial matters; after all, he wasn't Jian Yuchen's woman.

"What percentage of certainty do you think there is in what Shen Huaixu told us?"

Jian Yuchen opened the closet to look, finding that Wen Ni was not there.

He frowned and answered Ning Yan's question. "Anyway, I've made it very clear to you: his intentions are not what they seem."

He walked to the desk to open his laptop, but his leg was suddenly pinched. Jian Yuchen sat down calmly. This was a suite layout; the entire hotel mimicked an American resort style, and the desk was a heavy, solid wood piece that reached the floor. Wen Ni was curled up in the kneehole of the desk, and Ning Yan, sitting opposite, couldn't detect her at all.

Jian Yuchen hadn't expected her to be able to hide there so quickly. If she weren't a girl who had grown up under his very eyes, he would have thought this was the result of years of professional training.

He stared at her, while Ning Yan had already started speaking, "Why do I feel like you have a major grudge against him? Did you lose to him in a game before?"

"Him?" Jian Yuchen unlocked the computer.

Ning Yan found it amusing, shook his head, stood up, walked over to him, and handed him a glass. "It's rare to see you have such childish emotions toward anyone other than Wen Ni."

Even in the workplace, adults have to wear masks; no matter how much they dislike someone, they wouldn't show it.

"I work hard to make money so I don't have to look at anyone else's face; I've already suffered enough grievances." As soon as Jian Yuchen finished this sentence with a straight face, the hair on his leg was plucked.

Wen Ni was still twisting it above.

Ning Yan leaned against the desk, completely unaware of Jian Yuchen's abnormality.

"Speaking of which, why did you decide to invest in Lingdu?" Ning Yan frowned. "I remember you never took a liking to small companies back then."

Jian Yuchen saw Wen Ni perk up her little ears, and the corners of his lips curled. "There's a sense of accomplishment in turning a small company into a big one, isn't there?"

chapters.title: Do Me a Favor
chapters.content:
Ning Yan nodded. "That's true, you've always liked a challenge."

"What's wrong with you tonight?" Jian Yuchen noticed he was acting a bit strange.

Ning Yan turned around. "I heard that Shangmei went to invite Shen Huaixu to dinner tonight. Do you think we're being a bit too honest?"

Shangmei was considered Lingdu's arch-rival.

The two companies often clashed when competing for projects.

In recent years, Shangmei had been having some difficulties, while Lingdu had been rising too rapidly.

"You're only hearing this news now? Have you been slacking off lately?" Jian Yuchen leaned back in his chair.

Ning Yan also clicked his tongue. "I was having too much fun today; I didn't even think Shangmei would be waiting for me here."

"Don't worry, tonight they will only get the same result as us. Shen Huaixu won't give them any particularly clear direction."

Ning Yan frowned. "How are you so sure? I was afraid Shen Huaixu was just playing with us."

"Because he just cast the bait, and the fish hasn't taken it yet—why would he pull in the net?" Jian Yuchen watched as Wen Ni was about to twist his leg hair into a bow.

He kicked her butt with his foot.

Wen Ni glared at him fiercely from under the desk.

His phone buzzed in his pocket.

Ning Yan looked at his own phone and said anxiously, "If we don't get a definite answer tonight, I think I'll have insomnia tomorrow."

"Why do you think those old guys at Shangmei are always biting at us?"

"Is it possible that the people at Shangmei are thinking the same thing about you?" Jian Yuchen saw Wen Ni take out her phone to check a message, and he poked her waist with his toe.

Wen Ni was provoked and opened her mouth to bite him. Jian Yuchen sat lower, signaling her not to bite his leg.

There were naturally better places for her to bite.

Wen Ni rolled her eyes dramatically. She swiped her phone and realized it was a text message.

[Why didn't you add me as a friend? - Shen]

Shen Huaixu?

Wen Ni suddenly remembered that time after PE class when he had stopped her.

Shen Huaixu's family was wealthy, and his father was a leader of a large group; when parents' meetings were held, the car parked at the entrance was extremely flashy.

Shen Huaixu had good grades and looked clean and handsome, so he was quite popular in school.

So, when he suddenly stopped Wen Ni, quite a few people in the class looked back at them even after walking past.

At that age, one is very sensitive to contact with the opposite sex.

Wen Ni saw that class was about to end, and there would be even more people in the hallway.

"Is there something you need from me?"

Shen Huaixu rubbed his nose. "Do you want to be my girlfriend?"

"No." Wen Ni refused without even thinking.

Shen Huaixu was stunned. It was his first time being so bold in talking to a girl, and he truly hadn't expected to be rejected.

"May I ask why?"

Wen Ni turned to look at him, looking puzzled. "Why would I need a reason? No means no."

After saying that, Wen Ni walked away on her own.

But Shen Huaixu was clearly quite persistent.

He started showing up on weekends, during cleaning duty, and even followed behind when she went to buy milk tea with her classmates.

When Wen Ni helped keep score during PE class, he would also bring water to share with everyone and then naturally sit beside her.

"So, can you be my girlfriend now?"

"No." Wen Ni looked at the comic book in her hand and took a bite of her popsicle.

"What exactly is wrong with me? Can you tell me?" Shen Huaixu asked with a good temper.

Wen Ni looked at him with a half-smile. "Don't do this, brother. I thought I was being quite obvious."

Shen Huaixu's smile stiffened on his face. "Huh?"

"You came to find me because you made a bet with someone, right?" Wen Ni said, looking at the court. "Don't tell me I don't want to risk being discovered by my parents for puppy love; even if I really wanted to secretly find a boyfriend, I wouldn't consider someone like you, who uses someone else's sincerity to trade for your boring bets."

Shen Huaixu truly hadn't expected that Wen Ni would know.

"So you've been watching me act this whole time?"

"Yeah, but you're just thicker-skinned than I thought."

A normal person should have retreated in the face of her attitude.

But he just didn't get it.

Wen Ni couldn't be bothered to give him any face.

Shen Huaixu saw that he had been exposed, so he simply stated his purpose directly.

"That is true."

Wen Ni continued eating her popsicle. The manga’s main characters were at their most heartbreaking moment, and she wanted to be fully immersed in the reading.

However, Shen Huaixu, that buzzing fly, was still droning in her ear.

"Aren't you going to ask why you were chosen?"

Wen Ni didn't even turn her head. "Consider it my bad luck for not checking the almanac when I went out that day. You guys were just pointing fingers at random; whoever you pointed at was just unlucky. What, do you want me to send you a silk banner to thank you for picking me? Should I personally write a big 'Service Department' sign and deliver it to your class?"

"You're acting like you're picking a concubine, and you still have the nerve to ask why I was chosen?" Wen Ni rattled off, her little mouth moving a mile a minute.

Shen Huaixu perked up. "Why couldn't it be because you are lively, cute, and clever?"

"I do have those traits, but you should look at whether you're worthy of them!"

If Shen Huaixu wanted to see Wen Ni blush and say "I hate you" before stomping away, he could forget it.

It would be faster to try someone else.

Except for Wen Zhiwen, Wen Ni treated everyone the same way.

That is: I’ve already shown you my best manners, so don't provoke me! I can go crazy at any moment.

Shen Huaixu said, "But if I lose, I have to give away my limited edition signed basketball."

"What does that have to do with me?" Wen Ni prepared to plug her ears.

"How about this, I'll rent you for two days?"

"This lady is too noble~ you aren't worthy." Although this statement was incredibly chuunibyou, Wen Ni felt it represented her spirit of "neither riches nor honors can corrupt, and neither poverty nor lowliness can make one swerve."

As for mere money, no matter how greedy she was, she had to earn it herself.

This kind of ill-gotten gain was not appropriate.

"Then, until the end of this semester, I'll do your physics homework for you. How about that?"

Wen Ni’s hand paused, and her momentum deflated by half.

She had almost become a regular on the physics blacklist this semester.

The physics teacher got a headache just seeing her.

Every time that guy Jian Yuchen took first place, Wen Ni could hear that familiar line in the office.

"Look at Jian Yuchen, and then look at yourself!"

"..."

Wen Ni glanced at him. "Are you good at physics?"

"Tied with Jian Yuchen. Want to consider it?"

Tied with Jian Yuchen—wouldn't that be top of the grade?

Wen Ni was slightly swayed.

"Just doing my homework isn't enough."

Wen Ni put away her book. "You have to give me private tutoring. If my grades don't improve, I'll tell everyone the truth: that you couldn't get a girl and tried to bribe the victim. Your despicable and shameless behavior will be spread far and wide!"

Shen Huaixu didn't expect to have to tutor her. "I remember last semester, your physics score was only 20, right?"

"21! What do you mean 'only 20'? There was that 1 point!"

"Fine. It's a deal."

"Hey."

Wen Ni called him back, took out her pink sticky note pad, and wrote down the agreement.

"Sign it. Empty words won't do."

"You're quite cautious." Shen Huaixu signed it without a word.

"Alright, the cooperation is established."

Wen Ni patted it casually. A contract boyfriend, and he still wanted to hold hands with her? No way.

As soon as Shen Huaixu went to play basketball, the girls in the class ran over. "Wen Ni, what were you and Shen Huaixu talking about just now? Is he chasing you? Are you two dating?"

Wen Ni remembered what just happened and pursed her lips. "Yeah, we're together."

"Bang—" A loud noise startled Wen Ni and the girls.

"It's Jian Yuchen. Why is he making such a scene just taking out the trash?"

chapters.title: You're Quite Good at Playing Games
chapters.content:
The young man glanced at her coldly, then walked past them with a dark face.

Wen Ni came to her senses and asked the others, "Did he glare at me just now?"

"Isn't your relationship with him always a bit rocky?"

"Probably just because he's arrogant."

"..."

Thanks, your comfort was great; don't do it again next time.

The memory was forced to a halt.

Because Wen Ni's waist was suddenly lifted, and her phone fell to the floor.

With a "slap," a large palm landed directly on her bottom.

She was surprised to find that Ning Yan had left at some point, and Jian Yuchen had pressed her onto the desk, looking like he wanted to strike a second time.

"What are you doing!" Wen Ni wouldn't just let him have his way.

"Cheating behind my back?" the man said gloomily, pressing down on her waist and picking up the phone that was still lit up from the floor.

He knew it was that brat Shen Huaixu, whose heart was still set on her.

But what made him even more annoyed was that Wen Ni had actually stared at this text message for quite a while.

She hadn't even heard what Ning Yan said about the design direction at the end.

Wen Ni was speechless. "Who's cheating! Did I contact him first?"

Jian Yuchen poked her waist with his finger. "Then how do you plan to reply to this text?"

"Block him, obviously."

"Not afraid of offending a client now?"

Wen Ni was no longer the reckless college student who had just entered society.

Going head-to-head with a client only to compromise for reality later—she wasn't the female lead of a "face-slapping" web novel with golden fingers. As long as the pay was good and the client was satisfied, she could smile and swallow her pride.

True revenge was making a killing off these people.

It wasn't like there hadn't been male clients who saw she was single, young, and pretty and had ulterior motives before.

From successful 40-something divorcees with kids to fresh single graduates, she had dealt with persistent pursuers before, and Wen Ni could always handle them properly.

But Shen Huaixu was different.

For those other men, if they couldn't get what they wanted, Wen Ni never gave them any interaction outside of work.

After a while, it would just blow over.

But Shen Huaixu, as her standard high school scandal-contract-ex-boyfriend, sending this text message—publicly or privately—should not receive a response.

"He didn't even contact me during work hours. Look at what time it is; finding me in the middle of the night, everyone knows what he's up to." Wen Ni was actually very annoyed by this lack of boundaries.

Jian Yuchen leaned down and pressed against her. "For real?"

"Are you done or not?" Wen Ni tried to get up, but he flipped her over.

"A classmate reported that you brought your phone to school, and I actually found it."

Wen Ni raised an eyebrow, cursing him for being a pervert in her heart—he was already reacting after just a moment.

And he was immediately playing some kind of "school campus" roleplay, wasn't he?

Married for three years, the two of them had a bit of a tacit understanding in this regard.

She immediately softened her body, supporting herself with her arms, and said in a pitiful tone, "Senior, can you not tell the teacher?"

"That's against student council rules." Jian Yuchen's gaze fell on her white shirt. "Still stealing my clothes to wear?"

"As long as you don't tell the teacher, I~ I'll let you do whatever you want."

"So obedient?" Jian Yuchen's tone was full of a sigh, his fingers slowly landing on the buttons of her shirt.

"Take it off yourself, or should I help you?"

"But class just ended, and there are still people on the court... someone will find out." Wen Ni bit her lower lip.

Jian Yuchen’s Adam's apple rolled, and he cursed inwardly: *Damn it.*

She even had the script ready?

The man narrowed his eyes. "Isn't that more exciting? Isn't that what you want—to be seen?"

Wen Ni despised Jian Yuchen's twisted tastes in her heart, but she still wanted to be coy and find an opportunity to run.

Playing a little game of "Oh, Great King, come and chase me."

Jian Yuchen took two steps, picked her up horizontally, and placed her on the solid wood desk.

The American-style dark green Republic-era bank lamp swayed with her movements. The man leaned down, reached out to pick up the fountain pen on the desk, and the cold touch circled her leg. "Not obedient."

"Lying children have to be punished."

"Senior~ did you close the door tight?" She pressed her feet against Jian Yuchen's shoulders, making a final confirmation.

Jian Yuchen was in a hurry to get down to business, and being asked this made him feel she was too "out of character."

"Best Actress Wen, your acting skills have declined lately."

He picked her up directly, still holding the pen in one hand, and walked toward the door.

Wen Ni was terrified that Ning Yan might open the door and walk in, scaring her to death.

Hanging lazily on Jian Yuchen, she said, "Best Actor Jian hasn't acted with me in years; could it be that you're jealous of my career development?"

Jian Yuchen bit her earlobe, his voice hoarse. "Yeah, jealous to the point of madness. Jealous of every man who acts with you, jealous of them holding you, embracing you, and even kissing you in broad daylight~"

*Whoa*, he was acting like it was real.

Wen Ni was thrown onto the bed, hooking her arms around his neck.

"But with my market value, if you sleep with me once, I'm afraid you'll go bankrupt."

Jian Yuchen tore her shirt open. "Then I'll work hard to be a capitalist for once."

...

"No!"

"What now?"

"I haven't taken off my makeup yet."

It was this damn makeup removal again.

"Then what do I do? It's already like this."

"You just have to endure it. You can do it, Master!"

"You rebellious disciple..."

-

7:00 AM

As soon as Wen Ni's alarm went off, the two of them opened their suitcases and started looking for clothes.

"I packed a pair of flat shoes for you; they go perfectly with those casual suit pants. In case you have to go to the construction site, heels won't be convenient."

"OK." Wen Ni found the shoes he mentioned, put them on, and squeezed in next to Jian Yuchen to look in the mirror.

Then she was surprised to find that they were wearing the same color scheme today.

"Us like this, isn't it a bit obvious?"

"First, cover the hickey on your neck. Who in the company would care about this?"

"Even so~ it's a guilty conscience, you know."

Wen Ni picked up the foundation. "Should I touch up yours too?"

"What does it matter if a man like me gets gossiped about? Besides, I'm already 'gay,' what else could they say? That I'm looking for a gigolo in the middle of the night?"

"Wow, another piece of gossip to listen to."

Jian Yuchen was speechless. Wen Ni was probably the only person left in the world who enjoyed watching her own husband make a fool of himself.

She was truly a rare specimen among wives.

Wen Ni finished her makeup quickly, grabbed her computer, and looked at her watch. "They're all waiting for me in the restaurant on the second floor. See you later."

"Yeah." Jian Yuchen still had to shave.

As soon as Wen Ni went downstairs, she found Frits was also there.

"The breakfast at this hotel is pretty good." Sapna helped Wen Ni pull out a chair.

"Thanks." Wen Ni put down her computer bag, got her breakfast, and when she returned, she found Jian Yuchen and Ning Yan coming down together.

"Everyone, eat a hearty breakfast this morning. The people from Shangmei are here too, and we have a tough battle ahead of us, so keep your spirits up!"

"Understood, Mr. Ning."

Sapna glanced at Jian Yuchen, then her gaze fixed on his neck.

She then silently lowered her eyes, wondering where Jian Yuchen had gone to have his fun last night.

*First Day of the Business Trip,

chapters.title: Their Synchronized Actions
chapters.content:
In fact, Jian Yuchen had no intention of hiding it.

After the meal, everyone’s eyes fell, intentionally or otherwise, onto Jian Yuchen’s neck.

Only Ning Yan, taking advantage of the moment they were getting into the car, whispered, "Do you have mites? How did you get that on your neck?"

It wasn't that Ning Yan was simply ignorant of such matters between men and women; it was just that when he left last night, Jian Yuchen was about to go to sleep, and he wasn't the type to fool around the night before a business trip.

Therefore, he hadn't even considered that possibility.

Jian Yuchen raised an eyebrow, too lazy to answer such a stupid question.

The hotel was not far from the Jinfeng headquarters.

Only three companies remained for this bidding meeting. Who would ultimately win the design rights for Jinfeng would depend entirely on their own abilities.

Among them, Weifeng was an old design firm with a solid reputation in the industry. President Wei of Weifeng had founded the company after retiring from a state-owned enterprise. Their design style was grand and imposing, but the only drawback was that it felt slightly mechanical—mature, yes, but lacking in eye-catching appeal.

Lingdu, on the other hand, excelled in the seamless fusion of trendy and classical elements, showing a better understanding of contemporary mainstream aesthetics.

As for Shangmei Advertising, it was a subsidiary that had been opened halfway through the process. Its designers were all poached from other firms, and the team was still in the process of finding its rhythm. However, their advantage was that they were "connected"—being officially under the Shangmei Advertising umbrella gave them a powerful backer.

Most importantly, the boss, Hou Jinming, was as cunning as his name suggested (a "monkey-smart" person). His wife provided significant support, and he was practically wearing his reliance on nepotism on his sleeve.

Since he had marital ties to Jinfeng, winning this contract was a sure thing. As he walked toward them, he was beaming with success.

"Isn't this Mr. Ning? It's been a long time," Hou Jinming said, putting on a look of great surprise and rushing over to shake Ning Yan's hand firmly.

Wen Ni glanced at the team of designers Hou Jinming had brought. When she saw Shi Yue, she looked at her with surprise.

Shi Yue had already anticipated running into her and had no intention of striking up a conversation.

Wen Ni felt a strange bitterness in her heart; after all, they had been roommates in college.

Even if they were in different camps now, there was no need to act like strangers, was there?

"Director Wen is still as beautiful as ever." Hou Jinming turned to shake Wen Ni's hand. Wen Ni gave a perfunctory shake and let go. "Mr. Hou is joking."

"Who doesn't know that Director Wen is your ace at Lingdu? If your Mr. Ning ever treats you poorly, feel free to come to us at Shangmei."

"Hey, hey, hey, why are you poaching talent right in front of me? That’s not appropriate, Old Hou," Ning Yan said, blocking Wen Ni.

Hou Jinming laughed. "You’re still so narrow-minded. What’s wrong with me saying a few words to a beautiful woman?"

Watching Ning Yan and Hou Jinming enter the Jinfeng Group building first, Wen Ni and her team followed.

The two companies kept to themselves, even taking separate elevators to go upstairs.

When they arrived at the conference room, the people from Weifeng were already seated according to the nameplates.

Wen Ni searched the second and third rows for a while before realizing her seat was next to Ning Yan.

And right next to that was Shen Huaixu.

Seeing this arrangement, Wen Ni couldn't help but frown, feeling annoyed by Shen Huaixu’s blatant behavior.

It would put her in the spotlight for all the wrong reasons.

Just then, Wen Ni’s nameplate was removed.

She looked up and saw Jian Yuchen placing his own nameplate in her spot, then handing hers to her, signaling for her to sit behind him.

Wen Ni breathed a sigh of relief and sat down immediately.

Fortunately, everyone else was busy finding their seats and didn't notice the small exchange.

Wen Ni was surrounded by the design team. Since they were all peers and competitors, there wasn't much to say.

Soon, several Jinfeng executives arrived one after another.

After Shen Huaixu finished his self-introduction, he looked over and saw that the seat had been changed to Jian Yuchen. A flash of understanding crossed his eyes.

"Since everyone is here, let's begin."

Around the Lunar New Year, more than 20 companies had met with Jinfeng, and Lingdu had narrowly won. Now, they were back at the same starting line as the other two firms.

Weifeng had also heard some rumors.

The business world is like a battlefield. Having nepotism is, in itself, a form of strength, so most people felt that Lingdu was likely to lose this time.

However, seeing them return, people were curious to see what their previous designs had been like.

As the first to arrive, Weifeng’s designers were the first to take the stage.

Wang Linmu leaned toward Wen Ni. "Director, I think their design style has changed this time."

"You noticed it too?"

Previously, Weifeng was often criticized for having a "straight-man aesthetic." But their strength lay in being classic and enduring. Although it was slightly mechanical and didn't fit the architectural standards of today's youth, that very sense of groundedness made it timeless, which was why it was still popular among old-school entrepreneurs.

At the very least, several of the older Jinfeng leaders were nodding along.

After about half an hour, Weifeng’s changes were significant, and Wen Ni couldn't help but tense up.

Yu Xiaozhu’s palms were sweating. As an intern, this was her first time participating in such a large project. If they lost, it would be a rich experience, but it also meant she would lose a better entry for her resume.

Participating in a bid and being selected were two very different things.

"Which company is next?"

Hou Jinming discussed it with Shi Yue on the side. "Let us go first. Mr. Ning, you don't mind, do you? Since Lingdu is the grand finale, you certainly won't be stage-frightened. We also want to learn from our seniors."

With things put that way, could Ning Yan really say in front of so many people, "I do mind, get off the stage"?

He made a gesture of invitation.

Shen Huaixu hadn't looked at Wen Ni once since he sat down, but at this moment, his gaze finally landed on her.

She was dressed very professionally today.

Her shoulder-length hair was loose, and her fingers were quickly drawing and writing on paper.

This must have been a habit she developed over the last few years; Shen Huaixu didn't remember her being this focused before.

When he shifted his gaze to the stage, Shen Huaixu noticed that Jian Yuchen’s movements were exactly the same as hers.

The man subconsciously frowned, which made Shi Yue on stage nervous, causing her to misstate two pieces of data.

Hou Jinming’s face darkened on the spot. Shi Yue calmed herself down before regaining control of the presentation.

The design Shangmei presented this time actually shocked Wen Ni.

Not because it was stunning, but because this was not Shi Yue’s style at all.

Shi Yue had been taught by the same professor as her, and their design directions were actually very similar. Wen Ni was bolder and had a natural talent for color, while Shi Yue was cautious and careful. But Shi Yue was not the type to look down on work that was just "copy-pasted."

Her inspiration tended to be more natural, creating a very comfortable feeling.

Wen Ni had always admired her style.

After graduation, they would exchange stories about the hardships of their internships, but they had lost touch over time.

But she hadn't expected that the work Shi Yue was presenting now had completely lost its former spirit. It was essentially taking Jinfeng’s original architectural design and making minor alterations, with many strange elements thrown in. The dissonance was so strong that anyone in the industry could spot it at a glance.

Over at the Weifeng side, several designers were whispering to each other.

*

chapters.title: I'm Making Such a Scene with Jian Yuchen
chapters.content:
Shi Yue’s expression wasn't very good when she came down, but Hou Jinming was clearly quite satisfied, even discussing with the Jinfeng leaders that they could make changes at any time if they were dissatisfied with anything.

"The last group—is Lingdu’s design team ready?" Shen Huaixu suddenly spoke, interrupting Hou Jinming.

Wen Ni cheered herself on with Wang Linmu and Taozi, then led them onto the stage.

"Hello everyone, I am Wen Ni, Design Director of Lingdu Design Company. I will now explain our design draft."

"This design is based on the information and the style requested by Jinfeng Group. This is our initial draft and our conceptual approach."

"We understand Jinfeng’s long-standing corporate culture, so we have made some innovations and changes based on Jinfeng’s original design style. Please look at the renderings."

...

Ning Yan looked at Wen Ni and couldn't help but puff out his chest.

"Our Wen Ni is really bringing glory to our company," Ning Yan said with the expression of a proud father.

Jian Yuchen looked confused.

*If anyone is going to be proud, it should be me. What are you worrying about?*

However, the man who was usually cold and arrogant couldn't help but feel a sense of pride and self-satisfaction as he watched the woman on stage.

Seeing that the old fogies at Jinfeng were listening intently, Hou Jinming turned to look at Shi Yue with a clearly displeased expression.

Wen Ni spoke until her throat was dry, presenting every detail and covering the team’s hard work from the past half-year.

If they were still dissatisfied, there was nothing more Wen Ni could do.

Once the presentation was over, all that remained was to wait for Jinfeng’s response.

Wen Ni followed Ning Yan and the others to the lounge prepared by Jinfeng.

Everyone was waiting for the notification and was in no mood to chat.

Ning Yan and Jian Yuchen went to the side to discuss business. Wen Ni went to the restroom. While touching up her makeup, she saw Shi Yue just coming out of a stall.

Wen Ni didn't know what to say, and she didn't know if Shi Yue wanted to greet her, so she didn't speak for a moment.

"You were looking down on me just now, weren't you?"

Wen Ni’s hand paused. She finished applying her lipstick and closed the cap. "I don't know why you would think that, but everyone has their own helplessness in work. The ideals of our student days eventually yield to reality. To be able to be completely yourself in this world requires capital and conditions."

Shi Yue washed her hands and smiled. "I didn't expect you to still be with Senior Ning. Your design is excellent."

"Thank you."

Shi Yue sighed and turned to lean against the marble countertop.

Seeing that she looked very tired, Wen Ni pulled out a tissue and gave it to her. Shi Yue wiped her hands. "Thanks."

"Although I don't know what your current situation is, it's just a job. If you don't like it, you can change it. Consuming your passion for work is also a form of mental exhaustion. Life is only a few decades long; if you still have a choice, why not switch to a job you actually like?"

"I understand the logic, but as you can see, Hou Jinming is letting me be a director now; this is the company that offers me the greatest opportunity."

She turned her head to look at Wen Ni. "I know you must want to ask why I didn't come to Ning Yan back then."

"I was ambitious. My parents are both in the civil service and wanted me to take the civil service exams, but I wanted to do design, so I didn't listen to them. Back then, Ning Yan's company was just a small workshop—including you, there were only three people. If I had really gone there, my parents definitely wouldn't have agreed. I had to go to a big company so they could see a future."

"If you ask me if I regret it, of course I do. But I chose this path myself. The fact that I have no design freedom now and am only chasing money is the result of my own choices. Thank you for your suggestion today; I will consider it carefully."

Wen Ni smiled genuinely this time. "Look at you, even after entering society, you're still the same as you were in school. What's shameful about earning money? Everyone relies on their own abilities. Look at me, I do interior design, and I still have to listen to the clients. In the service industry, there's no such thing as truly being your own boss; if a client says one word, you change it if they want you to."

Shi Yue nodded. "I thought you would sternly ask me how I ended up like this."

"Hey, you're wronging me there."

Shi Yue nodded. "Are you and Jian Yuchen in the same company now?"

Wen Ni's expression was a bit unnatural. "Yeah, he came before the New Year. He's a partner of Ning Yan now."

"Were you two that close in school? I don't remember that."

"Ning Yan is just popular, otherwise how could he have built the company to this point with nothing but his bare hands?"

"That's true. But I really didn't expect you and Jian Yuchen to coexist peacefully; that's too magical." Shi Yue raised an eyebrow. "I still remember you arguing with him on the phone in the dorm; the whole building could hear you two. Everyone back then guessed you were a couple, but then we'd see you two ignoring each other when you ran into one another, and that's when we realized you were just pure arch-enemies."

Mentioning the past, Wen Ni was surprised. "Were we that childish?"

"You sure were. If they knew now that you and Jian Yuchen are working together, their jaws would probably hit the floor."

Wen Ni felt a bit guilty. If they knew she and Jian Yuchen were still sharing a bed, that would surely make the campus news.

"Hold on, I need to take a call." Shi Yue picked up her phone and shrugged helplessly at Wen Ni. "My boss is calling me again. Let's talk when we have time."

"Okay." Wen Ni nodded.

Shi Yue left from the other side. When Wen Ni walked out, she discovered that the corner of the hallway was filled with the history of Jinfeng's rise.

The founder of Jinfeng, Mr. Wang Yang, earned his first startup capital in the late 50s by selling scrap metal.

In 2000, he began establishing a web portal, which was the true start of his path to wealth.

Ten years later, he began to enter the field of artificial intelligence.

"What are your thoughts after seeing this?" A man's voice suddenly rang out in the empty reading room.

Wen Ni turned around abruptly to see Shen Huaixu leaning against the glass door, watching her.

Seeing that it was him, Wen Ni had nothing to say.

Shen Huaixu took the initiative to walk closer. "Jinfeng has already passed its most glorious days. Now, how to maintain the business and change channels is what they need."

Wen Ni walked forward, and Shen Huaixu followed.

The television screen was playing an interview with Wang Yang.

"In all these years, have you ever thought we would meet again?"

Wen Ni raised her eyelids and glanced at him. "No."

"You're just as direct as you used to be."

"Because I can't find a reason to be tactful with you. You aren't someone who doesn't know the truth. What's the point of you playing dumb here about what happened between us?"

"One moment asking me to add you, one moment getting close to my boss, one moment arranging seats, sending flowers to my office—could you stop doing these pointless things?" Wen Ni said with a cold face.

Shen Huaixu lowered his head and smiled. "But you didn't add me, did you?"

"Work is work. During work hours, as my client, as long as the money is sufficient, I will definitely complete my work according to your requirements to the best of my ability. As for other times, I think I have the right not to add you."

chapters.title: I'll Choose You Then
chapters.content:
Shen Huaixu nodded. "Naturally."

Wen Ni shrugged. "Do you have any other questions, Mr. Shen?"

"But I believe rules aren't set in stone. We're resting now; I'm not Jinfeng's Mr. Shen, and you're not Lingdu's design director. Can't we talk as high school classmates Shen Huaixu and Wen Ni?"

Wen Ni turned her head. "Fine, then what exactly do you want to say?"

Shen Huaixu looked at her. "I've missed you quite a bit these past few days. To be precise, when I saw you at Mingding, I realized I still can't quite forget you."

?

Wen Ni had a face full of question marks.

"Wait, let me confirm: we are speaking as high school classmates now, right? No matter what I say, it won't affect the bidding result for the Jinfeng design project, right?"

Shen Huaixu smiled faintly. "Yes, that's right."

"Fine, then I'll speak the truth too."

"What happened between us back then, as I just said, was just a contract. It was only because you made a bet with someone and couldn't afford to lose that we got together. It wasn't a proper relationship from the start, and we didn't have any feelings for each other."

"Really none? Wen Ni, you're still as insincere as you used to be."

Wen Ni was speechless.

She really wanted to share a little bit of her own insecurity with him.

"Fine, let's not even discuss the depth of feelings. When you saw me at Mingding and realized you couldn't forget me, it couldn't be because you thought, 'Ah, this girl is still the same, ignoring me. She's so special. I want to see her fall in love with me, be obsessed with me, just to add a colorful stroke to my glamorous dating history,' could it?"

Wen Ni crossed her arms and questioned him.

Shen Huaixu was dumbfounded, then lowered his head and said, "Is that how you think of me?"

"A man who in high school could run up to me and pretend to like me just because others were joking—how do you think I should view him?"

"Oh, right. Although I don't know why you think I'd still pay attention to you, I want to remind you: from beginning to end, whether it was you inexplicably betting with others to pursue me, or now wanting to put a period on your high school history in your 'chasing girls' diary, don't come near me. Because I'm the type of person who has no manners to speak of."

Wen Ni's subtext was: if you mess with me again, I'll hit you.

Shen Huaixu took a deep breath, then couldn't help but lower his head and laugh. "Your temper hasn't changed at all; it's still the way I remember it."

"WOW, your tactics haven't improved at all over the years either. Still the same old routine."

Wen Ni said expressionlessly, checked the time, and planned to leave immediately.

"What is your relationship with Jian Yuchen?"

Suddenly, Shen Huaixu asked.

Wen Ni paused and turned to look at him. "None of your business."

Shen Huaixu didn't mind being scolded; she had always been like this, and one shouldn't expect her to be gentle or considerate.

"As far as I know, you went to the same university and are now in the same company. Have you never thought that he might be interested in you?"

Wen Ni hadn't really considered this question, but Jian Yuchen was already her man; if he wasn't interested in her, who else would he be interested in?

Any behavior that showed signs of that would be marital infidelity!

He had to like her whether he wanted to or not!

"I'm so lively, cute, smart, and excellent—what's strange about him being interested in me?"

Shen Huaixu stepped up. "Then it's my personal freedom to pursue you. You've been arguing with Jian Yuchen for so many years; surely you can't shut out someone like me who has always been pretty good to you?"

"You were good to me? Let alone the fact that your physics tutoring was a total mess, you went abroad in your senior year and left me to be mocked for being dumped by you—I haven't even settled that account with you yet."

Back then, she was scolded by Wen Zhiwen and was in a bad mood. Good heavens, the rumor spread that she was heartbroken and wanted to jump off a building, and the teacher called her parents.

It eventually evolved into her becoming the woman Shen Huaixu didn't want!

She was a perfectly innocent girl, and once Shen Huaixu's label was stuck on her, she couldn't get it off.

Who could she go to for justice?

And he says he was good to her? Pfft!

Shen Huaixu was surprised. "They said that about you behind your back?"

Wen Ni looked him up and down. "You had plenty of fox friends in school; don't tell me you had absolutely no idea about this?"

Shen Huaixu said, "I really didn't know much about that. It's just that after I settled down in the US, I heard them say once that you cried very sadly."

"Hey!" Wen Ni reached out to interrupt him. "First, I didn't cry sadly because of you; it was because my dad was called to school because of my homework, and it made me lose face. I cried because I couldn't afford that embarrassment. Second, we didn't have that kind of relationship. I don't even know where that 'farewell letter' you wrote me went, let alone what you wrote in it."

So gossipy. Seeing her cry and assuming it was over Shen Huaixu.

Going to the US didn't mean he was in the afterlife.

Was she supposed to be mourning him in broad daylight?

Shen Huaixu's expression cracked. "So that's how it was."

He had thought, Wen Ni didn't seem to like him that much, but he knew she had cried very sadly back then.

He had actually felt a little happy inside.

But later, he was occupied by a new country and a new life; how could he have remembered Wen Ni?

"Do you have anything else?" Wen Ni checked the time and was really leaving.

Shen Huaixu lowered his eyes. "Believe it or not, these years abroad, I really did think of you."

"Although we were only together for three months, being with you was very relaxing and happy. That's something no one else has given me."

"That wouldn't even fool the 17-year-old me; you're trying to fool the 27-year-old me now?" Wen Ni was truly shocked.

As the saying goes, a performative personality—she had finally seen one today.

"You don't believe me?"

"It's not that I don't believe you; it's that I think you've fallen into a misconception."

"What worries could we have had at 17? Every day was just doing homework, going to class, going home to eat. At most, we worried about what was in the cafeteria that day. You've entered society; you have work pressure, family pressure, life pressure. People and things you encounter at different age groups have their own worries. You think being with me was relaxing because the 17-year-old you was relaxed, not because of me as a person."

"You look successful in your career now, young and promising, already a proper Mr. Shen. It shouldn't be hard to find someone who is devoted to you. Let's not make things difficult for each other anymore."

"Hmm, you have a point. I suppose I’ll choose you then. I’m also very curious to see how a relationship with you at this age would differ from when we were 17."

Wen Ni was just about to call him crazy.

"Wen Ni." The man’s cold, clear voice echoed in the room.

Wen Ni turned her head and saw Ning Yan and Jian Yuchen standing at the doorway. She had no idea how long they had been standing there.

Wen Ni froze, subconsciously looking at Jian Yuchen.

The man’s gaze was heavy. She pursed her lips, turned away from Shen Huaixu, and walked toward them.

chapters.title: You’re Quite Casual, Aren't You?
chapters.content:
Ning Yan let his gaze linger on Wen Ni for a moment before saying to Shen Huaixu, who was standing there watching them, "It seems we’ve come at a bad time. We didn't interrupt your conversation, did we?"

Shen Huaixu shrugged and walked toward them. "Not at all. I was just chatting with Director Wen about some design ideas."

Ning Yan wanted to say something else, but Jian Yuchen didn't even spare Shen Huaixu a glance. He grabbed Wen Ni’s hand and walked away. Before Ning Yan could react, they were already far off.

"I’ll head over first," Ning Yan said, hurrying to catch up.

"Wait, don't walk so fast." Ning Yan caught up and blocked their path. "You didn't get into an argument with President Shen just now, did you? The way you looked, it seemed like you wanted to curse him out."

Wen Ni certainly wanted to, and she had even been quite sarcastic, but she didn't like hearing Ning Yan put it that way.

"I’m not stupid. Why would I argue with the client at the client’s own company? Your worry is completely unnecessary."

Ning Yan nodded. "That’s true, but the look on your face just now was pretty scary."

Wen Ni said, "We were just talking about things related to the design proposal, nothing else."

Ning Yan clicked his tongue. "With the way things are today, I don't have a good feeling about this."

Seeing that Ning Yan had started talking to himself, Wen Ni subconsciously tried to pull her wrist away, only to find it held firmly by that man, Jian Yuchen.

"What are you doing!" Wen Ni glared at him.

Jian Yuchen looked down at her and said softly, "That excuse might work on Ning Yan, but it won't work on me. What did you say to him?"

The man raised an eyebrow. "You’d better not try to brush me off."

Wen Ni found his tone rather subtle.

"Which kind of answer do you want to hear?"

"Obviously, I don't really want to hear anything related to him, but I have the right to know."

"You don't want to hear it, yet you still want to?"

"I’m not some almighty deity; can’t I have moments where I’m annoyed? What does that have to do with whether I want to hear it or not?"

"Fine." Wen Ni turned her head and pulled her hand away from his. "If you behave, I’ll tell you."

?

Jian Yuchen felt that this woman, Wen Ni, sometimes really needed to be put in her place.

"You’re really not going to say?"

"I was actually going to tell you, but seeing how curious you are, I’ve decided to keep you in suspense. The gossip you can’t get your hands on is always the sweetest." After saying this, she raised her eyebrows at him triumphantly.

Jian Yuchen put his hands in his pockets and leaned down to stare at her. "Fine, you certainly have the right to remain silent, but I have other ways to find out tonight. By then, even if you want to talk, I might not be interested in listening."

Wen Ni stared into his eyes, her body suddenly shivering as a cold, eerie sensation crept up from her toes.

The last time Jian Yuchen was like this was during their third month of marriage.

She had been playing a game with him, a test of their tacit understanding.

It was pitch black, deep in the night, and they were busy bickering.

"Wen Ni!"

"What? Don't bother me, just follow the recipe."

"Follow the order to serve the dishes! Stop running around with that burning pot!"

"I know you're in a hurry, but don't be! You'll have plenty to be anxious about later!"

"Stop pushing your butt against me! Have you been chopping vegetables for two and a half years? Why don't you just chop up the customer who ordered the food too!"

"Please, I’ve closed off my heart and locked away love. Stop nagging! I’m a fully automated dishwasher, yet you’re fighting me for work. Just serve the food!"

"The food is all burnt, what is there to serve? I’m serving you instead."

"Baojuan, where is my pot? Where did you put my pot!"

Before they could finish arguing, the kitchen had finished burning.

"It's over..." Wen Ni muttered.

Jian Yuchen put down the game controller and rubbed his temples. "You, the Michelin eight-star dishwasher, it's the game that has no eyes."

"Who are you being sarcastic about?" Wen Ni wasn't happy and turned to face Jian Yuchen.

Jian Yuchen couldn't help but laugh out loud.

The reason was simple: the little leopard face mask Wen Ni was wearing had fallen off halfway, and with her baring her fangs and brandishing her claws, she looked adorable.

"You! You're still laughing at me!"

Wen Ni was most afraid of embarrassing herself in front of Jian Yuchen. Even when she woke up face-to-face with him in bed the day after their wedding, she had to tense up and say, "Nothing special." How could she lose her momentum now!

However, Jian Yuchen simply stood up, threw her over his shoulder, and carried her into the room.

That posture, that scene, it was like a savage carrying off his wife.

Jian Yuchen had just started "eating meat" back then and wanted to do it several times a day, yet she kept provoking him in all sorts of ways.

"I just like you like this. Bear with it for a moment, let me serve you until you're comfortable, and you'll grow to love the feeling."

Wen Ni secretly cursed him for being shameless, yet she also felt that Jian Yuchen was unexpectedly to her taste in bed.

For a long time after they were married, the two of them were like that—chaotic and wild.

One second they were arguing, the next they were rolling in the sheets.

Sure enough, the next day, Wen Ni couldn't straighten her back and was crying, threatening to divorce him.

Jian Yuchen could only wipe her face with a dark expression.

"Why are you being so rough? My skin is very delicate!" Wen Ni sniffled, almost crying out a snot bubble.

The memory was interrupted. Wen Ni glared at him. "You're so arrogant while asking for my private gossip. With that attitude, what kind of 'tea' do you think you'll get out of me?"

"Even if my attitude were good, you wouldn't necessarily tell me."

Wen Ni was speechless; that was true.

"Forget it, telling you is no big deal. He’s having a delusion, thinking I’m still hung up on him and wanting to relive our campus days."

Jian Yuchen’s footsteps faltered. *Heh*, he knew it.

"And then?"

Wen Ni widened her eyes. "What do you mean 'and then'? Do you think I would have an 'and then' with him?"

"You’re the great single woman Wen Ni now, aren't you? You used to like his type. Who knows, maybe you want to smell the stench of the poop you haven't tasted before."

"You really will stop at nothing to smear me! I am well aware of my status as a married woman, don't try to frame me." Wen Ni walked ahead, then suddenly turned back. "Who told you I liked his type?"

Jian Yuchen said expressionlessly, "You didn't like him, yet you dated him?"

"I didn't like you at the beginning either, but I still married you."

"Oh, then you really are quite casual."

"As if you married me because you liked me. Let’s not point fingers at each other." Wen Ni was stung by his comment about her being "casual."

Ever since Shen Huaixu, she didn't know what was wrong in college; even though people pursued her, they would vanish the next day.

Men nowadays had so little sincerity when pursuing a woman.

How could she possibly want any follow-up?

But that didn't mean Jian Yuchen could provoke her like this!

Jian Yuchen took a deep breath, but his words were interrupted by Ning Yan, who had turned back.

"Break time is over. It's time to announce the results."

Wen Ni and Jian Yuchen exchanged a look, and both tacitly stopped the argument they hadn't finished.

During work hours, the couple had always been professional.

chapters.title: Does Jian Yuchen Care About Me?
chapters.content:
However, Wen Ni and her team never expected this.

Jinfeng’s response was to give each company three days to revisit Jinfeng’s current construction site. Whoever could come up with the best creative chain would have the final design scheme decided by the board of directors and Wang Yang personally.

"Three days might not be enough, right?"

"You don't need to do a full design, just the facade."

"Is there any specific direction?" Shi Yue asked.

Shen Huaixu looked at the designers from the three companies. "Jinfeng *is* the direction. I will send all the design materials for the Jinfeng building to everyone. If you need any help, you can contact the internal project managers. See you in three days."

Wen Ni exchanged a look with the two designers on her team, feeling that this was completely baffling.

But she didn't have much time left.

Wen Ni immediately got up to find the project manager, took a stack of materials, and returned to distribute them to Wang Linmu and the others.

"Gu Wang, come to the construction site with me now. Bring your camera."

"Engineer Wang, you and Taozi stay here and look through these materials. Tell me your specific thoughts when I get back. We'll meet at the hotel later."

Wen Ni hurried downstairs with Gu Wang. Shi Yue also said something to Hou Jinming and quickly followed.

As soon as Wen Ni reached the first floor, Jian Yuchen was one step faster. He asked the driver for the car keys and told Wen Ni and the others to get in.

Wen Ni hesitated for a moment before climbing in. Gu Wang, however, spoke up, "Brother Simon, you just snatched the car like that. How are President Ning and the others going to get back?"

"They can take a taxi. The hotel isn't far from here, but the construction site is a fair distance away. Besides, it’s not easy to find a car once you’re out there. You two are outsiders going to the site; those people won't be so polite. Let's go."

Jian Yuchen started the car. Gu Wang nodded. "That's true. We haven't secured the design contract yet; we can't afford to be looked down upon."

Gu Wang watched the other two companies still waiting for a car and couldn't help but give Jian Yuchen a thumbs up. "Brother, I'll call you Brother Chen when we're not at the company."

Wen Ni was speechless. This kid, he was calling people "brother" after barely two minutes.

They had been to the Jinfeng site last year, and this year it remained unchanged.

There was no need to measure dimensions; they just needed to document the current state of things.

Gu Wang was busy photographing details, while Wen Ni took out paper and pen from her bag and began to conceptualize, facing the distant empty lot.

When she worked, she didn't like to be interrupted.

Jian Yuchen placed the car keys beside her and got up to leave.

When he returned, he was carrying a plastic bag containing three bottles of water.

Wen Ni took one and drank, her eyes narrowing. She had drawn a few messy lines on the paper, but hadn't added any color.

"No inspiration?"

Wen Ni sighed. "I already gave my best proposal before. For the same scene and the same building, I don't think anything I come up with now will be better than the previous design."

"Giving up already?"

"How could I!" The woman, who had been wilting just a moment ago, immediately lifted her chin.

"Shen Huaixu just couldn't handle the nepotism in his group, so he threw a difficult problem at us," Wen Ni gritted her teeth. "I don't believe I can't win this."

Jian Yuchen felt that Wen Ni was the type of person who, even at eighty, would likely still be provoked by a dare.

She never knew how to admit defeat.

"Very good, keep this state of mind."

"Hey, how did I manage to hear a hint of encouragement in what you just said?"

"Tsk, believing in your self-discipline is my way of encouraging you. This year’s bonus depends on this single project," Jian Yuchen said coolly.

Wen Ni couldn't help but straighten her back. "You always say the family can afford to support me. If I ever become a full-time housewife, you wouldn't find an excuse to kick me out, would you?"

"Mrs. Jian, I must solemnly remind you: although we were in a rush when we got married, please be reasonable. Even if there really comes a day when we divorce, I wouldn't be so low-class as to not give you any money. You’d probably end up with the majority of my assets anyway, so I’d be the one getting kicked out," Jian Yuchen said, glancing at her sideways.

"That’s so generous of you. Then why do you dare to offend me? If I dump you later, you’ll have to serve me well," Wen Ni said, her ego inflating the moment she heard that.

Jian Yuchen set his water aside. "There’s no one around here, and it’s quite exciting in the car. Come on, let me serve you well, shall we, Director?"

Wen Ni’s face suddenly flushed; she understood exactly what this scoundrel meant in a split second.

"Go away~ I’m working. I’m not the kind of Director who can be easily seduced by you."

"Hmm, I can see that. Your principles are incredibly strong." (At home, she could be bought with two cups of milk tea.)

Jian Yuchen smacked his lips. "So, it’s okay when you’re not working?"

Maybe picking a weekend to go to the back hill would be... nice...

She hadn't tried that yet.

Just as Wen Ni was about to say, "You’re dreaming," Shi Yue and the others arrived.

As soon as Shi Yue got out of the car, she nodded toward Wen Ni and walked straight inside.

"Shi Yue has changed a lot. I ran into her in the restroom today; I get the feeling she’s not very happy working at Shangmei."

"How many people in this world are actually happy at work?" Jian Yuchen found it baffling that Wen Ni still had the headspace to sympathize with a competitor.

Wen Ni took out the small cookies she kept in her bag. "Ugh, talking to you about this is like playing the lute to a cow. I’m going in to find some inspiration."

As Wen Ni started to walk away, Jian Yuchen grabbed her back the next second.

She couldn't stop her momentum and bumped straight into him.

"What are you doing?"

The man picked up a hard hat from the side and put it on her, then smoothed out the hair that had been pressed against her face, and nudged his chin forward. "Go on in."

Wen Ni felt she was strange; she had done much more intimate things with Jian Yuchen than this.

Yet, some of his casual, inadvertent gestures always managed to leave her feeling flustered.

Wen Ni turned her head and walked inside, feeling a bit stiff.

Shi Yue was discussing something with a few assistants. Seeing Wen Ni enter, the two of them headed in different directions.

By the time Wen Ni finished her rounds and came back, Shi Yue was still there.

"Your relationship with Jian Yuchen is actually better than I thought. But then again, he was quite attentive to you back then," Shi Yue said.

Wen Ni didn't react at first, but after pondering every word, she was stunned. "Huh? Jian Yuchen was attentive to me? Are you sure he wasn't just finding me to pick a fight after tracking down my location?"

Shi Yue raised an eyebrow, looking a bit surprised. "You didn't feel it yourself? There was one time you had a stomachache after an exam, and he carried you to the infirmary without saying a word."

"And another time, our dorm was scolded by a professor and we stayed in the classroom without going back, missing dinner. Where do you think that KFC family bucket came from? There was even a separate strawberry tart in there—your favorite thing to eat at school. Isn't that obvious enough?"

Wen Ni blinked.

"Wasn't that sent by your suitor at the time, Song Bo? That’s what Jian Yuchen told me."

Shi Yue shook her head with a helpless smile. "I don't like fried food. When Song Bo was pursuing me, he always asked me out to restaurants; he never ordered KFC for me. You were the only one in our dorm who loved it, okay?"

**

chapters.title: The Worker's Soul
chapters.content:
Seeing Wen Ni’s completely disbelieving expression, Shi Yue couldn't figure out what Jian Yuchen’s intentions were.

If you say he liked her, he was constantly bickering with Wen Ni, making her jump with rage over the smallest things.

If you say he didn't like her, the moment Wen Ni had even the slightest problem, he would appear within a 20-meter radius within half an hour, and then repeat the cycle of bickering.

Shi Yue couldn't understand him back then, and she understood him even less now.

"Forget it. Perhaps the two of you are destined to spend your whole lives bickering like this."

Wen Ni almost applauded her. If she went to set up a fortune-telling stall on an overpass, she could probably make a lot of money with that mouth—her guess was spot on.

It really was just going to be a lifetime of bickering with Jian Yuchen.

That is, provided they could last until the day they didn't divorce.

"Sigh, in the blink of an eye, we’re almost thirty. Time flies so fast. When we first met, thirty felt so far away. I used to imagine that by thirty, we’d all be urban elites with houses, cars, husbands, and kids, successful in our careers as famous designers. Turns out, we didn't achieve a single one of those things."

Wen Ni’s heart skipped a beat. She inexplicably felt as though she might end up with just the child part.

A child with Jian Yuchen!

Good heavens, she couldn't imagine giving birth to Jian Yuchen’s child one day.

What right did Jian Yuchen have to deserve that!

As Wen Ni’s mind wandered, she suddenly thought of Song Bo.

"Hey, back when we graduated from college, did you and Song Bo ever actually get together?"

Shi Yue paused, lowered her head, and gave a bitter smile. "We did, but we couldn't overcome reality."

Shi Yue’s hometown wasn't far, near H City, but Song Bo was a Northerner.

Between the long-distance, work pressure, and differences in food culture, love seemed so insignificant in the face of it all.

Wen Ni chatted with Shi Yue for quite a while. When she came out, Gu Wang had already returned and was sitting in the car with Jian Yuchen playing games.

"Sister Wen Ni." The kid Gu Wang dropped his act the moment he left the company.

Jian Yuchen reached out his hand, and Wen Ni handed him her bag.

"Are you done?"

"Yeah, I have a rough outline. What time is it now?"

"Afternoon. We’ll be back just in time for dinner."

Wen Ni shook her head. "I’m not eating. Tell Engineer Wang and the others to wait for me to get back so we can have a team meeting. I’ll just eat at the hotel."

She believed Shi Yue would do the same when she got back.

Jian Yuchen went to drive, while Gu Wang leaned back in the passenger seat, put on his headphones, and went to sleep.

"Are you still in touch with Song Bo?" Wen Ni sat in the passenger seat, making it easier to chat with Jian Yuchen.

Jian Yuchen glanced at her. "You were chatting with Shi Yue?"

"Yeah, when you run into someone, you’re bound to chat a bit. Did she really date Song Bo?"

"They’ve been broken up for over a year."

"Song Bo liked her so much back then, and they still broke up?" Wen Ni had never had a heart-wrenching romance.

She had read about it in novels—things like remembering someone for a lifetime, heart racing upon seeing them, or feeling like the world is ending when losing them.

She couldn't relate to any of it.

"It’s hard to hold onto someone you meet at the wrong time. You can't say either of them was wrong in that relationship; they just made their own choices."

Wen Ni only felt a sense of regret.

But at the same time, she wanted to know: when Jian Yuchen saw Fang Hui, did he feel the timing was wrong, causing them to miss each other?

However, with Gu Wang sitting in the back, Wen Ni didn't end up asking.

Back at the hotel, Wen Ni no longer had the time to think about these questions.

She had the hotel arrange a small conference room for their group. Each person had a laptop; at times they were in heated discussions, and at other times the entire room was deathly quiet, save for the hum of the computers.

Jian Yuchen passed by several times and noticed Wen Ni hadn't left the conference room once.

When he went with Ning Yan to deliver food, she was in the same position she had been in the morning.

"Eat something first."

"No need, just bring me another cup of coffee."

"You’ve had four cups since this afternoon. Do you not plan on sleeping?"

Wen Ni leaned her head back against the chair, looking at her exhausted team members. "You guys go back and sleep first."

Everyone was truly at their limit; they hugged their laptops and said their goodbyes before leaving one by one.

"What about you?" Jian Yuchen looked down at her.

Wen Ni rubbed her temples. "There’s one day left. I’ll keep looking."

Jian Yuchen looked at the design drafts scattered all over the floor—some rejected, some partially kept, only to be rejected again in the next round.

"You’re not leaving?" Wen Ni intended to continue working, but when she turned around, she saw him still sitting on the desk, his long legs propped up casually.

"I can't sleep either, so I’ll keep you company here."

This conference room was in a corner on the second floor of the hotel. At this hour, there wasn't a soul around. Leaving her here alone—she might be brave, but he wasn't that carefree.

"It’s no use keeping me company here. I have absolutely no ideas left."

Jian Yuchen picked up Wang Yang’s biography.

It seemed these successful businessmen were very fond of sharing their success stories, even trivial childhood memories, to show how they were different from a young age—a pearl hidden in dust.

Wen Ni watched as Jian Yuchen flipped through two pages and then stopped.

She got up and leaned against him, wanting to see what he was so engrossed in.

The scent of roses from the woman lingered in his nose. Jian Yuchen reached out and subconsciously pulled her into his arms, resting his head on top of hers.

"He seems to really like bamboo."

After Wen Ni finished speaking, she saw the sentence about his transformation after his first successful venture.

She leaned in his arms, and Jian Yuchen felt a bit distracted.

Just as the man was about to lean down to kiss her, Wen Ni suddenly turned her head, hooked her arm around his neck, and gave his cheek a fierce kiss.

With a loud "pop," Wen Ni flashed a bright smile. "I know how to design it now! Just you wait."

Then, his arms were empty. The woman had regained her spirit and started drawing on the computer again.

Jian Yuchen looked at his empty arms and gave a helpless smile.

The next morning, Wang Linmu came down with Yu Xiaozhu and Tao Zi.

"Did you sleep well last night?"

"How could we? My head is pounding."

"Yeah, today is the last day. Tomorrow is the submission deadline, and we haven't even finalized a single entrance."

As they spoke, morale was low. When they opened the door to the conference room...

Wen Ni turned her head and took a look. "You’re just in time. Come take a look."

Everyone looked at each other. "Director, you didn't rest last night?"

The clothes were the same ones from yesterday.

"Don't talk nonsense." Wen Ni beckoned to them.

Yu Xiaozhu put down her bag, and Jian Yuchen had just finished sticking the final drawing onto the board.

"Director, did you come up with this all by yourself?"

"Why this approach? It’s completely different from our first proposal."

"We were boxed in by the first proposal. Since there were no better ideas, we might as well try this version."

Wang Linmu said, "I think it’s feasible."

"Then what are we waiting for? We have one day. Refine what needs refining, and get to work on the renderings!"

chapters.title: This is Wen Ni’s Strength
chapters.content:
Once everything was settled, Wen Ni went straight back to her room. She didn't even eat dinner, sleeping straight through until 9:00 the next morning.

Ning Yan and Jian Yuchen didn't disturb them, waiting downstairs instead.

"Wen Ni and her team have really worked hard these past two days. There aren't many employees these days who can push themselves like this."

"So you’re just going to squeeze your junior schoolmate for all she’s worth?"

Ning Yan leaned back. "Hey, hey, don't make it sound like this has nothing to do with you. At the end of the day, you’re her boss too."

Both Jian Yuchen and Ning Yan understood that it was mostly because Wen Ni herself was willing.

She genuinely loved design.

Otherwise, given her temperament, she would have run off long ago.

Speak of the devil, and she shall appear; Wen Ni led her team down, looking full of energy.

"Everything is packed. Let's go."

Seeing her looking radiant, Ning Yan muttered to Jian Yuchen, "Women are truly amazing. They can look absolutely haggard from an all-nighter, but the next morning, you can't tell at all."

"That’s why you shouldn't underestimate women." Jian Yuchen curled his lips.

He looked forward to her performance on the battlefield today.

Of the three companies, Breeze arrived the earliest again.

Wen Ni took her seat in the same spot.

However, since this was likely the final decision-making session, the Chairman, Wang Yang himself, was among those who arrived.

After the top brass were seated, Lingdu was the final presenter, with Breeze going first.

Breeze’s chief designer was a veteran with extensive practical experience and maintained a high standard.

Ning Yan turned and whispered to Wen Ni, "The design style has changed."

Wen Ni had noticed it too, of course.

But at this point, it was down to individual ability.

When Shi Yue took the stage, Wen Ni perked up. Sure enough, the design Shi Yue presented this time was much better than the previous one.

It was likely that since Jinfeng hadn't been won over in one go, Hou Jinming had started to doubt his own decisions and let Shi Yue have free rein.

Wen Ni didn't miss a single pause or demonstration during Shi Yue's presentation.

Although she could only see the exterior design, she could already see Shi Yue’s own style embedded within it.

Compared to the last presentation, she was clearly much more confident this time.

When she came down, Wen Ni even gave her a look of approval.

When it was Wen Ni's turn, she took a deep breath before leading Wang Linmu and the others onto the stage.

"Hello everyone. My design this time takes the ecological landscape as its starting point."

As soon as this premise was stated, everyone was shocked.

Hou Jinming was speechless. He turned to Shi Yue and grumbled, "Is she crazy? Not focusing on Jinfeng, but on some... some ecological landscape!?"

Shi Yue couldn't be bothered to respond to Hou Jinming, but she knew that Wen Ni must have her reasons for doing this.

Wen Ni looked at the expressions of the people in the audience, maintaining her smile.

"Jinfeng's location is very subtle. We can foresee that in the future, the plaza’s landscape advantages, as well as the terrain, will provide a superior geographical position and landscape attribute."

"This area will be the core of future development, and Jinfeng’s primary business goals are intelligent manufacturing and digital innovation. This is the theme and focus that the Jinfeng office building needs to elevate and sublimate."

"Out of consideration for Jinfeng’s future development and our design philosophy, our company has created the following design. This is the concept map for our Twin Towers."

"The design adopts staggered high and low volumes, creating a sense of vitality like digital pulses rising step by step, which also embodies our beautiful expectations for Jinfeng’s future development."

"These are the specific details of our exterior facade drawings. I will now continue with the explanation."

...

As Wen Ni explained the detailed drawings with quantitative data, everyone gradually gained a concrete and profound understanding of the Twin Towers.

Only when the last syllable fell did Wen Ni bow and let Wang Linmu explain the details regarding the integration of landscaping and the building.

Wen Ni’s face was hidden in the light of the screen.

Everyone listened intently, and Hou Jinming’s expression grew increasingly ugly.

When Wang Linmu finished his explanation, the first person to applaud was Chairman Wang Yang.

"Director Wen, is it? I’d like to ask, why did you choose the ecological landscape as your starting point?"

Suddenly called upon, Wen Ni looked at the gazes directed at her, then looked straight at Jian Yuchen.

Then she smiled and said, "Actually, it was a bit of a gamble. Because in your autobiography, Chairman Wang, you once said that your dream was to dedicate yourself to ecological environmental protection. For so many years, you have been working hard to contribute to social environmental protection. So, I boldly guessed that your initial dissatisfaction with the design proposals stemmed from the fact that we hadn't properly protected the natural ecological wetland park behind the Jinfeng building."

Wang Yang nodded. "Good, I understand. Thank you for your answer. We have fully understood the design proposals provided by all of you. Please wait a moment; we will announce the results as soon as the vote is cast."

After saying this, Wang Yang stood up and left.

Wen Ni and the others had to wait there for the results.

Hou Jinming impatiently tapped his foot. Ecological environment, what the hell...

Ning Yan hadn't even had a chance to see Wen Ni's design until today.

"You were taking such a huge risk."

"Fortune favors the bold. Everyone else’s designs were blooming with fancy ideas. They didn't want anything exotic, they didn't want a surprise win, they didn't want something conventional, and they didn't want something trendy and high-end. What if they just happened to like ours?"

What Wen Ni didn't say was that Jian Yuchen’s words last night had given her the greatest inspiration.

"Capitalists are capitalists at the end of the day. If a building completely contradicts a landmark wetland park, it will only become a laughingstock."

Wang Yang was a low-key person who didn't like to show off; this was definitely not what he wanted.

Regardless of his original intention, the focus had to be the wetland park behind it.

Wen Ni decided to take the risk.

Half an hour later, when Shen Huaixu entered with his secretary and assistant, everyone tensed up.

"Sorry to keep you all waiting. I will now announce the partner for the Jinfeng building design bid."

Shen Huaixu’s gaze landed on Wen Ni, and he said, "Congratulations to Lingdu Design. I look forward to our future cooperation."

"Yes!" Ning Yan stood up abruptly, high-fived Wen Ni, and then gave Jian Yuchen a fierce hug.

He went forward to cooperate with Shen Huaixu.

"Congratulations."

"Thank you, Mr. Shen."

"Our Chairman Wang said he wants to treat you all to a meal tonight, and by the way, discuss some areas that need improvement."

"Of course, of course, it’s only right."

Hou Jinming stood up, and the secretary brought by Shen Huaixu hurried to see him off.

Shi Yue gave Wen Ni an encouraging look before hurrying to follow.

Wen Ni smiled at her before looking down to unwrap a candy for herself.

This was a method she used to reward herself every time she achieved something.

Jian Yuchen looked back at her silently and reached behind his back.

Wen Ni saw his fingers beckoning to her. Damn him, even trying to steal her candy.

She took one out of her bag and stuffed it into his hand.

Jian Yuchen toyed with the candy wrapper. After all these years, she still loved this flavor.

Sweet, just like Wen Ni.

chapters.title: Things Like Younger Brothers-in-law
chapters.content:
For a period of time, Wen Ni often ate this kind of fruit candy.

However, she would always pick out the durian-flavored ones and shove all the rest into her mouth.

That was during her senior year of high school. Every time she went home on the weekend, Wen Zhiwen would stare at her.

"If you don't get into college, don't come back to this house."

Later, Wen Ni was under so much pressure that her hair started falling out in clumps.

Seeing that her grades weren't improving, Wen Zhiwen simply went to her homeroom teacher and canceled Wen Ni’s boarding status.

Not only that, but like other "tiger parents," he chose to send Wen Ni to a tutor. After evening self-study ended, she had to go for extra tutoring before heading home at night.

Wen Zhiwen didn't mind the fatigue; he would wait outside the tutor's residential complex every day, driving Wen Ni home under the stars.

Her weekly allowance was only 100 yuan, and eating candy was the cheapest way to relieve stress without much cost.

After eating so much, she gave herself cavities.

Because of the change of seasons and the heat, her gums became swollen and painful, making her wince even while eating school cafeteria food.

By the time Wen Ni discovered that the tutor lived in the same residential complex as Jian Yuchen, she had already been back home for nearly a week.

After evening self-study, everyone scattered.

Wen Ni sprayed some watermelon frost on her gums and took her papers to leave.

When she reached the back gate, she bumped straight into Jian Yuchen.

Given their relationship, Wen Ni certainly wasn't going to give him a pleasant look.

A massive crowd gathered at the stairwell.

At that time, the scent of lemon laundry detergent on Jian Yuchen was quite distinct amidst the smell of sweaty boys.

So, when he was behind her, Wen Ni’s dog-like nose knew it immediately.

Following the flow of people, they reached the stairwell. Some were going to the bike shed, some were being picked up by parents at the school gate, and others were heading to the dorms, splitting into several groups.

Wen Ni felt like a lone canoe, drifting on the ocean toward the next stop.

The footsteps behind her followed at a steady, unhurried pace.

Wen Ni walked past the first bus stop, and he was still following.

She suddenly turned her head. Jian Yuchen glanced at her and then walked past her.

?

What’s with the attitude?

Why don't you trip and die, you idiot?

Wen Ni hoisted her heavy backpack up.

She walked past Jian Yuchen with quick strides.
