After passing the first intersection, Wen Ni turned her head again.

He was wearing his backpack, still that same deadpan look.

?

"Why are you following me?" Wen Ni couldn't help but ask.

"Are you sick? Does this road have your name on it?"

"..."

Wen Ni looked left and right. That was true; there were only two main roads out of the school, either left or right.

But even at the third intersection, when they saw the entrance to her tutor's apartment complex, Jian Yuchen was still with her.

Wen Ni stamped her foot, ready to ask him if he was planning to ambush her under the cover of darkness, what a despicable high school boy!

However, Jian Yuchen walked past her again, looking down at her, and then turned right into the complex.

?

Wen Ni quickly followed. "You, you live here?"

Jian Yuchen chuckled. "What else? I have a crush on you."

Wen Ni felt a little embarrassed by his teasing.

But the stubborn girl wasn't about to back down.

"Well, who knows? Those cunning perverts are masters of disguise. Which building do you live in?"

"Building 3, 1602."

Wen Ni breathed a sigh of relief. Thank goodness, her teacher lived in Building 4.

Next door. But who could tell her why the tutor's study room was directly opposite Jian Yuchen's bedroom?

"The approach to this problem is wrong," the teacher continued pointing out errors on the test paper.

Wen Ni looked up and could see a figure walking past the screen window of the opposite room.

The blue curtains, Wen Ni could tell from the shadow that it was Jian Yuchen.

Sure enough, the curtains opened the next second, and Jian Yuchen sat down to play on the computer.

"Wen Ni, don't get distracted," the teacher said, closing the curtains. "I talked to you about this problem yesterday. You need to remember it and not make this mistake again."

Wen Ni felt incredibly resentful.

Someone was still doing homework late at night.

Someone was playing games across the street.

It was utterly inhumane; the contrast was unsettling. Disconnecting from the internet was recommended.

Finally, the one-hour tutoring session ended.

"Your English was pretty good this time. Keep memorizing vocabulary. You shouldn't have lost so many points; it's a shame to lose points just because you got one or two words wrong."

"Thank you, teacher, I understand."

"Your dad's at the entrance of the complex, right? Be careful on your way."

Wen Ni nodded. As she walked downstairs, someone from the building next door came down as well.

Wen Ni kicked a small pebble on the side of the road and walked slowly forward.

"Woof woof woof!" A dog's bark caught Wen Ni's attention.

She looked up. The boy was wearing a black hoodie, carrying a trash bag, and leading a... well... a small dog?

The dog was tiny, pure white, with big eyes, and it was sticking its tongue out at Wen Ni.

The dog was quite cute, but its owner was utterly annoying.

Jian Yuchen walked on by himself, threw the trash into the garbage bin, sending it flying in a magnificent arc.

Wen Ni silently followed behind his elongated shadow.

In the middle of the night, the neighborhood was deserted, save for the dark shadows of the trees and the dim yellow streetlights.

Wen Ni was a little scared.

Unfortunately, Wen Zhiwen wouldn't come in to pick her up.

Thankfully, Jian Yuchen was there.

Although he was a bit of a jerk, he made her feel a little safer at this moment.

Wen Ni saw him walking towards the neighborhood entrance and hurried after him.

Jian Yuchen turned around, and she slowed down.

"How are you getting home?" the boy asked.

Wen Ni honestly replied, "My dad's picking me up."

"Okay." The boy said and continued walking. He had spoken first; it wasn't exactly a flirtation, was it?

Wen Ni followed with small steps. "What are you doing down here so late?"

"Going to the supermarket to buy some Coke." The dog in his arms nestled against his arm, sticking out its tongue at Wen Ni.

"Your dog is so cute! What's its name?"

Jian Yuchen glanced down at the dog in his arms. "It's my mom's dog, named Mimi."

"A girl?"

"A boy."

Ah~

"Is that your younger brother?"

Later, Mimi actually became her brother-in-law.

Wen Ni truly regretted her actions.

Putting Mimi aside, that night the moon was very round, and the wind was strong.

Jian Yuchen was arrogant, and Mimi was sweet.

Wen Ni was confused.

Because Wen Zhiwen wasn't at the entrance of the residential area.

Wen Ni took out her phone and called her mother. "Your dad, oh dear, I forgot! Take a taxi back, your dad's going to inspect the fire department at work today, I don't know what time he'll be back."

Wen Ni was speechless, "Mom! How could you forget that?"

"Mom thought you were still living at school."

Wen Ni hung up. Jian Yuchen stood not too far from her, watching her stomp her foot and storm off towards the bus stop. He quickly took a few steps, grabbed Wen Ni's hat, and pulled her back.

He was tall back in high school, and Wen Ni bumped into him and fell into his arms.

"What are you doing?" Her teeth were already aching, and he just had to come provoke her further.

chapters.title: Director Wen Has Grown Up
chapters.content:
He probably didn't expect the girl to suddenly bump into him.

Jian Yuchen opened his mouth, his breathing a little erratic, a faint fruity scent wafting from her.

Her eyes were fixed on him, as if she would get angry if he didn't give her a proper reason.

Jian Yuchen glanced to the side, looking nonchalant and impatient. "At this hour, where are the buses?"

Wen Ni knew that too. The last bus had already left in the last 10 minutes.

"Where do you live?"

Wen Ni gave him her address.

Jian Yuchen nodded, hailed a taxi, and when he opened the door, Wen Ni was still standing under the tree watching him.

Her soft hair fluttered in the wind.

"What are you standing there for? Get in."

Wen Ni came over and was shoved into the car.

Wen Ni was calculating whether she had enough pocket money, and if not, she'd have to call her mother to pay. Jian Yuchen stretched out his long legs and squeezed in as well.

The boy was tall and had long legs; when he squeezed in, the air in the back seat of the taxi seemed to thin out.

He must have showered at home; he still smelled of shower gel mixed with lemon laundry detergent from his clothes.

Mimi was behaving well in his arms. Wen Ni felt a little awkward.

But she didn't ask him why he got in the car.

It was the middle of the night, and many young girls were getting into accidents traveling alone.

Wen Ni clung to the window, her oversized school uniform covering her figure.

The two remained silent, and Wen Ni began to feel drowsy.

The driver played an old song.

Wen Ni's head swayed, and she just wanted to get home and bury herself in her bed.

After a turn, the driver suddenly swerved the steering wheel.

Wen Ni almost bounced off her seat. When Jian Yuchen leaned over and pressed down on her, his head hit her cheek.

The impact caused Wen Ni to cry out in pain.

"Are you trying to ruin my teeth?"

Her braces had broken last time, costing her her first kiss and making her the butt of jokes from the entire school for half a year.

Wen Zhiwen hadn't given her a kind look in a long time, and had even berated the boy who kissed her for being a pervert, but it was an accident, and no one should make a big deal out of it.

Wen Ni later thought about it and wondered if Wen Zhiwen had ever recognized that the boy he considered his prized future son-in-law was actually that same "pervert."

But right now, all she felt was the pain in her cavity and the inflamed area, making her head buzz.

"Let me see," Jian Yuchen glared at the driver who was driving recklessly, and lifted Wen Ni's chin.

Wen Ni covered her mouth, "No."

This position is so awkward!

Jian Yuchen frowned, "I hit you pretty hard just now, let me see."

Wen Ni dodged, "No, no."

Jian Yuchen clicked his tongue, grabbed the back of her neck and lifted her up, prying open her jaw to take a look.

This damn thing was incredibly strong; Wen Ni couldn't break free at all.

Jian Yuchen, seeing her bleeding teeth in the light, couldn't help but exclaim, "Wow, what a huge cavity!"

Wen Ni's face instantly turned bright red. She shoved him away, angrily retorting, "You, you're talking nonsense! You just ate chocolate and didn't brush your teeth! What do you mean, 'what a huge cavity'?"

Jian Yuchen's hoodie was slightly disheveled from her shove.

He silently straightened it and sat quietly in the corner.

Wen Ni, still covering her face, felt it wasn't right for her to be so fierce with Jian Yuchen, who had specially accompanied her home that evening. She leaned closer and discovered this rascal.

He was actually smiling!

Although the smile wasn't wide, Wen Ni saw it clearly!

He was smiling!

"Miss, we've arrived!" the driver interrupted abruptly, stopping the car.

"39 yuan."

Wen Ni took out her wallet from her bag; Jian Yuchen had already paid the driver.

"I have money."

"No need." The boy's large hand pressed her hand back.

The sudden contact made them both quickly pull away.

Even though Jian Yuchen was so innocent back then that he wouldn't even dare touch a girl's hand, it didn't stop him from being a sleazy old man now.

Jian Yuchen opened the car door and got out. Wen Ni got out. "We're home. You can go back now."

"It's so dark. I've already taken you to your doorstep. It's not like it's a big deal."

Wen Ni said "Oh," and added, "You're actually quite nice."

In the few times they'd spent time together privately, Wen Ni had considered reconciliation.

But seeing him always made her want to argue, so she never thought about reconciliation.

Today was a good opportunity.

Wen Ni took a few steps, and Jian Yuchen thought this girl was really easy to fool.

He took her home, and that made him nice? He was about to say something when she suddenly rushed forward, "Mom!"

Jiang Meili was already waiting at the entrance of the residential area.

"Wen Ni!"

Wen Ni ran a few steps, said something to Jiang Meili, and then ran back, "Give me your hand."

Jian Yuchen was puzzled. He held out his hand, and Wen Ni stuffed 100 yuan into it. "Go home early, this is for your round-trip fare."

"That's too much."

"Then consider it my treat for milk tea, goodbye Mimi!"

She seemed to have forgotten the unpleasantness from earlier and was about to run off with a smile.

Jian Yuchen couldn't help but pull her back.

"Is there anything else?"

"Your mouth is bleeding, you need to see the dentist."

Wen Ni looked conflicted. "I'll think about it later. It's hard to get time off now, let's wait until the weekend."

"Then I'll go with you."

?

Wen Ni was puzzled.

The boy looked serious. "I bumped into you. What if something had happened?"

Wen Ni was about to say something when he took a piece of candy from his pocket, the kind she often ate.

"This is to apologize. Now you can go back."

He turned and left.

Wen Ni didn't come back to her senses until a moment later, walking over to Jiang Meili's side.

"Who was that?"

"A classmate from the next class over, the one who’s always getting first place."

"Oh, that’s Jian Yuchen from your school, right? I remember that boy. Did he accompany you because he was worried about you coming back alone? What a good boy. You should learn from him; his grades are so good, his parents must be very happy."

Here we go again.

He has good grades, sure, but his temper is terrible.

Whatever. In the eyes of parents, good grades are a "get out of jail free" card.

Mom’s favorite boy.

"I know, I know."

She was still clutching that candy in her palm.

Later, she placed the candy on her desk and never ate it, even until it went bad.

After she and Jian Yuchen got married, he made it a habit to stock up on a bag for her every time they went to the supermarket.

Wen Ni would always keep them in her bag.

But she didn't devour a whole bag a day like she did when she was a kid.

At most, she’d have one.

Today, she could even share one with him. Hmm, Director Wen has grown up.

Look at how generous she is!

Actually willing to share.

The evening celebration banquet was held in a hotel private room next to Jinfeng.

They had invited both Shangmei and Weifeng along; after all, even if the deal didn't go through, there was no need to burn bridges. It wouldn't look good to let them leave on such bad terms.

Wen Ni was feeling refreshed and triumphant today.

Ning Yan had already sent the good news back to the company.

The contract had been officially signed as well.

"Wen Ni, you can't escape this drink tonight—

chapters.title: Jian the Dog is Quite Pitiful
chapters.content:
Since they had landed such a big order, what was a couple of drinks?

That was cold, hard cash!

It was what she, Wen Ni, deserved!

Wen Ni’s little tail was practically wagging in the air.

Jinfeng put on a grand display that evening.

They even invited the director of the local Environmental Protection Bureau and the Municipal Party Secretary.

Perhaps because Wen Ni’s proposal had taken the protection of the surrounding ecological environment into account, the approach really resonated with the local leaders, so they specifically praised Lingdu Company.

Even Ning Yan was a bit bewildered.

Wen Ni had thought she would end up drinking until she blacked out tonight.

Who knew that because the leaders were present, everyone was quite restrained, and no one was pushing drinks on anyone.

The kind of disgusting drinking games and lewd jokes Wen Ni hated didn't happen, so she ate to her heart's content and only took small sips when people came to congratulate her.

By the time the party broke up, everyone was still sober.

"Everyone has worked hard these past two days. We’ll set off to return tomorrow, and I’m giving everyone a day off. Come back to work once you’ve rested! Get your energy back!" Ning Yan announced the good news at the hotel entrance.

The Jinfeng project had dragged on for so long that it had almost been a lost cause, but now they had a second chance.

So, no one had much time to just rot at home.

One day was already plenty.

Shen Huaixu was accompanying the leaders and likely had another stop to make. From a distance, he watched Wen Ni and Jian Yuchen leave in the company car.

"President Shen seems particularly interested in Lingdu?" the department head asked, standing to the side.

Shen Huaixu paused, then said, "After all, they are our future partners."

"True. Lingdu’s design is refreshing, and the whole company gives off a professional and dedicated vibe. I’m already looking forward to the day the building is completed."

That was at least two or three years away.

But he didn't have much time left here.

Yet, to this day, Wen Ni hadn't given him even the slightest opening.

It was too tricky.

Shen Huaixu had spent many years abroad, learning business and investment, and he’d had his fair share of women—some sexier and hotter than Wen Ni, some with gentler temperaments.

It wasn't that this woman was truly irreplaceable.

But she was indeed a regret from his high school days.

To give up so easily without even trying simply didn't fit his way of doing things.

"Let's go. There will be plenty of opportunities to interact in the future anyway."

He planned to do a good job with this work now that he was back in the country.

Even if he wasn't at the H City office and was assigned to another subsidiary, as long as Wen Ni was still on this project team, they would have chances to meet.

He could also use work as an excuse to get her contact information.

If Shen Huaixu wanted to, all of this would become very simple.

That night, just after Wen Ni returned to her hotel room and finished washing up, her WeChat buzzed.

[Jinfeng Design Group Chat]

People were still being added one after another: Jinfeng’s liaison staff, several designers from Lingdu, Ning Yan, and even employees who hadn't made the trip at all.

The only one missing was Jian Yuchen.

Wen Ni didn't think much of it, assuming Jian Yuchen hadn't been added yet.

She pinned the group chat to the top, placing it above the client group, squeezed in next to the Sheng Tang International chat.

Below that, Jian Yuchen’s profile picture remained where it was before she started washing up.

He was asking her if she wanted to come to his room.

Wen Ni wasn't going.

She was exhausted; what good would come of going there?

What if that brat Ning Yan suddenly popped up again? Where would she hide?

It was hard enough to get two days of rest.

Wen Ni rubbed her stomach. She hadn't eaten her fill tonight; the food was delicious, but she’d been too busy chatting.

Wen Ni had always been the type to do whatever she wanted.

And so, she changed into shorts and a t-shirt, slipped on a pair of hotel slippers, and was ready to head out.

To prevent that jerk Jian Yuchen from finding out she wasn't in her room, she was sneaky even as she walked to the door and opened it.

Just as she pulled the door shut, a voice that haunted her like a ghost rang out.

"Where are you going?"

Wen Ni was startled, and when she turned her head, she found herself face-to-face with Jian Yuchen.

For a second, the words "Oh, hell" flashed through Wen Ni's mind.

But after years of battling Jian Yuchen, she had learned how to stay calm.

"Huh?" Wen Ni brushed her hair back. "I can't sleep, wanted to go down and walk around."

"So, you were intentionally ignoring me."

You’re good at summarizing, aren't you?

No need to say it out loud, though.

"Did you send me a message? What did it say?" Wen Ni gave herself a silent thumbs-up.

*Go, you're amazing! Future Best Actress Wen Ni!*

Jian Yuchen didn't call her bluff. "Middle of the night, dressed so nicely, where are you going to cause trouble?"

At this point, Wen Ni had nothing left to hide.

She straightened up and said with a serious face, "It’s not that I wanted to hide it from you, Master, it’s just that your disciple is feeling empty inside. I wanted to go downstairs to eat some grilled lamb, chicken legs, chicken wings, pork tenderloin, ham sausages, toothpick meat, grilled eggplant, and so on..."

Jian Yuchen breathed a sigh of relief. As long as she wasn't sneaking off to have a secret rendezvous with some Shen "Cat" or "Dog" Huai-xu, it was fine.

"Then why aren't you leading the way? Do you want your Master to drink dew behind you?"

Wen Ni paused. "You want to eat too?"

"You think your little stomach is enough to fill me up? Let's go." Jian Yuchen started walking, and Wen Ni trotted along behind him.

"I’m saying this first: you’re treating, I’m not paying."

"Let's go, you talk too much."

However, Wen Ni’s love for money was actually hidden quite deep.

But she wasn't stingy.

She might say not to let him pay, but sometimes the gifts she gave were more expensive than anyone else's.

She just liked to pick the best within her means; she believed that was a way to save money.

If she wanted to own something, she’d buy the best one at that price point right away, so she wouldn't feel the need to look for cheap alternatives later.

Sometimes when Jian Yuchen pondered what she said, it actually made a lot of sense.

As the two walked into the elevator, Wen Ni picked up her phone and noticed there were already over 30 people in the group.

"Hey, why haven't you joined the group yet?"

"What group?"

Wen Ni blinked. "The Jinfeng design communication group?"

Jian Yuchen smiled without warmth. "Shen Huaixu is in that group, right?"

Of course he was; Shen Huaixu’s wolfish ambition was plain to see.

That kid was just as devious as he was in high school.

But his tactics were too old-fashioned. Wen Ni was already his wife; did he really think he could move up?

He was only in the same group as her.

They weren't even friends; they had only added each other because of work.

Given Wen Ni’s temper, she would only handle things professionally.

Idiot. Did he think Wen Ni was still that gullible, stupid girl from high school?

The more Jian Yuchen thought about it, the more he felt like someone was constantly eyeing the meat in his bowl.

He remained silent the whole way. Wen Ni thought he was hurt because he felt excluded.

It made sense; Jian Yuchen had such a weird temper. He was just a bit good-looking, but a man’s looks couldn't be eaten as a meal forever.

Jian Yuchen was truly pitiful; he was left with no one but her who didn't despise him.

When they were old and went to do square dancing, he probably wouldn't even find an old lady willing to be his partner.

After all, at that age, the infatuation phase had long passed; who would want to look at an old geezer with a sour face?

Thinking this, Wen Ni patted Jian Yuchen on the shoulder and sighed. "Even though your temper is weird and you're annoying, I won't despise you."

Jian Yuchen, who was just thinking about how to tear Shen Huaixu into a thousand pieces—

chapters.title: Pure-Hearted Little Chili Pepper
chapters.content:
"Boss, I want mine spicy!"

Wen Ni stood in front of the barbecue stall.

At this hour, the hotel beach was still bustling.

The neon lights stretching along the coastline looked like an endless dragon, with little sparks of light in the distance.

Jian Yuchen stood behind her, keeping a distance that was neither too close nor too far.

The squid was drizzled with sauce and pressed onto the iron plate, making a sizzling sound.

Wen Ni smelled the aroma, and her stomach started drumming.

Jian Yuchen glanced down at her and said to the boss, "Mildly spicy is fine."

Wen Ni turned her head and glared at him, but Jian Yuchen didn't give her a chance to argue, pulling out his trump card immediately.

"Your tonsils."

Fine, Wen Ni wilted instantly.

Her tonsils were so fragile; they were like the Princess and the Pea of tonsils.

If she dared to eat even a tiny bit of medium-spicy food, they would go on strike.

And it would inevitably lead to a throat infection, a high fever, and loss of voice, until Wen Ni had to get nebulizer treatments and suffer for half a month before recovering.

But Wen Ni was the type to remember the taste, not the pain.

She craved it every time she saw it.

Jian Yuchen had gone through the ordeal with her two or three times.

And then he decided he would never let Wen Ni eat anything spicier than "mild" ever again.

The first time, Wen Ni had gotten into it with him at the spicy hotpot shop outside the school gate.

In the second semester of their senior year, more and more students were living off-campus because they were secretly waiting to "cook their own meals."

Wen Ni had been picked up to go home early.

Since she was going home anyway, eating at the cafeteria was pointless.

The pocket money she had saved up finally got to be put to good use.

Wen Ni ordered quite a few side dishes and sat at a table with her close girlfriends.

While waiting for the food, Wen Ni was questioned.

"Wen Ni, Shen Huaixu has gone abroad. Has he been in touch with you?"

Wen Ni pried apart her disposable chopsticks. "No. Why would I have any reason to be in touch with him?"

Her friend nudged the other, then said, "Let's not talk about that. We're going to buy milk tea. You still want the chocolate flavor, right?"

"Yeah."

They got up to leave. Only when they reached the door did one mutter, "Why did you have to bring up Shen Huaixu in front of Wen Ni? She must be very sad."

"I was just curious."

A shadow fell over them. The two looked up and saw Jian Yuchen and the group from the basketball team.

Jian Yuchen was popular and famously good-looking, so they blushed and stepped aside.

Wen Ni turned her head and saw him pushing the door open to enter.

Ever since that day after cram school, Wen Ni felt that their relationship had eased up.

So, when he walked in, she went through a long internal struggle before finally raising her hand and giving him a very casual greeting.

"Hi~"

However, Jian Yuchen just glanced at her and went off to get his food.

!

Wen Ni gasped.

Fine, that damn Jian Yuchen.

She shouldn't have reconciled with such a petty guy.

Meanwhile, the girls at the next table were still discussing him.

"Did Jian Yuchen grow taller again?"

"He looks pretty good wearing a sports headband, too. What brand is it?"

"I don't know. Should we go watch him play ball next time?"

Play ball, my foot.

Wen Ni took a sip of orange juice and scoffed internally.

The owner soon called their number.

Wen Ni brought over the dishes for the two friends who had come with her as well.

The sauce was a bit bland for her taste, so her eyes landed on the chili sauce nearby.

Just as she reached out, the harsh sound of a chair dragging across the floor rang out.

He took the chili sauce right off her table.

"..."

?

Although anyone could take the chili sauce on the table, Jian Yuchen had clearly seen her reaching for it and took it anyway. Wasn't he just deliberately making things difficult for her?

And here she was, feeling like she had been too harsh on Jian Yuchen before.

Now she felt it was completely unnecessary to have greeted this guy.

Wen Ni decided not to stoop to his level and turned to grab a bottle from the table behind her.

But a hand moved faster than hers.

Wen Ni’s eyes widened as she watched Jian Yuchen walk away with both bottles of chili sauce.

She could tolerate it once, but if she tolerated it twice, she wouldn't be Wen Ni anymore!

"Hey, are you kidding me? You're stealing my chili sauce again!"

The boys' laughter stopped, and everyone looked at Wen Ni in unison.

Wen Ni looked Jian Yuchen up and down and said irritably, "Give me one bottle back."

"Why should I?" Jian Yuchen sat back down at his seat and placed both bottles of chili sauce on the table.

Everyone was a bit confused.

Jian Yuchen didn't really talk to girls much at school.

Why did he have to bicker with this Wen Ni from Class 4 every time he ran into her?

Fan Yanwen, who was also on the basketball team, picked up a bottle to return to Wen Ni, trying to give them both a way to smooth things over, but Jian Yuchen pressed his hand down to stop him.

This was awkward.

"Do you even know how to eat spicy food? Taking two bottles? Don't end up choking yourself out of bravado."

Jian Yuchen raised his eyelids. "How do you know I can't?"

Saying that, he aggressively scooped two spoonfuls into his bowl.

Wen Ni snatched one bottle back and scooped three spoonfuls for herself.

Actually, her hand was shaking a little by the third spoonful.

Jian Yuchen sneered and scooped another.

Could Wen Ni lose to him? She wouldn't lose face; today she would show him what a "tough-as-nails beauty" was! It was just chili sauce—later, she’d make him kneel and call her 'mom'!

It was only when the landlady couldn't bear to see her chili sauce being wasted and gave them a warning that the two finally stopped.

But it was too late; the perfectly good spicy hot pot had turned into a pot of red oil...

Everyone looked at Jian Yuchen, then at Wen Ni.

They wanted to say, "Maybe just let it go..." It wouldn't be good if they got sick.

But the two stubborn fools, not knowing who they were trying to spite, just started shoveling it into their mouths.

"Wen Ni, isn't it spicy?"

"Not spicy. *Cough, cough, cough*—spicy my ass." Her face was turning red from holding it in.

"Jian Yuchen, are you okay..."

"What could possibly be wrong with me?"

Buddy, you're sweating on your forehead, buddy.

The aftermath of this chili war was that Wen Ni’s gums were completely ruined; that afternoon, she was crying and begging her homeroom teacher for leave to see a dentist. Jian Yuchen didn't fare any better—he had a bout of gastroenteritis.

The two of them ended up sharing a taxi at the school gate.

"Sh-sh-sh-shut up! It hurts so bad!"

chapters.title: Happy Little Squid
chapters.content:
For contemporary young people, when they want to go on vacation, they have neither money nor time; when they finally have the money to go on vacation, everywhere is crowded, so they might as well stay home.

It was the last night of a rare business trip. Listening to the sound of the waves, everyone felt that this was truly stolen time.

Jian Yuchen had a few drinks, and everyone listened as the guitarist over there began to play a serenade.

The gentle melody was quite different from the intense dance music from just a moment ago.

It made people feel peaceful and relaxed.

Wen Ni was eating happily when a hand reached behind her, tracing up her tailbone and pressing down on the base of her second rib.

Wen Ni shuddered, a tremor spreading from her back throughout her entire body.

Without leaving a trace, she stepped on Jian Yuchen’s instep and ground her heel down hard.

Both of them were wearing flip-flops downstairs.

The beach was soft.

Just as her toes squeezed over, the man used his toe to scoop up a handful of sand and flicked it onto her feet.

Wen Ni was furious and took a fierce bite of her baby squid.

"Hey, they're grabbing balloons over there! Let's go grab a few for the ladies."

"Let's go, let's go." Gu Wang was suddenly full of energy.

Wang Linmu patted his big belly, "I think I'll skip it with this stomach of mine."

At his age, how could he compete with the young people?

"Do you want one?" Yu Xiaozhu and the others had all gone over.

Wang Linmu was also dragged along by someone to grab balloons.

Wen Ni turned her head and almost kissed Jian Yuchen.

Afraid of being seen, she quickly leaned back.

Jian Yuchen raised an eyebrow, then asked again, "Do you want one?"

Wen Ni acted awkward and a little proud, "Well, I want that pink pig head."

"Fine."

Jian Yuchen wiped his hands, tossed his phone to her, and walked over there himself.

As soon as he joined in, the scene became a bit chaotic.

Wang Linmu couldn't keep up with the young people and retreated from the battlefield.

Jian Yuchen caught the little pink pig head on his first try.

Wen Ni was craning her neck to watch when her phone vibrated.

She looked down and saw it was an unfamiliar number.

Wen Ni answered directly, "Hello?"

There was a sudden silence on the other end.

Wen Ni glanced at the phone, "This is Mr. Jian Yuchen's phone. He'll be back in a moment. May I ask who is calling?"

The other side was quiet for a while, then a gentle female voice spoke up, "Wen Ni, is that you?"

The answer suddenly popped into Wen Ni's mind.

Fang Hui.

"Ah, it's me. You're looking for Jian Yuchen, right?"

"It's okay, if he's busy, it's the same if I tell you."

"It's like this, I just returned to the country and I'm looking for a job. I haven't been in touch with many high school classmates, so I wanted to ask if you'd like to go out for a meal together."

chapters.title: I Blocked Her
chapters.content:
Wen Ni felt the sea breeze make her face go a bit numb.

Inviting them to dinner—why call only Jian Yuchen?

Wen Ni curled her lips, not exposing Fang Hui's little motives, "Jian Yuchen is back, you can tell him yourself."

They weren't in a normal, romantic marriage.

But Wen Ni would not allow Jian Yuchen to have other thoughts.

Since they were married, they were married. She had no intention of cheating on him, and he had better not have any wandering eyes.

When Jian Yuchen walked back, based on his years of experience with her, he sensed she was unhappy.

But Wen Ni smiled naturally, "Fang Hui is looking for you."

Jian Yuchen’s brow twitched.

He took the phone, "Hello."

Wen Ni bit into a baby octopus, watching the pink pig head still floating above Jian Yuchen's head.

She thought she had made a great choice.

Jian Yuchen was exactly like a pig head!

A big pig head!

"I've been quite busy lately, so I probably won't be able to make time. Sorry."

"Let's talk about it when there's time."

"Yeah, we aren't in H City."

"Thanks for the invitation, goodbye."

Jian Yuchen hung up, and Wen Ni suddenly felt a bit sour in her heart.

The jerk—whenever he talked to her, his tone was never that good.

But with Fang Hui, it was "Thanks for the invitation" and "Sorry!"

He was so gentle it didn't even sound like him.

Wen Ni felt bubbles of jealousy rising in her throat.

Well, back then, who didn't say they were a perfect match?

Fang Hui liked elegant opera, played the piano, could sing, and stood there looking graceful and beautiful.

She spoke gently and treated people kindly.

Wen Ni felt she had truly memorized the script of a "vicious supporting female character" by heart.

If Jian Yuchen hadn't married her and had stayed single for a few more years, and Fang Hui had come back, wouldn't they have been a perfect, talented couple?

Jian Yuchen blocked Fang Hui's number. Seeing Wen Ni only focused on eating, he handed her the balloon, "Your pig head."

Wen Ni glanced at the pink pig head, feeling like the little pig was mocking her.

She ignored Jian Yuchen.

The man sat down, and then her denim shorts were tugged. Wen Ni turned her head; he had already tied the pig head balloon there.

!

"Like a little tail."

"Yeah, doesn't it look good?" Jian Yuchen rested his face on one hand, while the other hand teased her "little tail."

The pig head swayed back and forth, dropping down and rising up.

Wen Ni pursed her lips; she didn't want to talk to him right now.

"I deleted her," the man suddenly said.

Wen Ni was stunned, turning to look at him, thinking she had misheard.

Jian Yuchen repeated it, "Deleted. There's no point in keeping it."

"If she looks for you again, just say you're busy. We weren't that close as classmates anyway."

Not to mention they weren't close, they were barely acquaintances.

Even if they had been close, now that he was married to her, it wasn't appropriate to keep in touch with Fang Hui.

Wen Ni really wanted to ask why he blocked her, but Gu Wang and the others had returned with their balloons, and the topic ended there.

By the time they returned to the hotel, Wen Ni hadn't had a chance to ask.

Finally, after saying goodbye to the others on their floor, as soon as the elevator door closed, Wen Ni jumped to Jian Yuchen's side, "Why did you block Fang Hui?"

She remembered back when they were together, everyone said they were a perfect match.

When was that? The second semester of senior year, everyone was in the final sprint, and Fang Hui and Jian Yuchen got together.

The news came from her deskmate, who had a long-standing crush on Jian Yuchen.

But that crush back then was just her own little secret.

"How do you know she's with Jian Yuchen?" The person in front of her was a die-hard fan of Fang Hui and couldn't help but ask.

The deskmate sighed, "Hey, a bunch of us were doing cleaning duty yesterday and passed by the small garden. We heard Fang Hui confess, and today they were walking together. If that's not being together, what is?"

"Besides, if Jian Yuchen isn't with Fang Hui, who else would he be with?"

One was a top student at the level of a school heartthrob, the other was an arts student who won honors for the school at the level of a school beauty.

They were simply the handsome man and beautiful woman of the 11th High School.

The person in front slumped back around.

Wen Ni paused her pen and continued writing her test paper.

"What, Jian Yuchen is dating someone else? Then what about Wen Ni?"

"Are you sick?" Wen Ni threw a piece of scratch paper at them.

The person laughed and pulled their head back.

"Wen Ni, I know you two are impossible, I was just joking."

Annoying.

What did he mean by "impossible"? Thinking she wasn't good enough for a top student, right?

Wen Ni was annoyed. Her grades were improving very fast now, okay? It was the last semester.

She wanted to get into a good university and get far away from Wen Zhiwen.

In the future, she would earn a lot of money, bring her mother over, and never let Wen Zhiwen scold her again.

Wait! Why was she thinking about being with Jian Yuchen?

Ever since that one time they happened to be going the same way, they would walk into the residential complex one after the other every day.

As time went on, everyone said Jian Yuchen and Wen Ni were living together.

High school boys had loose lips, but later, as more tutors moved into the complex, the gossip died down.

After all, everyone was on the same path.

Jian Yuchen and Wen Ni didn't really have much interaction.

What was there to talk about regarding dating?

Now Jian Yuchen had a proper partner, and it was Fang Hui. Fang Hui was so beautiful.

Wen Ni didn't know what was going on. Back then, even though Fang Hui had just started dating Jian Yuchen, she really liked to find Wen Ni to hang out with.

They had been in the same school for so many years and even in the same class before.

By high school, they only had the courtesy of a nod.

Wen Ni couldn't figure out why she came to find her.

"Tutoring?" Wen Ni was a bit puzzled, "But I already have a tutoring class."

"Group study is more efficient. Sunday is a day off, right? We'd only tutor for half a day. My dad heard from your dad that I'm falling behind in my academic subjects, so the teacher suggested it. There will be many other classmates, so we can discuss any problems we don't understand."

Wen Ni really didn't want to go. She didn't know what to say to Fang Hui, so she refused.

But that night, when she got home for dinner, Wen Zhiwen actually brought it up.

"Fang Hui invited you, why didn't you go? You're so petty."

"What's wrong with going openly? Studying and exchanging ideas is a good thing. Stop going out to the mall to buy snacks with those classmates of yours all day."

"Look at yourself, what's with that hair? So short."

Wen Ni used to have long hair, but Wen Zhiwen said Wen Ni's face shape wasn't as smooth as Fang Hui's and didn't look good, so she just went to the barbershop and got it cut short. Because of this, Wen Zhiwen scolded her for looking even worse.

But Wen Ni liked it; she thought it suited her perfectly and it was easy to wash.

"I told Fang Hui for you. Sunday afternoon at 1 o'clock, at the municipal library. Here's 100 yuan, don't spend it recklessly."

"..."

Whenever it came to Fang Hui, Wen Zhiwen was particularly demanding.

Usually, he wouldn't give her a penny if she wanted to go out, but this time he gave her 100.

Actually, the one who looked down on her the most was Wen Zhiwen.

Because he couldn't see that she had scored 40 points higher than Fang Hui in academic subjects this semester.

He didn't think Wen Ni could be better than anyone else.

So he only thought that Wen Ni was no good.

Wen Ni didn't want to explain to him that Fang Hui only wanted to get into an arts college now and her grades weren't great.

If she said it, she'd just get scolded, like, "Fang Hui has talent, what do you have?"

A weekend study group? Fine, she'd go.

She dawdled and took the bus to the library that day. Fang Hui was already waiting for her at the entrance, and Jian Yuchen was behind her.

Both of the annoying people were together. It was truly...

chapters.title: Physics is Very Romantic
chapters.content:
It was early spring, and the second semester of senior year had just begun.

It was a rare weekend, and Wen Ni had originally wanted to catch up on sleep at home and wake up naturally.

Since Fang Hui’s suggestion meant wasting a precious holiday face-to-face with Jian Yuchen, Wen Ni’s gloom was understandable.

She wore a pink, fleece-lined hoodie, her fluffy short hair sporting a natural wave, and her face still carried traces of fatigue.

When she walked over, Wen Ni didn’t think much of it; it was just the most ordinary student attire.

But when she saw Jian Yuchen standing with Fang Hui, Wen Ni felt like a moving little pink penguin.

Fang Hui was wearing a light, white coat over a matching thin sweater, slim-fitting, with a white tulle skirt underneath. She stood there, graceful and slender. Even though they were all still in their adolescence—a time when everyone was quite sloppy and didn't know how to dress themselves—Fang Hui already stood out like a beautiful swan.

Compared to her, this penguin looked rather comical.

Jian Yuchen stood there in a black windbreaker. For some reason, Wen Ni felt the corners of his mouth slowly curling up, as if he were ruthlessly mocking her.

Still, they were a couple—why did they have to drag her, an innocent bystander, along for their study session?

"Wen Ni, you're here! We just arrived, too," Fang Hui said, hugging her arm. "Wen Ni, did you grow a bit taller?"

Wen Ni felt she hadn't grown an inch since the eighth grade.

Fang Hui’s eyesight wasn't very good.

Jian Yuchen opened the library door. The heat was on inside, the temperature was just right, and there was a faint scent of coffee.

Most of the people here were seniors or college students.

They kept to themselves, though; you could tell the difference at a glance.

Jian Yuchen walked ahead on his own, hands in his pockets, a crossbody bag slung over his back.

He didn't look like he was there to study at all.

Wen Ni looked at the people around her, heads buried in their books, and sighed.

*Sigh*~ Why is it so infuriating to compare yourself to others?

Some people spend their time after class playing games, basketball, or participating in all sorts of activities, yet you never see their grades drop.

Ah, could Jian Yuchen be one of those people who says, "Oh, I never study," but is actually grinding like crazy in private?

Yes, he must be secretly memorizing vocabulary under his covers at night and doing endless practice papers.

Wen Ni crawled into the darkness of her own imagination.

At this moment, Fang Hui smiled and waved at someone ahead. Wen Ni looked over and saw familiar faces.

There were quite a few people; she wondered if there would be enough seats.

They occupied a long table in the library. Wen Ni found a spot in the very corner; after all, when the villainess isn't following her career path, who would pay attention to her?

She thought about her Sunday homework and took the practice papers she’d brought out of her bag.

"Yuchen, you sit..."

The boy had already sat down opposite Wen Ni.

Fang Hui’s expression froze for a moment, but she quickly walked over as well.

Wen Ni looked up and realized they were both there.

She grumbled inwardly about why they had to choose this spot when there were so many other seats.

Now, everyone was looking over, whether intentionally or not.

"Study God, can we ask you if we don't understand something?"

Jian Yuchen looked up, waited a moment, and then gave a cold "Mm."

But he had always been indifferent to people at school; the fact that he was willing to help with review was already good enough.

Unlike at school, you couldn't really talk in the library. Everyone quietly got up from their seats, lined up beside Jian Yuchen, pointed to the problems they were stuck on, and asked him to help with the logic.

Wen Ni felt she was making good progress today.

But when she got to the physics problems, she hit a wall.

Her absolute Achilles' heel!

Just as she was chewing on her pen, a pair of hands snatched her paper away.

Wen Ni looked up. Fang Hui’s gaze fell upon her, and after handing a coffee to Jian Yuchen, she smiled at Wen Ni.

Wen Ni inexplicably felt like she was interrupting a couple’s date.

She reached out quickly, wanting to snatch the paper back.

Jian Yuchen had already spoken: "If you don't know how to do it, why don't you ask?"

Wen Ni thought to herself, *I haven't even tried yet, how do you know I can't do it!*

"For this formula..." Jian Yuchen started explaining directly.

Those who were buried in their work immediately pricked up their ears and leaned over to look.

Wen Ni, intending to listen and see how he solved it, secretly focused for a moment. As it turned out, this guy really knew his stuff. When he saw she didn't understand, he immediately noticed and silently explained the previous problem along the way.

"Do this problem again. The method is exactly the same as the one I just showed you."

Wen Ni said "Oh" and took the paper to look it over.

Strange to say, Jian Yuchen was in a pretty good mood today and hadn't provoked her.

So, she would peacefully coexist with him for a little while.

Just for a little while.

Any longer than that wouldn't do.

Wen Ni felt she was becoming increasingly magnanimous.

Wen Ni finished the problem and immediately handed it to him, unable to help but puff out her chest—it shouldn't be wrong this time.

"Right, remember this problem-solving logic for next time. The points are basically free." The boy’s voice was clear and crisp. Wen Ni thought that even though Jian Yuchen was a jerk, he could occasionally say something pleasant.

She took the paper back with a beaming smile, a smile so bright that Jian Yuchen’s Adam’s apple bobbed.

However, her smile immediately froze on her face.

On which paper had this kid Jian Yuchen been scribbling just now!?

*Ahhhhhh*, this was the best she had ever done based on her own hard work!

She had treasured it so carefully she’d almost framed it in an A4 document folder.

And he dared to write formulas on it!

Wen Ni looked at the people around her and couldn't yell at Jian Yuchen.

After all, no one else knew, but she still felt a little... aggrieved.

She folded the paper carefully and tucked it into her bag.

"Cough, not going to look at the formula again?"

"Nothing to look at. I'm going to find some books." Wen Ni slumped, dejected.

?

She was so happy just a moment ago, why was she suddenly angry?

Wen Ni stood up and left.

She had come to this library when she was a child; she didn't know when it had been renovated.

The old-fashioned floor tiles were gone, replaced by a modern, high-tech design.

Looking at the dazzling array of bookshelves, Wen Ni felt like she couldn't even find her way around.

She really wanted to go to the romance novel section.

But in the end, she wandered into the study materials and senior year area.

Wen Ni looked at the physics books she had absolutely no interest in and silently walked through the shelves.

Someone’s footsteps matched hers. Through the shelves, she saw the boy’s tall figure.

The library was so quiet she could only hear footsteps and the sound of pages turning.

She casually pulled a book from a shelf on the other side, turned her head, and went to the windowsill to read.

Someone came up beside her, and she moved over to make room.

"Reading Lawrence?"

Wen Ni looked up. She didn't know when Jian Yuchen had appeared beside her again.

How would Wen Ni know anything about Lawrence?

"Physics is very romantic. If you study it with heart, you will fall in love with it."

Physics is romantic, my foot. The most she’d ever loved it was when she finally scored a 60.

"Where is the romance in it..." Wen Ni muttered under her breath.

Is this the world of top students? It’s too perverted.

"Every atom in your body comes from an exploded star. The atoms forming your left hand might have come from a different star than those forming your right. This is the most poetic thing I know about physics: You are all stardust. — Lawrence Krauss."

Wen Ni blinked. Jian Yuchen explained, "It's from this book."

Wen Ni flipped to the front cover: *A Universe from Nothing*.

Wen Ni couldn't even figure out what kind of book this was, then looked at Jian Yuchen again.

His gaze was very gentle today.

Not aggressive at all.

Wait!

He is Jian Yuchen!

How could she be so careless and be deceived by his appearance?

Wen Ni, you fool!

Wen Ni suddenly became alert.

"Are you trying to say I'm uncultured on purpose?"

Saying a string of things she didn't understand, something about atoms in the left hand and atoms in the right hand...

That must be what he meant.

How could Jian Yuchen have a normal discussion with her about Lawrence or whatever?

Jian Yuchen choked, his face full of absurdity. "What have you been listening to in class?"

*Look, look, look*, he’s showing his fox tail now.

He’s even getting angry because she saw through him.

"None of your business." If she didn't listen in class, it was because she hadn't built a good foundation. She was just catching up now.

"My grades have clearly improved lately, okay?" After Wen Ni muttered this, she saw Fang Hui standing by a row of bookshelves in front, watching them quietly.

Wen Ni was stunned. She felt that being alone with Jian Yuchen wasn't appropriate.

Even though Jian Yuchen had come to argue with her.

"Oh, you're here. I was just wondering where you both went." Fang Hui walked over with a smile.

She looked at the book in Wen Ni’s hand.

"Wen Ni, you like reading this? I remember Shen Huaixu liked it too. Has he been in touch with you lately?"

Wen Ni shook her head. "Why would he be in touch with me?"

There was no relationship to begin with. He went to the United States, the time difference was huge, so what was there to talk about?

He couldn't help her much with physics anyway; asking Shen Huaixu was less effective than asking Jian Yuchen.

Fang Hui looked at Jian Yuchen and then said, "Almost forgot he went to the US. Let's go, everyone said they want to go out for lunch. Wen Ni, is there anything you want to eat?"

There were plenty of things Wen Ni wanted to eat.

"What are the options?"

"Oh, they said they wanted barbecue."

"Then barbecue it is..."

If she split the bill with her 100 yuan, it should be enough.

She hadn't even spent all the money Wen Zhiwen gave her.

"Okay, I'll tell them later and take a count."

Fang Hui turned her head and asked with a smile, "What about you, Yuchen?"

"Whatever."

Wen Ni thought his tone was truly awful. Was Fang Hui a masochist to pick such a partner?

Watching him keep a cold face all day.

Jian Yuchen’s future wife would be truly unlucky.

Fang Hui’s eyes curved into smiles, and she nodded gently.

In the end, everyone decided to go for barbecue.

There was a food court in the mall near the library.

When they sat down, most of the people were boys with boys and girls with girls.

"There’s a new game center upstairs. I have a membership. Should we go play a round later?"

"No thanks. My game console at home is practically gathering dust. I’ve got exams in a few months, so I should finish those first."

"When will this miserable life ever end? Do you think things will be easier once we get to college?"

"Probably not. My sister is tired as a dog, too."

Wen Ni sipped her cola, listening to them chat about everything under the sun.

"By the way, which universities and majors are you all planning to apply for?"

"I have a lot of things I want to study, but I'm afraid they won't take me."

"Study God, what major are you planning on?"

Wen Ni followed everyone's gaze toward him.

"Haven't decided yet."

What a boring answer.

But Wen Ni knew that whatever university he ended up at, it wouldn't be a bad one.

"What about you, Fang Hui?"

"Media. I want to go to the Communication University."

That made sense; Fang Hui had been working hard toward that goal all along.

It was Wen Ni's turn.

She said, "Wherever I get in, I get in."

She really didn't have a goal. Currently, she was still quite far from the university Wen Zhiwen would be satisfied with.

The barbecue was served quickly, and the heavy topic was soon cast to the back of their minds.

While eating, everyone shared some gossip.

For Wen Ni, it was like opening the door to a new world.

It turned out everyone had been up to quite a lot of mischief behind the scenes.

After the meal, everyone headed back to the library to claim their seats.

Fang Hui was acting strange today; instead of sticking with Jian Yuchen, she insisted on walking with her.

"Wen Ni, could you let me see your physics test paper later? The one from this morning."

Wen Ni was puzzled. "My paper is full of mistakes. You should borrow one from someone else."

Why was she asking to borrow a test paper when Jian Yuchen was right there?

"You don't understand. With him... if I do the problems as poorly as I have been, I'm afraid he'll laugh at me."

Wen Ni understood. The downside of having a boyfriend with such good grades had finally surfaced.

Being a girlfriend must be so stressful!

Sigh, she never expected Fang Hui to have days like this.

It just went to show that there were plenty of people who ignored their academic subjects to pursue the arts, only to find themselves cramming at the last minute.

Wen Ni felt a subtle emotion.

Fang Hui was borrowing her test paper.

But she couldn't be intimidated; her own grades weren't bad anymore.

Wen Ni opened her bag and handed the paper to her.

"This is the best I've ever done. Give it back to me when you're finished."

"Okay." Fang Hui agreed gently, though her hands kept flipping through the paper, searching for problems.

When she saw a problem Jian Yuchen had left in the margin, her smile suddenly froze. She then gave Wen Ni a complex look.

"What's wrong?" Wen Ni slurped her pearl milk tea.

Fang Hui lowered her eyes and said with a smile, "Nothing. The problem-solving logic is very clear."

Wen Ni tucked the paper away.

Even though Jian Yuchen had written on it, she was still very satisfied with this test paper.

She had to keep it in her little iron box.

It was the first time she had scored so high in physics, all on her own.

"Wen Ni."

"Hmm?"

Fang Hui continued to link her arm with hers. "When you were with Shen Huaixu, what did you guys talk about?"

Wen Ni thought for a moment. "We didn't really talk about much. Just went over problems."

Fang Hui was surprised. "You don't have to be afraid that I'll tell anyone. I'll keep your secret."

Couples didn't just do math problems; they would surely say sweet things like "I love you" or "I want to be with you forever."

Wen Ni took another slurp of her milk tea.

"It's true. What else would I talk to him about?"

"I really envy you guys. Yuchen is so hard to figure out. What do you think of him?"

Wen Ni almost rolled her eyes. "What could I possibly think of Jian Yuchen? My thought on him is: don't touch me."

Fang Hui let out an imperceptible sigh of relief. "Why do you dislike him so much?"

"He’s not a hundred-yuan bill; why should I have to like him?"

Fang Hui was so strange. Was she not allowed to dislike her boyfriend?

She was so obsessed.

Fang Hui nodded. "But Yuchen is quite good to me. The first time I met him, my textbook fell, and he helped me pick it up. My friends said he usually ignores everyone, so if he was willing to help me pick it up, he must like me."

"And whenever we run into each other at school, he often looks back at me."

"Back then, I really felt so sweet. I couldn't even believe it was real."

Wen Ni had never been particularly fond of anyone, so she couldn't relate to these feelings.

She could only nod in agreement. "Yeah."

chapters.title: Am I Pregnant?
chapters.content:
"Wen Ni, I really love Yuchen."

Why was she emphasizing that? She already knew.

Wen Ni didn't quite understand why Fang Hui was confessing to her.

Where did that test paper go later?

Wen Ni remembered. After returning from the library, she really did put it in that little iron box, and it was still sitting on a shelf at home.

Should she take it out and look at it?

Her best physics grade.

She never scored that high on the college entrance exam, either.

But what problem did Jian Yuchen write on the back for her back then?

Should she go home and check...

Would it be embarrassing if she couldn't solve it?

Wen Ni's mind was a mess. The question she had just asked—"Why did you block Fang Hui?"—suddenly made her heart race because of these memories.

According to Fang Hui, that guy really liked her back then.

No wonder he dragged her to watch those first-love movies and stare into each other's eyes that night...

Could it be that he still wasn't over her?!

Jian Yuchen took a bite of the squid in her hand, frowning in confusion at her question. "That’s called the boundaries of a married man. First, there’s no business connection. Second, not being in contact for years doesn't affect anything. Third... I don't want to invite trouble for myself."

Although Wen Ni thought Jian Yuchen was truly cold and heartless, she had to admit that she felt a bit pleased inside.

After all, she hadn't added that half-baked "first love" boyfriend either, had she?

Jian Yuchen still had the nerve to chat with his first love in front of her; that wouldn't be appropriate, would it?

"Full?"

Wen Ni nodded, seeing a pregnant woman walking by, holding a small child.

Wen Ni paused mid-bite of her skewer.

"What's wrong? Did you choke?" Jian Yuchen asked, looking down.

Wen Ni turned her head abruptly and swallowed hard. "My period... how many days has it been?"

Jian Yuchen's movements also paused.

At least five days late.

It should have come a long time ago.

Wen Ni had a good physique and her period was always on time. They had used birth control from start to finish, and there had never been any slip-ups.

But there was always a "what if."

The more Wen Ni thought about it, the more panicked she became.

She didn't want to be pregnant at this critical juncture.

It meant she wouldn't be able to follow up on the Jinfeng project; she didn't have the heart or the energy for it.

Ten months of pregnancy wasn't the end of it once the baby was born.

It wasn't as if you could just be an absentee parent because you had money, a nanny, and a confinement nurse.

The most important thing Wen Ni learned from Wen Zhiwen was that not everyone was qualified to be a competent parent.

When you bring a child into this world, you have the responsibility and obligation to let them feel the beauty of the world.

This was completely outside of Wen Ni's plans.

She felt anxious immediately. "What should we do?"

"There's a pharmacy nearby. Go back to the room and wait for me. Don't run around."

Wen Ni nodded. "Buy a few different brands. Buy several."

"Okay."

Thinking about how she had been drinking recently, Wen Ni felt incredibly frustrated. She had even been staying up late.

Back in the hotel room, Wen Ni waited anxiously.

Sitting down felt uncomfortable, standing felt uncomfortable, and lying down felt even worse.

The door card swiped open, and Jian Yuchen walked in with a bag of pregnancy tests from various brands. "Do you want me to go in with you?"

Wen Ni's face darkened. "No way."

She walked over, took the bag, took a deep breath, and started toward the bathroom, only to silently turn back around.

Her voice had a hint of a sob. "What do I do, Jian Yuchen!"

For once, the man didn't bicker with her. "Test first, then we'll see."

Wen Ni took two steps and turned to look at him again. "What if...?"

"Then we have it. Abortion hurts the body. At worst, I'll quit my job and stay home to take care of the baby." Jian Yuchen put his hands on his hips. "Go, hurry."

Wen Ni looked at him suspiciously, took two steps, and came back. "Really?"

"Really. I can do investments even if I quit my job. I won't let you and the baby starve. Go!" He carefully escorted her to the bathroom door. "Call me if you need anything."

When Wen Ni went in, Jian Yuchen waited at the door.

Through the frosted glass, he could only see a silhouette moving.

Jian Yuchen felt anxious.

He felt like he hadn't been this nervous even when he was looking at red and green stock charts for the first time.

His palms were sweating.

He couldn't help but think that when they bought this apartment, they hadn't considered the school district.

It seemed there weren't any good kindergartens nearby; should they move?

And there was no room for a nursery.

Kids are kids, after all; you can't just make a nursery look like an adult's room.

"Ah!!!"

Jian Yuchen's train of thought was interrupted. He burst through the door, nervous. "What is it? What's wrong? Are you not feeling well?"

Wen Ni lined up the pregnancy tests. "Does this mean there's nothing?"

Jian Yuchen took a look. All single lines.

Wen Ni let out a heavy sigh of relief. "It must be because I've been under too much pressure lately. I knew it."

In an instant, the clouds parted for her, and she happily strolled out of the bathroom. "Oh my, my period is really mischievous."

Jian Yuchen was still staring at the pregnancy tests.

"What are you doing? You look so disappointed. Do you want a baby that much?"

Jian Yuchen sighed. "Not necessarily, but if it really happened, I would have looked forward to it."

What would their child be like? Who would they resemble? Boy or girl? He would have looked forward to all of that.

But it was fine that it didn't happen now; otherwise, with her workaholic nature, she definitely wouldn't take a proper maternity leave just as Jinfeng was starting up.

Seeing him looking so disappointed, Wen Ni murmured, "You were looking forward to it that much..."

Jian Yuchen quickly composed himself.

He disposed of the items. "Are you still feeling unwell?"

"A little." Wen Ni held her waist. She didn't know if she was just tired from the last two days or what, but she felt sore and weak all over.

Soon, Wen Ni realized something was wrong.

Because the "Aunt Flo" that had given them both such a scare had finally arrived.

Jian Yuchen had to go out and buy her some sanitary products.

I don’t know where he managed to find red date and longan soup when he returned, but after Wen Ni finished a bowl, she finally felt a bit more comfortable.

Jian Yuchen took a shower and then curled up behind her.

His warm palms pressed against her abdomen, massaging it slowly, and Wen Ni began to feel drowsy.

In her hazy state, nestled in his arms, she remembered back in high school when she didn't even know her period had started.

She hadn't realized it even after a class ended, and she just walked right out.

It wasn't until she heard a few boys making fun of her that she realized what had happened.

This period had come at an inconvenient time; the girls in the class had all been called away by the music teacher to try on choir uniforms. Wen Ni had been a step behind, and by the time she got there, everyone was gone. She couldn't very well go digging through other people's schoolbags.

Being mocked by the boys didn't make Wen Ni feel ashamed; hadn't the teachers said this was a normal physiological phenomenon?

These idiots were conflating an uncontrollable period with incontinence, and Wen Ni didn't want to converse with the mentally challenged.

It was a waste of time to even acknowledge them.

She was about to go buy pads herself when she was grabbed by the arm and dragged back just as she reached the stairwell.

"What are you doing!?" Wen Ni was startled.

chapters.title: The Princess and the Pea
chapters.content:
Jian Yuchen expressionlessly took off his school uniform jacket and tied it around her waist. "Do you have any?"

"No..." That was exactly where she was going to buy some.

"What brand?"

Wen Ni was stunned. "Huh?"

"I asked you what brand."

"Just... the blue one. You just need to pick the square-shaped one, don't accidentally buy panty liners..."

Wen Ni doubted he even understood what she was talking about, but she still couldn't believe Jian Yuchen was actually going to buy them for her; she felt like he was plotting something against her.

Jian Yuchen frowned. "It's hard for me to find it like this."

He leaned in, bringing his ear close to her. "Tell me the brand, be specific, so I don't buy the wrong thing. I have no experience."

He said a whole string of words in one breath, a complete contrast to his usual deadpan self who only knew how to "heh" or sneer.

Wen Ni didn't react for a moment.

The boy leaned in, his ear almost brushing against her lips.

He smelled of clean lemon-scented laundry detergent mixed with the fragrance of sunshine. Wen Ni blinked, pursed her lips, and whispered the brand and size to him.

Jian Yuchen said, "Alright, go wait in the restroom."

Wen Ni didn't even have time to ask how he would get them to her.

Because the situation no longer allowed her to stand in the stairwell.

Wen Ni hurried into the restroom and locked herself in a stall.

After a long while, Wen Ni felt like class was about to start, and she began to wonder if Jian Yuchen had lied to her.

"Wen Ni?"

Wen Ni quickly responded, "I'm here!"

The girl stopped outside the stall door and passed a supermarket bag over the top.

"Wen Ni, Jian Yuchen asked me to give this to you."

Judging by the voice, the girl was Yu Hui, their class's physics representative.

She had been in the same physics competition group as Jian Yuchen before.

Wen Ni suddenly felt she had misunderstood him; he was actually quite reliable in a pinch.

"Thanks, Huihui."

"No problem~ Though you and Jian Yuchen argue so much, I didn't expect him to be so helpful to you."

Wen Ni opened the bag and found that it actually contained women's underwear... her face turned beet red instantly.

It felt so awkward.

Although there were boarding students at the school and the supermarket sold these, most people didn't buy them there.

Especially since it was Jian Yuchen buying them for her.

There was also a pack of wet wipes inside. She cleaned herself up briefly and came out; there was no helping the school uniform pants.

She could only cover up with Jian Yuchen's jacket.

Yu Hui was still waiting for her outside. "He seemed quite anxious. He couldn't find anyone to deliver it, and it just so happened I was called away by the head teacher and didn't go try on the choir uniforms. He stopped me when I came downstairs."

As she was speaking, she saw Jian Yuchen.

The boy was leaning against the railing, and he looked over the moment she came out.

Wen Ni didn't quite know how to thank him; she always felt awkward around Jian Yuchen.

"Thanks. I'll pay you back later, and the jacket—if you don't mind, I'll wash it and return it to you."

Jian Yuchen raised an eyebrow; hearing a "thank you" from her mouth was truly rare.

"Okay."

After saying that, he nodded to Yu Hui and headed back to his classroom.

Soon, he disappeared, with his arm slung around a boy's shoulder.

"Wen Ni, don't you think Jian Yuchen will be a very good boyfriend in the future?"

Wen Ni was startled. "Huh?"

Yu Hui said, "Look, he'll buy this for a girl, and even though you argue with him every day, he's still so gentlemanly. How bad could he be to a girlfriend? Even Fang Hui, who is so stuck-up, likes him, doesn't she?"

That seemed to make some sense.

Lying in bed, Wen Ni thought about it and realized that in the three years she had been married to Jian Yuchen, he really hadn't let her suffer any major grievances.

The little disputes between couples that she often saw online were rarely seen in their relationship.

Wen Ni suddenly turned her head to look at him.

Jian Yuchen propped up his upper body. "Not feeling well?"

"No."

It was just a dull ache, a normal phenomenon.

"Jian Yuchen, are you this nice to everyone?"

"Have you bought sanitary pads for everyone in your class?"

What kind of nonsense was that.

"Why would I buy them for them?" The man was speechless; he didn't even know most of them.

Wen Ni burrowed into his arms, blinking as she looked at him. "Then how did you think to buy them for me back in high school?"

Jian Yuchen revealed that mysterious smile again. "Thought you were pathetic."

Wen Ni rolled her eyes and turned away.

She knew that dog couldn't spit out ivory.

Seeing her tossing and turning like a pancake, Jian Yuchen lay down next to her as well.

Wen Ni didn't ask if he had finished packing; with him around, she didn't need to worry about those things.

She stared at the bedside lamp and fell asleep before long.

Jian Yuchen watched her sleeping form before leaning down to press a kiss to her forehead.

"Silly girl, I've only ever bought them for you."

He had been standing by her side for so many years, yet she was dull enough not to notice even this.

Jian Yuchen sighed. Forget it, it wasn't the first day he knew she was slow.

The man lay down slowly, and before long, she automatically rolled into his arms, sprawling across him.

Jian Yuchen tucked the quilt around her and patted her back gently, falling asleep shortly after.

The next morning, fearing someone would discover she had slept in the same bed as Jian Yuchen, Wen Ni went downstairs early to wait.

After arriving in H City, she took her luggage from Jian Yuchen and they went their separate ways, planning to meet at the underground parking garage.

As soon as Wen Ni got into the car, she started complaining.

"That was like a secret meeting between revolutionary party members."

"With that sneaky look of yours, if the enemy saw you, they'd have to ask 'Baka' a couple of times."

"I was just afraid of being discovered." Wen Ni fastened her seatbelt. "Hurry home! I'm sleepy."

She could catch up on sleep from afternoon until night; she would leave tomorrow's struggles to tomorrow's Wen Ni.

When they reached the residential complex, Jian Yuchen specifically went to the fruit shop at the entrance to buy some fruit, intending to make a fruit salad for Wen Ni.

They were regulars, so the owner would give them a discount.

By the time they got home, Wen Ni headed straight for the bathroom to wash up. When Jian Yuchen finished unpacking and making the fruit salad, Wen Ni had already changed into her pajamas, grabbed a small blanket, and was lying on the sofa.

Jian Yuchen: ...

She certainly knew how to enjoy life.

"Princess and the Pea, which one do you plan to eat first?"

"Yellow peach tart and brown sugar water, not too much, what are we eating tonight?"

"I'll see what's in the fridge and make whatever; probably noodles."

"Alright then." Wen Ni burrowed deeper into the sofa.

The group chats were still buzzing, but Wen Ni absolutely ignored work during her time off.

However, when she opened her phone, she didn't see a work group, but a high school reunion chat.

【How many people haven't signed up yet?】

【Wen Ni still hasn't replied.】

【This time it's a reunion for us classmates in H City. Everyone from our year can attend. Oh, and don't forget to call Jian Yuchen. I saw him in a financial report last time; a genius is still a genius.】

Wen Ni suddenly flipped over. Reunion

chapters.title: The Decision is in Your Hands
chapters.content:
A warm sensation surged out, and Wen Ni adjusted her posture uncomfortably.

Jian Yuchen was still in the kitchen boiling noodles, the blue flame of the stove making a faint sound.

"What's wrong? You look like someone who just jumped up from a deathbed." Jian Yuchen, with his apron half-tied around his waist and his white shirt still on, asked when he saw her.

Wen Ni said, "Where's your phone?"

Jian Yuchen raised his eyebrows in surprise. "That's not like you, Ms. Wen. Three years into marriage and you're thinking of checking up on me?"

Had she started to care about him?

Wen Ni was actually a little bit curious about Jian Yuchen's phone.

She wanted to know if this man usually read novels, comics, or played games on his phone.

People have to eat and relieve themselves; he must have some normal hobbies, right?

Although she had known the password for years, she rarely opened his phone. The only two times were when Jian Yuchen was carrying her things and couldn't scan a QR code, so he had asked her to take it.

He took out his phone and tossed it over, and Wen Ni hurriedly caught it.

"Money isn't meant to be wasted like that, what if I hadn't caught it?" Wen Ni said crossly.

Jian Yuchen said, "Aren't you quite agile?"

She glared at him and lay back down carefully, so as not to disturb "Aunt Flo."

Opening Jian Yuchen's phone, she found there were over 99 friend requests.

Wen Ni clicked in and saw all sorts of things.

The brat was still this popular...

She wondered what these people liked about him.

Get a life!

There were also over 99 notifications in his Moments. Good heavens, didn't it bother him?

Wen Ni was the type of person who had to click on every single red dot.

Wen Ni scrolled through and found that his business dealings were so extensive, it exceeded her imagination.

Tourism, catering, AI, medical...

Why was there even robotics?

She suddenly felt that she didn't know at all whether Jian Yuchen had been secretly handling other matters in his office at Lingdu.

Otherwise, where did he get so much energy?

"See anything?" the man asked from the kitchen.

Wen Ni said awkwardly, "Why do you have so many discussion groups?"

"Work-related matters." Jian Yuchen rubbed his temples. "But this software isn't very user-friendly; it can't transfer larger files."

Indeed, and it took up too much memory, too.

Wen Ni searched around and finally found the class group that had just been created in the corner.

People in the group were still calling for Jian Yuchen.

"Did you find anything?" the man asked.

Wen Ni scratched her hair. "Are you going to the class reunion? The people from our graduating class who stayed in H City are calling for you in the group."

Jian Yuchen frowned. "Do you want to go?"

Wen Ni was conflicted. If she went, what identity should she go as?

As Jian Yuchen’s wife, or... as a colleague from the company?

Or should she keep up the act and pretend they weren't close?

And if they held a wedding banquet in the future, what would they tell everyone when they invited them to dinner?

Wen Ni suddenly gave a start.

Good heavens, she had actually started thinking about holding a wedding banquet with Jian Yuchen.

Both sets of parents had been urging them to do so.

They had been urging them for three years now.

For the first two years, she used the excuse that their careers weren't stable and they didn't want to go public yet.

But now, she was a design director.

And Jian Yuchen, that guy, seemed to be doing quite well and smoothly in his career, too.

This left her with no excuses to find.

"If you want to go, I'll go."

Wen Ni was puzzled. "Why do you sound like you don't want to go?"

Jian Yuchen looked at the noodles in the pot. "I really don't want to go that much. Everyone is too busy. If it’s just a boring social gathering for bragging, I avoid it if I can."

Adults need to know how to filter their surroundings.

Jian Yuchen didn't have the time to spare to get together with a bunch of people he barely kept in touch with just to reminisce about the past.

Wen Ni sometimes felt that this man was quite heartless.

At other times, she felt he was overly concerned about everyone.

He even personally went to check on the grandmother living downstairs last year when she didn't go for her nucleic acid test, just to see if she was feeling unwell.

"I think if everyone is going, it wouldn't hurt to go."

"Then how do you plan to introduce our relationship?" Jian Yuchen turned off the stove and scooped out the noodles.

Wen Ni opened her mouth. "That’s... that’s exactly why I’m asking you, because I can't make up my mind."

Jian Yuchen said, "Go if you want to. This isn't a difficult question."

"Then..."

"We are already husband and wife; do you plan on getting a divorce later?" Jian Yuchen raised his thin eyelids, his gaze fixed directly on her.

Wen Ni shivered for no reason, feeling as if she were to nod, this man might pounce over and bite her neck off.

She touched her neck. "Well... it’s not that serious."

Actually, being married to Jian Yuchen for so long had already exceeded her expectations.

She had originally thought that, given the nature of the two of them, they would have divorced within three days over how soft-boiled an egg should be.

But in reality, in their daily life, Jian Yuchen tried his best to satisfy her needs.

Her temper wasn't good, and sometimes even she felt she was being unreasonable, but he would just get up and do what was needed.

He never seemed to ask why or try to lecture her.

It was completely different from Wen Zhiwen.

Most of Wen Ni’s resistance to marriage stemmed from Wen Zhiwen.

She had seen with her own eyes how Wen Zhiwen would call her mother a spendthrift with no brains just for spending 10 yuan more on groceries.

And that she hadn't improved over the years.

It was as if he had suffered a great loss by marrying such an unvirtuous woman, and that no one else would want her but him.

He was her savior.

And her mother would only meekly say she wouldn't do it again.

But that dish was one her mother loved to eat.

Because of Wen Zhiwen, she didn't even dare to eat more than a few bites.

The blind dates Wen Zhiwen introduced were all just like him.

As soon as they sat down and opened their mouths, they were filled with the heavy stench of Wen Zhiwen.

Wen Ni felt she wasn't going on a blind date with a future partner.

She was meeting her own father.

And repeating her mother's fate.

That was why she had been able to settle for Jian Yuchen back then; she felt that no matter how bad things got, at least if Jian Yuchen retorted, she would have the interest to retort back.

If a miniature version of Wen Zhiwen said those things to her, she might just kill him.

She had never had much self-control when it came to her original family.

How would she rate Jian Yuchen as a husband?

She suddenly felt that if the passing grade was 60, Jian Yuchen could get a perfect score from her.

The freedom, comfort, and harbor she wanted, he could provide them all.

It seemed that all her pre-marital concerns had become more relaxed and comfortable because she had no demands of Jian Yuchen.

She had to admit that seeing Wen Zhiwen felt oppressive, but the moment she saw Jian Yuchen, there was a mysterious sense of joy in her heart.

Why was that happiness there?

It was as if a butterfly had flown by, flapping its wings. Wen Ni blinked, and Jian Yuchen had already carried the noodles to the coffee table and walked past her.

"When is the class reunion?"

"Next Friday."

Jian Yuchen picked up the noodles. "Then you still have some time to consider it, don't you?"

He paused, not looking at her, looking somewhat disappointed.

"Consider how to introduce our relationship, then decide whether to go or not."

"The decision is in your hands."

For the first time, Wen Ni felt that when Jian Yuchen said this, he seemed a bit pathetic.
